//// blueprints/addon.d.ts
import type { BaseComponentEmits, BaseComponentProps, BaseComponentParts, BaseComponentSlots, BaseComponentClasses, BaseComponentExpose, AddonItem, LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type DefineEvents } from '../helpers';
/**
 * Props for the addon component blueprint.
 */
export interface AddonProps<S = AddonSlots, P = AddonParts, C = AddonClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseComponentProps<S, P, C, TContext> {
    /**
     * The addon content — a text value or an element schema tuple.
     */
    addon?: AddonItem;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the addon component.
 */
export interface AddonEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseComponentEmits<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots of the addon component.
 */
export interface AddonSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseComponentSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Parts of the addon component.
 */
export interface AddonParts extends BaseComponentParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes of the addon component.
 */
export interface AddonClasses extends BaseComponentClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for addon-based components.
 */
export interface AddonExpose extends BaseComponentExpose, AddonApi {
}
/**
 * Factory API produced by the addon blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props. Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites.
 */
export type AddonApi<TProps extends AddonProps = AddonProps> = ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>;
/**
 * Builds the addon factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`.
 */
export declare function blueprint<TProps extends AddonProps>(props: LooseRequired<TProps>, _events: DefineEvents<AddonEmits>): {
    resolved: import("vue").ComputedRef<import("../helpers").ResolvedAddon>;
};
/**
 * Default prop values for the addon blueprint.
 *
 * @skipTypeExport
 */
export declare const defaults: {};

//// blueprints/button.d.ts
import type { DProp, LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type DisabledProps, type BaseElementEmits, type BaseElementProps, type BaseElementParts, type BaseElementClasses, type BaseElementExpose, type BaseElementSlots, type AddonableProps, type LoadingProps, type LayoutProps, type InteractionEmits, type BtnEmits, type BtnProps } from '../features';
import { type DefineEvents } from '../helpers';
/**
 * Props for the button element blueprint.
 *
 * Non-generic counterpart — no item-driving type parameters. The plain props
 * type and the props interface are the same shape.
 */
export interface ButtonProps<T extends string = 'button', S = ButtonSlots, P = ButtonParts, C = ButtonClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, BtnProps {
    /**
     * The visual variant of the button.
     */
    variant?: 'filled' | 'outlined' | 'text' | 'link';
    /**
     * The color severity of the button.
     */
    severity?: DProp<'primary' | 'secondary' | 'success' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'help' | 'danger' | 'contrast', TContext>;
    /**
     * The size of the button.
     */
    size?: 'medium' | 'small';
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the button element.
 */
export interface ButtonEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, BtnEmits, InteractionEmits<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available on the button element blueprint.
 */
export interface ButtonSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseElementSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the button element blueprint.
 */
export interface ButtonParts extends BaseElementParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the button element blueprint.
 */
export interface ButtonClasses extends BaseElementClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for button-based components.
 */

}
/**
 * Factory API produced by the button blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props. Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites.
 */
export type ButtonApi<TProps extends ButtonProps<string> = ButtonProps<string>> = ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>;

 * Builds the button factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`.
 */
export declare function blueprint<TProps extends ButtonProps<string>>(props: LooseRequired<TProps>, events: DefineEvents<ButtonEmits>): {
    label: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | undefined>;
    form$: import("../components/VfForm").VfFormContext<import("../components/VfForm").EntryProps<Record<string, any>>> | undefined;
    severity: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    name: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<string, string>>;
    id: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    page: import("vue").ComputedRef<import("../types").PageProp | undefined>;
    help: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    description: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    tokens: import("vue").ComputedRef<import("vue").CSSProperties>;
    disabled: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    loading: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    text: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    icon: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | undefined>;
    href: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    to: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    focus: (scroll?: boolean | undefined) => Promise<boolean>;
    path: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    container: import("@vueform/core").ContainerContext;
    $el: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<HTMLElement | null, HTMLElement | null>>;
    componentName: keyof import("@vueform/core").ComponentRegistry<Record<string, any>>;
    uid: import("vue").Ref<string, string>;
    children: import("../composables").VueformChildren;
    available: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    visible: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    viewLoaded: import("vue").Ref<boolean, boolean>;
    genericName: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    helpId: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    descriptionId: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    errorId: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    labelId: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    resolvedColumns: import("vue").ComputedRef<Record<string, Partial<import("../types").ResolvedColumns>>>;
    updateColumns: (v: any) => any;
    scrollTo: (options?: ScrollIntoViewOptions, force?: boolean) => Promise<boolean>;
    errors: import("vue").ComputedRef<string[]>;
    messageBag: import("../composables").MessageBagInstance;
    displayErrors: import("vue").ComputedRef<string[]>;
    messages: import("vue").ComputedRef<string[]>;
    nonce: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<string | undefined, string | undefined>>;
    tokenClass: string;
    tokenCss: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    disable: () => void;
    enable: () => void;
    handleClick: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
    type: import("vue").Ref<LooseRequired<TProps> extends infer T ? T extends LooseRequired<TProps> ? T extends {
        type: infer T_1;
    } ? [Extract<NonNullable<T_1>, string>] extends [never] ? string : Extract<NonNullable<T_1>, string> : string : never : never, LooseRequired<TProps> extends infer T_2 ? T_2 extends LooseRequired<TProps> ? T_2 extends {
        type: infer T_1;
    } ? [Extract<NonNullable<T_1>, string>] extends [never] ? string : Extract<NonNullable<T_1>, string> : string : never : never>;
};

//// blueprints/checkbox.d.ts
import type { LooseRequired, TProp } from '../types';
import { type AriaProps, type DisabledProps, type BaseElementProps, type ValidationProps, type BaseElementEmits, type ExpressionProps, type ModelPropsWithDefault, type BaseElementParts, type BaseElementClasses, type BaseElementExpose, type BaseElementSlots, type AddonableProps, type LayoutProps, type ModelEmits, type InteractionEmits, type InputEmits, type ValidationEmits, type AlignedProps, type ModelApi } from '../features';
import { type DefineEvents } from '../helpers';
/**
 * Checkbox model shape: the union of `trueValue` and `falseValue`.
 */
type CheckboxModelOf<TTrueValue, TFalseValue> = TTrueValue | TFalseValue;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for checkbox — `NoInfer` so `modelValue` does not
 * compete with `trueValue` / `falseValue` when inferring generics.
 */
type CheckboxModelProp<TTrueValue, TFalseValue> = NoInfer<CheckboxModelOf<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>>;
/**
 * The model value type carried by the checkbox element's wide props.
 */
type CheckboxModel = Required<CheckboxProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Props for the checkbox element blueprint, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type arguments (`trueValue` / `falseValue`). Plain usage (`CheckboxProps`)
 * keeps every member wide, so no separate plain-props alias is needed.
 */
export interface CheckboxProps<T extends string = 'checkbox', TTrueValue = any, TFalseValue = any, S = CheckboxSlots, P = CheckboxParts, C = CheckboxClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefault<CheckboxModelProp<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, AlignedProps {
    /**
     * The value used when the checkbox is checked. Also drives one arm of the
     * model type.
     *
     * Includes a naked `boolean` arm alongside `TTrueValue` so the erased schema
     * surface (and blueprint defaults) still accept `true` / `false` literals.
     * Concrete values continue to infer into `TTrueValue`.
     */
    trueValue?: TTrueValue | boolean;
    /**
     * The value used when the checkbox is unchecked. Also drives one arm of the
     * model type.
     *
     * Includes a naked `boolean` arm alongside `TFalseValue` so the erased schema
     * surface (and blueprint defaults) still accept `true` / `false` literals.
     * Concrete values continue to infer into `TFalseValue`.
     */
    falseValue?: TFalseValue | boolean;
    /**
     * Overrides the HTML `name` attribute for the checkbox input.
     */
    checkboxName?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The label text displayed next to the checkbox.
     */
    text?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Positions the label text relative to the checkbox (`left`, `right`, or
     * `auto`).
     */
    align?: 'left' | 'right' | 'auto';
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the checkbox element.
 */
export interface CheckboxEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<CheckboxModel, TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<CheckboxModel, TContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available on the checkbox element blueprint.
 */
export interface CheckboxSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseElementSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the checkbox element blueprint.
 */
export interface CheckboxParts extends BaseElementParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the checkbox element blueprint.
 */
export interface CheckboxClasses extends BaseElementClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for checkbox-based components.
 */
export interface CheckboxExpose extends BaseElementExpose, CheckboxApi {
}
/**
 * Factory API produced by the checkbox blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props. Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites.
 */
export type CheckboxApi<TProps extends CheckboxProps<string> = CheckboxProps<string>> = ModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;
/**

    description: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    disabled: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    text: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    ruleMessages: Record<string, import("vue").ComputedRef<string | undefined>>;
    aria: import("vue").ComputedRef<{
        'aria-labelledby'?: string;
        'aria-describedby': string;
        'aria-required': boolean;
        'aria-invalid': boolean;
        'aria-busy': boolean;
    }>;
    nullValue: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<any, any>>;
    focus: (scroll?: boolean | undefined) => Promise<boolean>;
    load: (data: import("../features").ModelOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>) => void;
    reset: () => void;
    clear: () => void;
    invalid: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    track: () => void;
    path: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;

    $el: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<HTMLElement | null, HTMLElement | null>>;
    componentName: keyof import("@vueform/core").ComponentRegistry<Record<string, any>>;
    uid: import("vue").Ref<string, string>;
    children: import("../composables").VueformChildren;
    available: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;

    viewLoaded: import("vue").Ref<boolean, boolean>;
    genericName: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    helpId: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;

    initialModel: import("vue").Ref<import("../features").ModelOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>, import("../features").ModelOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>>;
    pending: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;

    messageBag: import("../composables").MessageBagInstance;

    onUserInput: () => void;
    validateSelf: () => Promise<boolean>;

//// blueprints/checkboxes.d.ts
import type { LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type DisabledProps, type ModelPropsWithDefault, type BaseElementEmits, type BaseElementProps, type ValidationProps, type ContainerProps, type BaseElementParts, type BaseElementClasses, type BaseElementExpose, type BaseElementSlots, type ItemsProps, type ItemsModelProp, type ItemValueProp, type GroupChildrenProp, type StackedProps, type LayoutProps, type ModelEmits, type InteractionEmits, type ValidationEmits, type AlignedProps, type ItemsProp, type ItemsModelApi } from '../features';

/**
 * Plain props type for the checkboxes element blueprint — the widest
 * instantiation of `CheckboxesProps`. Use this whenever "the props of a
 * checkboxes" is meant without generic narrowing; it also serves as the
 * constraint for `blueprint` / `CheckboxesApi` type parameters.
 */
type LooseCheckboxesProps = CheckboxesProps<string, ItemsProp, ItemValueProp, GroupChildrenProp>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the checkboxes element blueprint, parameterized
 * by the item-driving type arguments. Reach for `LooseCheckboxesProps` instead
 * when no narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface CheckboxesProps<T extends string = 'checkboxes', TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown, S = CheckboxesSlots, P = CheckboxesParts, C = CheckboxesClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ModelPropsWithDefault<ItemsModelProp<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, true, TModel, TItemValueReturn>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, ContainerProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, ItemsProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn, TContext>, StackedProps, AlignedProps {
}

}

 * Slots available on the checkboxes element blueprint.
 */

}

}

 * `CheckboxesApi<VfCheckboxesProps<typeof items, 'id'>>`). Prefer this over

 * layers, extensions).
 */
export type CheckboxesApi<TProps extends LooseCheckboxesProps = LooseCheckboxesProps> = ItemsModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;
/**
 * Builds the checkboxes factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,

        itemValueKey: TItemValueKey;
        groupChildren: TGroupChildren;

import type { BaseComponentEmits, BaseComponentProps, BaseComponentParts, BaseComponentSlots, BaseComponentExpose, BaseComponentClasses, AlignProp, ValignProp, LooseRequired } from '../types';

/**
 * Props for the col component blueprint that represents a column cell within a
 * row.
 */
export interface ColProps<S = ColSlots, P = ColParts, C = ColClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseComponentProps<S, P, C, TContext> {
    /**
     * The number of grid columns this cell spans.
     */
    colspan?: number | string;
    /**
     * The number of grid rows this cell spans.
     */
    rowspan?: number | string;
    /**
     * Horizontal alignment of the cell content.
     */
    align?: AlignProp;
    /**
     * Vertical alignment of the cell content.
     */
    valign?: ValignProp;
    /**
     * Whether this column cell should be styled as a header. Automatically
     * resolves to column header, row header, or both based on position.
     */
    header?: boolean;
}

 * Events emitted by the col component.
 */

}

}

}

}

}

export type ColApi<TProps extends ColProps = ColProps> = ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>;

//// blueprints/field.d.ts
import type { LanguagesProp, LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type AriaProps, type DisabledProps, type ModelPropsWithDefault, type AddonsProps, type IconsProps, type BaseElementEmits, type BaseElementProps, type BaseElementParts, type BaseElementClasses, type BaseElementExpose, type BaseElementSlots, type ExpressionProps, type TranslateProps, type TValidationProps, type ReadonlyProps, type LayoutProps, type ModelEmits, type InteractionEmits, type KeyEmits, type InputEmits, type ValidationEmits, type TranslateModel, type TranslatableModelApi } from '../features';
import { type DefineEvents } from '../helpers';
/**
 * Field model shape. `TNullValue` always types **one value** — the model itself
 * when not translating, the per-language entry when translating:
 *
 * - `translate: false` — the `nullValue` prop type (default `null` on the SFC).
 * - `translate: true` — a locale-keyed object of `TNullValue` entries (the SFC
 *   defaults `TNullValue` to the text scalar `string | number | null` here).
 * - `translate` wide/unset — union of both.
 */
type FieldTranslateModel<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, TNullValue = any> = [boolean] extends [TTranslate] ? FieldNullValue<TNullValue> | TranslateModel<boolean, TLanguages, FieldNullValue<TNullValue>> : [TTranslate] extends [true] ? TranslateModel<true, TLanguages, FieldNullValue<TNullValue>> : FieldNullValue<TNullValue>;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for field — `NoInfer` so `modelValue` does not
 * compete with `translate` / `languages` / `nullValue` when inferring
 * generics.
 */
type FieldTranslateModelProp<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, TNullValue = any> = NoInfer<FieldTranslateModel<TTranslate, TLanguages, TNullValue>>;
/**
 * The model value type carried by the field element's wide props.
 */
type FieldModel = Required<FieldProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * The field's current-value type, read from the `nullValue` prop — which types
 * one value in both modes (the model when not translating, the per-language
 * entry when translating), so no model-shape dissection is needed.
 */
type FieldValueOf<TProps> = 'nullValue' extends keyof TProps ? FieldNullValue<Exclude<TProps['nullValue'], undefined>> : any;
/**
 * Recursively widens literals to their primitives: `'1234'` → `string`, `0` →
 * `number`, `false` → `boolean`. Arrays of any shape become `any[]` — an array
 * `nullValue` only says "the model is an array", never what it holds. Object
 * properties turn optional (a model may be partially filled) and widen the same
 * way, dropping `readonly`; functions and remaining types pass through.
 */
export type WidenLiteral<T> = T extends string ? string : T extends number ? number : T extends boolean ? boolean : T extends readonly any[] ? any[] : T extends (...args: any[]) => any ? T : T extends object ? {
    -readonly [K in keyof T]?: WidenLiteral<T[K]>;
} : T;
/**
 * Derives the model / value type from a `nullValue`. The declared empty value
 * describes the _kind_ of data, not its exact members — `defineSchema`'s
 * `const` narrowing would otherwise turn `['1234', 'asdf']` into a tuple of
 * those literals and reject every real model value:
 *
 * - `null` — no shape declared, the model is `any`.
 * - string / number / boolean — widened to the primitive.
 * - array — `any[]`, regardless of the declared members.
 * - object — the shape is kept with every key optional; a key that IS provided
 *   must match its declared (widened) property type.
 */
export type FieldNullValue<T> = [T] extends [null] ? any : WidenLiteral<T>;
/**
 * Props for the field element blueprint, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type arguments (`translate` / `languages` / `nullValue`). Plain usage
 * (`FieldProps`) keeps every member wide, so no separate plain-props alias is
 * needed.
 *
 * `nullValue` always types one value: it is the model when the element is not
 * translatable, and each language's entry when `translate: true` (where the
 * model is a locale-keyed object of it).
 */
export interface FieldProps<T extends string = 'field', TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, TNullValue = any, S = FieldSlots, P = FieldParts, C = FieldClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefault<FieldTranslateModelProp<TTranslate, TLanguages, TNullValue>, TContext>, TValidationProps<TContext>, TranslateProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, ReadonlyProps<TContext> {
    /**
     * The custom null value representing an empty state. Always describes one
     * value: the model itself when the element is not translatable, and each
     * language's entry when `translate: true`.
     */
    nullValue?: TNullValue;
    /**
     * Arbitrary pass-through options exposed in the slot context, useful for
     * parameterizing slot components in schema-driven usage.
     */
    options?: Record<string, any>;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the field element.
 */
export interface FieldEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<FieldModel, TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, KeyEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<FieldModel, TContext> {
    /**
     * Generic proxy event that the default slot can use to surface events from
     * the underlying input component.
     *
     * @param name The original event name being proxied.
     * @param args Additional event arguments.
     */
    event: [name: string, ...args: any[]];
}

/**
 * The model value type carried by the file element's wide props.
 */
type FileModel = Required<FileProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Props for the file element blueprint, parameterized by the model-driving type
 * argument (`multiple`). Plain usage (`FileProps`) keeps every member wide, so
 * no separate plain-props alias is needed.
 *
 * - `multiple: false` — model is `File | null`
 * - `multiple: true` — model is `File[]`
 */
export interface FileProps<T extends string = 'file', TMultiple extends boolean = boolean, S = FileSlots, P = FileParts, C = FileClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ModelPropsWithDefault<FileModelProp<TMultiple>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, MultipleProps<TMultiple> {
    /**
     * Whether pre-existing (non-File) items can be removed. Defaults to `true`.
     * Newly added files are always removable regardless of this setting.
     */
    remove?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the file select button should be displayed.
     */
    add?: boolean;
    /**
     * The accepted file types (e.g. `image/*`, `.pdf,.docx`).
     */
    accept?: string;
    /**
     * The capture attribute for mobile device camera/microphone access (e.g.
     * `user`, `environment`).
     */
    capture?: 'user' | 'environment' | boolean;
    /**
     * The label text displayed on the file selection button.
     */
    text?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The icon identifier for the add button.
     */
    addIcon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The icon identifier for the remove button.
     */
    removeIcon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
}

 * Events emitted by the file element.

     *
     * @param file The newly added file.

/**
 * Describes a previously uploaded file with optional display metadata. All
 * properties are optional to allow custom object shapes — the defaults provide
 * an opinionated structure for the built-in file list rendering.
 */
export interface FileObject {
    /**
     * The display name of the file.
     */
    name?: string;
    /**
     * A URL to link the file name to.
     */
    url?: string;
    /**
     * Whether the file can be removed. Defaults to `true` when omitted.
     */
    remove?: boolean;
    [key: string]: unknown;
}
/**
 * A normalized file entry used for rendering the file list.
 */
export interface FileListItem {
    /**
     * The display name of the file.
     */
    name: string;
    /**
     * An optional URL to render the name as a link.
     */
    url?: string;
    /**
     * Whether the file can be removed from the list.
     */
    removable: boolean;
    /**
     * The kind of the original value: `'file'` for `File` instances, `'string'`
     * for plain strings, or `'object'` for `FileObject` entries.
     */
    type: 'file' | 'string' | 'object';
    /**
     * The original raw value from the model (`File`, `string`, or `FileObject`).
     * Available for custom slot rendering.
     */
    raw: FileProp;
}

 * override.

export declare function toFileListItem(v: File | string | FileObject, removable: boolean, { $security }: {

    filled: (value: any) => boolean;
    dirty: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    completed: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    success: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    empty: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    messageBag: import("../composables").MessageBagInstance;
    validation: import("vue").ShallowReactive<Record<string, import("@vueform/core").ValidationView>>;
    validator: import("@vueform/core").Validator;
    shouldValidate: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    onUserInput: () => void;
    validateSelf: () => Promise<boolean>;
    initValidation: () => void;
    destroyValidation: () => void;
    update: (data: import("../features").ModelOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>) => void;
    isContainer: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<boolean, boolean>>;
    isFlatContainer: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    containerModel: import("vue").ComputedRef<unknown>;
    handleModelUpdate: (data: Event) => void;
    validateChildren: (options?: {
        force?: boolean;
    }) => Promise<boolean>;
    unvalidate: () => void;
    clean: () => void;
    clearErrors: () => void;
    clearMessages: () => void;
    clearMessageBag: () => void;
    tracking: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    untrack: () => void;
    init: () => void;
    reinit: () => void;
    destroy: () => void;
    initModel: (() => void) | (() => void);
    reinitModel: (unregisterDataPath?: string) => void;
    destroyModel: (() => void) | (() => void);
    rootModel: import("@vueform/core").RootModel | undefined;
    payload: import("vue").ComputedRef<Record<import("../types").ElementName, any>>;
    dataPath: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<string, string>>;
    ownDataPaths: import("vue").ComputedRef<string[]>;
    sensitivePaths: import("vue").ComputedRef<string[]>;
    hoisted: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean | undefined>;
    displayErrors: import("vue").ComputedRef<any[]>;
    ownErrors: import("vue").ComputedRef<string[]>;
    formErrors: import("vue").ComputedRef<Record<string, string[]>>;
    messages: import("vue").ComputedRef<string[]>;
    setInputRef: (el: any) => void;
    canonicalDomValue: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    inputBindings: import("vue").ComputedRef<{
        ref: (el: any) => void;
        onBlur?: ((e: Event) => void) | undefined;
        onFocus?: ((e: Event) => void) | undefined;
        onInput: (payload: any, e?: Event) => void;
    }>;
    componentBindings: import("vue").ComputedRef<{
        onBlur?: ((e: Event) => void) | undefined;
        onFocus?: ((e: Event) => void) | undefined;
        modelValue: any;
        'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: any) => void;
    }>;
    disable: () => void;
    enable: () => void;
    type: import("vue").Ref<LooseRequired<TProps> extends infer T_1 ? T_1 extends LooseRequired<TProps> ? T_1 extends {
        type: infer T_2;
    } ? [Extract<NonNullable<T_2>, string>] extends [never] ? string : Extract<NonNullable<T_2>, string> : string : never : never, LooseRequired<TProps> extends infer T_3 ? T_3 extends LooseRequired<TProps> ? T_3 extends {
        type: infer T_2;
    } ? [Extract<NonNullable<T_2>, string>] extends [never] ? string : Extract<NonNullable<T_2>, string> : string : never : never>;
};

import { type ComputedRef, type MaybeRef, type Ref } from 'vue';
import type { NavPosProp } from './nav';
import type { StackedProps, TabbedEmits, TabbedProps } from '../features';
import type { AutosaveProp } from '../modules/autosave';
import type { ConditionalProp, ConditionsTriggerProp } from '../modules/conditions';
import type { BaseComponentEmits, BaseComponentProps, BaseComponentParts, BaseComponentSlots, BaseComponentExpose, BaseComponentClasses, EndpointProp, ErrorLevelProp, ExpressionsProp, LanguagesProp, RuleMessagesProp, ScrollTopOnProp, ShowRequiredProp, TProp, ThemeTokens, ValidateOnProp, LooseRequired, FormSchema, DeepPartial, ElementByPath, GetResult, ModelByPath, Paths, SchemaToModel, StandardSchemaV1 } from '../types';
import { type Pager, type ResolvedPage } from '../composables';

/**
 * The non-generic bulk of the form factory API, computed and cached once at the
 * widest props. `FormApi<TProps>` overlays only the small schema-dependent
 * slice (`find` / `get` / `set` / model fields) on top — instantiating
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` per concrete props re-derives the
 * entire blueprint return each time.
 */
type FormApiBase = Omit<ReturnType<typeof setup>, keyof FormSchemaApi>;
/**
 * The schema type carried by a form props type's `schema` prop (`MaybeRef`
 * unwrapped), falling back to the wide `FormSchema`.
 */
type FormPropsSchema<TProps> = TProps extends {
    schema?: MaybeRef<infer S | undefined>;
} ? [S] extends [never] ? FormSchema : S : FormSchema;
/**
 * Props for the form component blueprint, optionally parameterized by a
 * concrete schema type (`TSchema`) that drives the typed schema API (`find` /
 * `get` / `set` / `model` / `payload` / `update`).
 */
export interface FormProps<S = FormSlots, P = FormParts, C = FormClasses, TContext = any, TSchema = FormSchema> extends BaseComponentProps<S, P, C, TContext>, TabbedProps, StackedProps {
    /**
     * Optional name identifying this form instance in DevTools and debugging.
     */
    name?: string;
    /**
     * The schema defining the form's elements and structure.
     */
    schema?: MaybeRef<TSchema>;
    /**
     * The form data object (v-model), or a `useModel` instance whose store the
     * form adopts (shared data, no cloning or v-model sync).
     */
    modelValue?: Record<string, any> | ModelInstance<any>;
    /**
     * Custom validation error messages keyed by rule name.
     */
    ruleMessages?: RuleMessagesProp;
    /**
     * Available languages for multilingual forms.
     */
    languages?: LanguagesProp;
    /**
     * The default selected language.
     */
    language?: string;
    /**
     * Whether the form supports multilingual content.
     */
    multilingual?: boolean;
    /**
     * Events that trigger form validation (e.g. blur, change, submit).
     */
    validateOn?: ValidateOnProp;
    /**
     * A Standard Schema (Zod, Valibot, ArkType, …) validated against the whole
     * form data for form-level (cross-field) validation. Issues are bucketed by
     * path onto the matching element's validation state; unmatched / pathless
     * issues surface as the form's root-level errors. Overrides a Standard Schema
     * attached via `defineSchema`'s second argument.
     */
    validationSchema?: StandardSchemaV1;
    /**
     * Where to show required field indicators (e.g. label, placeholder).
     */
    showRequired?: ShowRequiredProp;
    /**
     * Whether to clear custom/server errors on revalidation.
     */
    clearCustomErrors?: boolean;
    /**
     * Controls where validation errors are displayed (element-level, form-level,
     * or both).
     */
    errorLevel?: ErrorLevelProp;
    /**
     * Whether to hide form-level validation error messages.
     */
    hideErrors?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the form uses a multi-step wizard layout.
     */
    stepped?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to show a progress bar in stepped forms.
     */
    progress?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to show step navigation in stepped forms.
     */
    nav?: boolean;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    navPos?: NavPosProp;
    /**
     * Whether to automatically sync step state when data is loaded or the form
     * mounts with pre-filled data. When enabled, steps are enabled up to the last
     * step that has data and that step is selected.
     */
    syncSteps?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to enable browser history for stepped forms.
     */
    history?: boolean;
    /**
     * Overrides the global `config.routerQueryParam` for this form. When set,
     * step names are encoded as a query parameter instead of a path segment.
     */
    routerQueryParam?: string;
    /**
     * Whether to show the back button in stepped forms.
     */
    back?: boolean;
    /**
     * The label for the next step button.
     */
    nextLabel?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The label for the back step button.
     */
    backLabel?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The label for the finish/submit button in stepped forms.
     */
    finishLabel?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Events that trigger scrolling to the top of the form.
     */
    scrollTopOn?: ScrollTopOnProp;
    /**
     * Whether to scroll to the first element with an error on validation failure.
     */
    scrollToError?: boolean;
    /**
     * Options passed to `scrollIntoView` when scrolling.
     */
    scrollOptions?: ScrollIntoViewOptions;
    /**
     * Whether to focus the first element with an error on validation failure.
     */
    focusError?: boolean;
    /**
     * The autosave configuration object: a remote `endpoint` (URL or handler
     * function) with its scheduling options (`on`, `interval`, `delay`,
     * `invalid`, `method`, `transform`), and/or a `local` draft mirror that saves
     * the model to storage on every action, restores it on mount, and clears it
     * on successful submit.
     */
    autosave?: AutosaveProp;
    /**
     * Whether the form should display a default submit button
     */
    submits?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the form is in a loading state.
     */
    loading?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the form is disabled. Accepts a boolean, a ref, or a conditional
     * prop.
     */
    disabled?: ConditionalProp<TContext>;
    /**
     * Whether the form is in read-only mode. Accepts a boolean, a ref, or a
     * conditional prop.
     */
    readonly?: ConditionalProp<TContext>;
    /**
     * The source that triggers re-evaluation of the form's async conditional
     * props. Accepts an array of element paths whose values are watched, a `Ref`,
     * or a function used as a watch getter. When omitted, any change in the form
     * model re-triggers evaluation.
     */
    conditionsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp;
    /**
     * The debounce delay in milliseconds applied before re-evaluating the form's
     * async conditional props when the trigger source changes. Overrides the
     * global `$conditions.debounce` config (default `300`).
     */
    conditionsDebounce?: number;
    /**
     * The HTTP method for form submission (e.g. POST, PUT).
     */
    method?: RequestMethod;
    /**
     * The URL or async function handling form submission.
     */
    endpoint?: EndpointProp;
    /**
     * URL to redirect to after successful submission.
     */
    redirect?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Message displayed after successful form submission.
     */
    successMessage?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Whether to reset the form after successful submission.
     */
    resetOnSuccess?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to clear the form after successful submission.
     */
    clearOnSuccess?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to set validation errors on elements from a 422 server response.
     */
    setInvalid?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to update form data with the server response data.
     */
    setResponse?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to send form data as JSON instead of FormData.
     */
    json?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to encode file uploads as base64.
     */
    base64?: boolean;
    /**
     * Custom HTTP headers to include in the submission request.
     */
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    /**
     * Token overrides applied to the form's CSS custom properties.
     */
    tokens?: ThemeTokens;
    /**
     * Controls which props allow dynamic expression resolution. Set to `false` to
     * disable all expression evaluation, `true` to enable for all expressionable
     * props, or an array of prop keys to enable selectively.
     */
    expressions?: ExpressionsProp;
    /**
     * Form-level expression constants. Each value is a TProp that is resolved and
     * merged into the expression evaluation scope. Names already registered in
     * `config.$expression.consts` keep the config value — the form-level entry is
     * ignored.
     */
    consts?: Record<string, TProp>;
    /**
     * Forces the form into dark or light mode regardless of the environment.
     *
     * **Requires `build.scopedDarkMode: true` in the `createVueform` config.**
     */
    dark?: boolean;
    /**
     * Transforms form data before submission.
     *
     * @param payload The form payload to transform.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    transformPayload?: (payload: Record<string, any>, context$: any) => Record<string, any>;
    /**
     * Transforms the server's validation error response.
     *
     * @param data The raw error response data.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    transformServerInvalid?: (data: Record<string, any>, context$: any) => Record<string, any>;
    /**
     * Transforms the server response data when `setResponse` is enabled.
     *
     * @param data The raw response payload.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    transformResponse?: (data: any, context$: any) => Record<string, any>;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the form component.
 */
export interface FormEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseComponentEmits<TContext>, TabbedEmits {
    /**
     * Emitted when the active step changes.
     *
     * @param newPage The step being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The step being navigated from.
     * @param pager The pager instance managing step state.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    step: [
        newPage: ResolvedPage,
        oldPage: ResolvedPage,
        pager: Pager,
        context$: TContext
    ];
    /**
     * Emitted when navigating to the previous step.
     *
     * @param newPage The step being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The step being navigated from.
     * @param pager The pager instance managing step state.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    back: [
        newPage: ResolvedPage,
        oldPage: ResolvedPage,
        pager: Pager,
        context$: TContext
    ];
    /**
     * Emitted when navigating to the next step.
     *
     * @param newPage The step being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The step being navigated from.
     * @param pager The pager instance managing step state.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    next: [
        newPage: ResolvedPage,
        oldPage: ResolvedPage,
        pager: Pager,
        context$: TContext
    ];
    /**
     * Emitted before the active step changes, allowing cancellation.
     *
     * @param newPage The step being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The step being navigated from.
     * @param pager The pager instance managing step state.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    beforeStep: [
        newPage: ResolvedPage,
        oldPage: ResolvedPage,
        pager: Pager,
        context$: TContext
    ];
    /**
     * Emitted before navigating to the previous step, allowing cancellation.
     *
     * @param newPage The step being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The step being navigated from.
     * @param pager The pager instance managing step state.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    beforeBack: [
        newPage: ResolvedPage,
        oldPage: ResolvedPage,
        pager: Pager,
        context$: TContext
    ];
    /**
     * Emitted before navigating to the next step, allowing cancellation.
     *
     * @param newPage The step being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The step being navigated from.
     * @param pager The pager instance managing step state.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    beforeNext: [
        newPage: ResolvedPage,
        oldPage: ResolvedPage,
        pager: Pager,
        context$: TContext
    ];
    /**
     * Emitted before the form finishes (submits from the last step), allowing
     * cancellation.
     *
     * @param pager The pager instance managing step state.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    beforeFinish: [pager: Pager, context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when any form element's value changes, with the new and previous
     * values.
     *
     * @param newValue The new form data.
     * @param oldValue The previous form data.
     * @param context$ The component context.
     */
    change: [
        newValue: Record<string, any>,
        oldValue: Record<string, any>,
        context$: TContext
    ];
    /**
     * Emitted when the form is reset to its default values.
     *
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    reset: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when the form is cleared.
     *
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    clear: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when form data is loaded programmatically via the `load` method.
     *
     * @param value The loaded model value.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    load: [value: any, context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted before the autosave request is sent. Return `false` to cancel, a
     * `string` to use as the endpoint URL, or an `HttpResponse` to use as the
     * result without making a request.
     *
     * @param payload The form payload to be autosaved.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    autosave: [payload: Record<string, any>, context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted before a locally stored autosave draft is restored into the form on
     * mount. Return `false` to skip the restore (the stored draft is kept).
     *
     * @param data The stored draft data about to be loaded.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    autosaveRestore: [data: Record<string, any>, context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted after a successful autosave operation.
     *
     * @param response The HTTP response from the autosave request.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    autosaveSuccess: [response: HttpResponse, context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when an autosave request fails due to a network or server error.
     *
     * @param error The HTTP error that caused the failure.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    autosaveFail: [error: HttpError, context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when the form becomes invalid due to client-side validation errors.
     *
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    invalid: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when the form passes validation.
     *
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    valid: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when the form is submitted, before the HTTP request is sent.
     *
     * @param payload The submitted form payload.
     * @param context$ The form's component context.
     */
    submit: [payload: FormData | Record<string, any>, context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when an HTTP response is received from the server.
     *
     * @param response The HTTP response object.
     */
    response: [response: HttpResponse];
    /**
     * Emitted when form submission fails due to a network or server error.
     *
     * @param result The failure result object.
     */
    fail: [result: SubmitFail];
    /**
     * Emitted when form submission fails due to validation errors.
     *
     * @param result The invalid result object.
     */
    serverInvalid: [result: SubmitServerInvalid];
    /**
     * Emitted when form submission succeeds.
     *
     * @param result The success result object.
     */
    success: [result: SubmitSuccess];
    /**
     * Emitted when form submission is cancelled before sending a request (e.g.
     * the form is invalid, loading, disabled, already submitting, or a `submit`
     * handler / `endpoint` function returned `false`).
     *
     * @param result The cancelled result object.
     */
    cancelled: [result: SubmitCancelled];
    /**
     * Emitted to update the v-model binding.
     *
     * @param value The new model value.
     */
    'update:modelValue': [value: Record<string, any>];
}
/**
 * Slots of the form component.
 */
export interface FormSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseComponentSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Parts of the form component.
 */
export interface FormParts extends BaseComponentParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes of the form component.
 */
export interface FormClasses extends BaseComponentClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for form-based components.
 */
export interface FormExpose extends BaseComponentExpose, FormApi {
}
/**
 * Result returned when form submission succeeds with a server response.
 */
export interface SubmitSuccess {
    /**
     * The result type discriminator, always 'success'.
     */
    type: 'success';
    /**
     * The response data returned by the server.
     */
    data: any;
    /**
     * The HTTP status code of the response.
     */
    status: number;
    /**
     * The full HTTP response object.
     */
    response: HttpResponse;
    /**
     * The form context instance at the time of submission.
     */
    context$: any;
}
/**
 * Result returned when form submission is rejected due to client-side
 * validation errors.
 */
export interface SubmitClientInvalid {
    /**
     * The result type discriminator, always 'invalid'.
     */
    type: 'invalid';
    /**
     * The error source, always 'client' for client-side validation failures.
     */
    source: 'client';
    /**
     * Validation errors keyed by element path.
     */
    errors: Record<string, string[]>;
    /**
     * Structured validation issues (`{ path, rule, message }`) — the same
     * projection as `form$.issues` at the time of submission.
     */
    issues: Issue[];
    /**
     * The form context instance at the time of submission.
     */
    context$: any;
}
/**
 * Result returned when the server responds with a 422 validation error.
 */
export interface SubmitServerInvalid {
    /**
     * The result type discriminator, always 'invalid'.
     */
    type: 'invalid';
    /**
     * The error source, always 'server' for 422 validation responses.
     */
    source: 'server';
    /**
     * Validation errors keyed by element path, transformed via
     * `transformServerInvalid`.
     */
    errors: Record<string, string[]>;
    /**
     * Structured issues synthesized from `errors` (`rule: 'server'`), mirroring
     * the client-side `issues` shape.
     */
    issues: Issue[];
    /**
     * The raw response data from the server.
     */
    data: any;
    /**
     * The full HTTP response object.
     */
    response: HttpResponse;
    /**
     * The form context instance at the time of submission.
     */
    context$: any;
}
/**
 * Union of client-side and server-side validation failure results.
 */
export type SubmitInvalid = SubmitClientInvalid | SubmitServerInvalid;
/**
 * Result returned when form submission fails due to a network or server error.
 */
export interface SubmitFail {
    /**
     * The result type discriminator, always 'fail'.
     */
    type: 'fail';
    /**
     * The category of the failure (e.g. network error, timeout, abort, an origin
     * blocked by `$security.allowOrigins`, or an SSR-time request).
     */
    reason: 'network' | 'timeout' | 'http' | 'abort' | 'blocked' | 'ssr' | 'unknown';
    /**
     * The HTTP status code, or null if no response was received.
     */
    status: number | null;
    /**
     * A human-readable error message describing the failure.
     */
    message: string;
    /**
     * The response data if available, or null.
     */
    data: any | null;
    /**
     * The HTTP response object if available, or null.
     */
    response: HttpResponse | null;
    /**
     * The form context instance at the time of submission.
     */
    context$: any;
}
/**
 * Result returned when form submission is cancelled before sending a request.
 */
export interface SubmitCancelled {
    /**
     * The result type discriminator, always 'cancelled'.
     */
    type: 'cancelled';
    /**
     * The reason the submission was cancelled (e.g. form was invalid, disabled,
     * or already submitting).
     */
    reason: 'loading' | 'disabled' | 'submitting' | 'prevented' | 'unknown';
    /**
     * The form context instance at the time of submission.
     */
    context$: any;
}
/**
 * Discriminated union of all possible form submission outcomes.
 */
export type SubmitResult = SubmitSuccess | SubmitInvalid | SubmitFail | SubmitCancelled;
/**
 * Factory API produced by the form blueprint's `blueprint` function, optionally
 * parameterized by concrete props (e.g. `FormApi<VfFormProps<typeof schema>>`).
 * Prefer this over `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites.
 */
export type FormApi<TProps extends FormProps<any, any, any, any, any> = FormProps> = FormApiBase & FormSchemaApi<FormPropsSchema<TProps>>;
/**
 * The schema-driven slice of the form factory API. When `TSchema` is a concrete
 * schema (e.g. from `defineSchema` via the `schema` prop), paths, element
 * contexts, and model shapes are all derived from it; with the wide
 * `FormSchema` every member falls back to its loose form.
 */
export type FormSchemaApi<TSchema = FormSchema> = {
    /**
     * Finds a registered element by its path or data path. Known schema paths are
     * suggested and return the element's schema-narrowed context; unknown paths
     * are accepted and return an untyped element.
     *
     * @param path The element path or data path to look up.
     */
    find: <P extends Paths<TSchema> | (string & {})>(path: P) => ElementByPath<TSchema, P> | undefined;
    /**
     * Returns the value of the element at the given path. When the path is
     * suffixed with `@propName` it returns that property of the element's context
     * instead of its model value.
     *
     * @param path The element path, optionally suffixed with `@propName`.
     */
    get: <P extends Paths<TSchema> | (string & {})>(path: P) => GetResult<TSchema, P>;
    /**
     * Sets the value of the element at the given path, falling back to writing
     * the root model directly when no element is registered there.
     *
     * @param path The element path to set.
     * @param value The value to assign.
     */
    set: <P extends Paths<TSchema> | (string & {})>(path: P, value: ModelByPath<TSchema, P>) => void;
    /**
     * The root reactive model object holding all form element values.
     */
    model: Ref<SchemaToModel<TSchema>>;
    /**
     * The full model data — an alias of `model`.
     */
    data: Ref<SchemaToModel<TSchema>>;
    /**
     * A snapshot of the model at mounted time, used for dirty checking and reset.
     */
    initialModel: Ref<SchemaToModel<TSchema>>;
    /**
     * The aggregated submission payload derived from all child elements.
     */
    payload: ComputedRef<SchemaToModel<TSchema>>;
    /**
     * Updates form element values programmatically from a (partial) data object.
     *
     * @param data The data to load into the form.
     */
    update: (data: DeepPartial<SchemaToModel<TSchema>>) => void;
};

/**
 * A resolved grid cell: what it mounts (`key` / `component` / `props`), its
 * span, and its alignment.
 */
export type ResolvedCell = {
    /**
     * Stable key for the rendered cell: the element's `name` for schema cells,
     * the `row-col` position otherwise.
     */
    key: string;
    /**
     * What the cell mounts: the resolved element component for schema cells (an
     * explicit `component` allowed by `$security.allowComponents`, or the `Vf*`
     * name derived from `type`), the content component for string cells (plain
     * text escaped; HTML via `$security.allowHtml: ['grid']`, sanitized after
     * expression resolution), or `null` for an empty cell.
     */
    component: string | Component | null;
    /**
     * The props bound to `component`: the sanitized element schema for schema
     * cells, empty otherwise.
     */
    props: Record<string, any>;
    /**
     * Number of columns this cell spans.
     */
    colspan: number;
    /**
     * Number of rows this cell spans.
     */
    rowspan: number;
    /**
     * Horizontal text alignment for the cell.
     */
    align: AlignProp;
    /**
     * Vertical alignment for the cell.
     */
    valign: ValignProp;
    /**
     * Additional HTML attributes applied to the cell element.
     */
    attrs: GridCellAttrs;
    /**
     * The cell's row index in the grid schema.
     */
    row: number;
    /**
     * The cell's column index in the grid schema.
     */
    col: number;
};
/**
 * A fully positioned grid cell with row/col coordinates and optional CSS
 * grid-area style.
 */
export type GridCell = ResolvedCell & {
    /**
     * The cell's row index in the resolved grid.
     */
    row: number;
    /**
     * The cell's column index in the resolved grid.
     */
    col: number;
    /**
     * The CSS grid row start position (0-based).
     */
    rowStart: number;
    /**
     * The CSS grid column start position (0-based).
     */
    colStart: number;
    /**
     * The CSS grid row end position (0-based).
     */
    rowEnd: number;
    /**
     * The CSS grid column end position (0-based).
     */
    colEnd: number;
    /**
     * Whether this cell is a column header (first row when colHeaders is
     * enabled).
     */
    colHeader: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether this cell is a row header (first column when rowHeaders is
     * enabled).
     */
    rowHeader: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether this cell occupies the last row of the grid.
     */
    lastRow: true | undefined;
    /**
     * Whether this cell occupies the last column of the grid.
     */
    lastCol: true | undefined;
};
/**
 * A two-dimensional array of resolved column tuples representing the full grid.
 */
export type ResolvedGrid = ResolvedCol[][];
/**
 * Map of row indices to inline column definitions used when the grid is defined
 * via template slots.
 */
export type InlineGrid = Map<number, [number, [number, number]][]>;

    page: import("vue").ComputedRef<import("../types").PageProp | undefined>;
    help: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    description: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    disabled: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    ruleMessages: Record<string, import("vue").ComputedRef<string | undefined>>;
    nullValue: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<any, any>>;
    focus: (scroll?: boolean | undefined) => Promise<boolean>;
    load: (data: import("../features").ModelOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>) => void;

     */

     * Whether to flat list values into a single-level array.
     */
    flat?: boolean;
    /**
     * Controls when validation is triggered.
     */

     * rendered.

    /**
     * Whether removing items is enabled. When `false`, remove buttons are not
     * rendered.
     */

    /**
     * The minimum number of items the list must contain. When reached, the remove
     * button is hidden.
     */
    min?: number;
    /**
     * The maximum number of items the list can contain. When reached, the add
     * button is hidden.
     */
    max?: number;
    /**

     */
    sort?: boolean;
    /**

    addLabel?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The label text for the "remove row" button.
     */
    removeLabel?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The placeholder text displayed when the list has no items.
     */
    placeholder?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The icon identifier for the "add row" button.
     */
    addIcon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The icon identifier for the "remove row" button.
     */
    removeIcon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The icon identifier for the sort handle button.
     */

     * Whether to render list items in a wrapped layout.

/**
 * A matrix row normalized from any accepted source format, with its value,
 * label, extracted metadata, and the original raw item.
 */
type NormalizedMatrixRow = {
    /**
     * The row's value used as the key in the matrix data model.
     */
    value: string | number;
    /**
     * The display label for this row header.
     */
    label: string | number | undefined;
    /**
     * Conditional visibility rules for this row.
     */
    conditions: ConditionalProp | undefined;
    /**
     * Validation rules applied to this row.
     */
    rules: RulesProp | undefined;
    /**
     * The original raw item the row was normalized from.
     */
    $raw: Record<string, any>;
};
export type MatrixModes = 'single' | 'multiple' | 'auto';
/**
 * Props for the matrix element blueprint.
 */
export interface MatrixProps<T extends string = 'matrix', S = MatrixSlots, P = MatrixParts, C = MatrixClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ModelProps<ObjectModel, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, ContainerProps, DisabledProps<TContext> {
    /**
     * The selection mode for the matrix.
     */
    mode?: MatrixModes | (string & {});
    /**
     * Whether the matrix uses a tabular visual style with borders and headers.
     */
    tabular?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to enable drag-and-drop sorting of matrix rows.
     */
    sort?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the matrix is horizontally scrollable on overflow.
     */
    scrollable?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether column headers stick to the left when scrolling.
     */
    stickyCols?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether row headers stick to the top when scrolling.
     */
    stickyRows?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether column header text can wrap.
     */
    wrapColHeaders?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether row header text can wrap.
     */
    wrapRowHeaders?: boolean;
    /**
     * The label text for the "add row" button.
     */
    addLabel?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The label text for the "remove row" button.
     */
    removeLabel?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The icon identifier for the "add row" button.
     */
    addIcon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The icon identifier for the "remove row" button.
     */
    removeIcon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The icon identifier for the sort handle button.
     */
    sortIcon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Whether to display column headers.
     */
    colHeaders?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to display row headers.
     */
    rowHeaders?: boolean;
    /**
     * The minimum width of each matrix column.
     */
    minWidth?: number | string;
    /**
     * The maximum width of each matrix column.
     */
    maxWidth?: number | string;
    /**
     * The minimum number of rows allowed.
     */
    min?: number;
    /**
     * The maximum number of rows allowed.
     */
    max?: number;
    /**
     * CSS `grid-template-columns` value or a function returning it.
     */
    gridTemplateColumns?: string | ((context$: any) => any);
    /**
     * Whether adding new rows is enabled. When `false`, the add button is not
     * rendered.
     */
    add?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether removing rows is enabled. When `false`, remove buttons are not
     * rendered.
     */
    remove?: boolean;
    /**
     * Custom HTTP headers to include when loading cols or rows from an endpoint.
     */
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    /**
     * The HTTP method to use when loading cols or rows from an endpoint. Defaults
     * to `'GET'`.
     */
    method?: string;
    /**
     * The column definitions for the matrix grid. Accepts a plain array, a plain
     * object, an array of objects (customizable via `colValue`, `colLabel`, and
     * related props), an endpoint URL string (supporting expressions), or a
     * (possibly async) function receiving the component context.
     */
    cols?: MatrixCols;
    /**
     * The row definitions or a fixed number of rows for the matrix grid. Accepts
     * a plain array, a plain object, an array of objects (customizable via
     * `rowValue`, `rowLabel`, and related props), an endpoint URL string
     * (supporting expressions), or a (possibly async) function receiving the
     * component context.
     */
    rows?: MatrixRows | number;
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each column's value (the key used in the
     * matrix data object) when `cols` is an array of objects. Defaults to
     * `'value'`. Set to `null` to use the full column object as the value.
     */
    colValue?: string | ((col: any) => any) | null;
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each column's header label when `cols` is
     * an array of objects. Defaults to `'label'`.
     */
    colLabel?: string | ((col: any) => string | number | undefined);
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each column's conditions when `cols` is
     * an array of objects. Defaults to `'conditions'`.
     */
    colConditions?: string | ((col: any) => ConditionsResult<TContext> | undefined);
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each column's custom element schema when
     * `cols` is an array of objects. Defaults to `'schema'`.
     */
    colSchema?: string | ((col: any) => MatrixElement | undefined);
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each column's minimum width when `cols`
     * is an array of objects. Defaults to `'minWidth'`.
     */
    colMinWidth?: string | ((col: any) => string | number | undefined);
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each column's maximum width when `cols`
     * is an array of objects. Defaults to `'maxWidth'`.
     */
    colMaxWidth?: string | ((col: any) => string | number | undefined);
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each row's value (the key used in the
     * matrix data object) when `rows` is an array of objects. Defaults to
     * `'value'`.
     */
    rowValue?: string | ((row: any) => string | number);
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each row's header label when `rows` is an
     * array of objects. Defaults to `'label'`.
     */
    rowLabel?: string | ((row: any) => string | number | undefined);
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each row's conditions when `rows` is an
     * array of objects. Defaults to `'conditions'`.
     */
    rowConditions?: string | ((row: any) => ConditionsResult | undefined);
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves each row's validation rules when `rows`
     * is an array of objects. Defaults to `'rules'`.
     */
    rowRules?: string | ((row: any) => RulesProp | undefined);
    /**
     * The source that triggers re-resolution of function-based `cols`. Accepts an
     * array of element paths whose values are watched, a `Ref`, or a function
     * used as a watch getter. When omitted, function-based cols are only
     * re-resolved when the `cols` prop reference itself changes.
     */
    colsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp;
    /**
     * The debounce delay in milliseconds applied before re-resolving `cols` when
     * an expression path or the `colsTrigger` source changes. Defaults to no
     * debounce (immediate re-resolution).
     */
    colsDebounce?: number;
    /**
     * Transforms data received from a `cols` endpoint or function into the cols
     * format before normalization.
     */
    transformCols?: (data: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>;
    /**
     * The source that triggers re-resolution of function-based `rows`. Accepts an
     * array of element paths whose values are watched, a `Ref`, or a function
     * used as a watch getter. When omitted, function-based rows are only
     * re-resolved when the `rows` prop reference itself changes.
     */
    rowsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp;
    /**
     * The debounce delay in milliseconds applied before re-resolving `rows` when
     * an expression path or the `rowsTrigger` source changes. Defaults to no
     * debounce (immediate re-resolution).
     */
    rowsDebounce?: number;
    /**
     * Transforms data received from a `rows` endpoint or function into the rows
     * format before normalization.
     */
    transformRows?: (data: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>;
    /**
     * An endpoint URL (supporting expressions) that loads both the column and row
     * definitions from a single request. Each side can still be overridden by
     * defining `cols` or `rows` explicitly.
     */
    endpoint?: string;
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves the column definitions from the
     * `endpoint` response. Defaults to `'cols'`.
     */
    colsKey?: string | ((data: any) => any);
    /**
     * The key or function that resolves the row definitions from the `endpoint`
     * response. Defaults to `'rows'`.
     */
    rowsKey?: string | ((data: any) => any);
    /**
     * Transforms data received from the `endpoint` before the column and row
     * definitions are extracted.
     */
    transformEndpoint?: (data: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>;
}

/**
 * A fully resolved matrix row with its component, props, column mappings, and
 * removal handler.
 */
export type ResolvedMatrixRow = {
    /**
     * The Vue component name for this row (e.g. VfRadios, VfCheckboxes, VfGroup).
     */
    component: string;
    /**
     * The resolved props passed to the row component.
     */
    props: {
        /**
         * The row's element name used to register it in the matrix data model.
         */
        name: ElementName;
        /**
         * The display label for this row.
         */
        label: string;
        /**
         * Conditional visibility rules for this row.
         */
        conditions: ConditionalProp | undefined;
        /**
         * Validation rules applied to this row.
         */
        rules: RulesProp | undefined;
        /**
         * Set to `false` to render the row's children without any layout wrapper.
         */
        layout: false;
        /**
         * Whether the row nests its data under the row key in the matrix model.
         */
        nested: boolean | undefined;
    };
    /**
     * The resolved columns belonging to this row.
     */
    cols: ResolvedMatrixCol[];
    /**
     * The slot name for rendering custom row content.
     */
    slot: string;
    /**
     * The unique DOM id for this row, used for ARIA references.
     */
    id: string;
    /**
     * The stable `v-for` key for this row: a per-item id for dynamic matrices or
     * the named row value for static ones. Stays constant across reorders so the
     * row's component instance (and its state) follows its data.
     */
    key: string;
    /**
     * The row's current data index (canonical position in the matrix model). Used
     * for drag identity and child data binding.
     */
    dataIndex: number;
    /**
     * Reactive boolean indicating whether the row is currently visible.
     */
    available: Ref<boolean>;
    /**
     * Removes this row from the matrix.
     */
    remove: () => void;
};
/**
 * A fully resolved matrix column with its component, value, label, and width
 * constraints.
 */
export type ResolvedMatrixCol = {
    /**
     * The resolved component for this column's input: an explicit `component`
     * allowed by `$security.allowComponents`, or the `Vf*` name derived from
     * `type` (e.g. VfRadio, VfCheckbox, VfText).
     */
    component: string | Component;
    /**
     * The element schema props passed to the column component.
     */
    props: MatrixElementSchema;
    /**
     * The column's value used as the key in the row's data model.
     */
    value: string | number;
    /**
     * The display label for this column header.
     */
    label: string;
    /**
     * Conditional visibility rules for this column.
     */
    conditions: ConditionalProp | undefined;
    /**
     * Reactive boolean indicating whether the column is currently visible.
     */
    available: Ref<boolean>;
    /**
     * Minimum width constraint for this column.
     */
    minWidth: string | number | undefined;
    /**
     * Maximum width constraint for this column.
     */
    maxWidth: string | number | undefined;
    /**
     * The unique DOM id for this column, used for ARIA references.
     */
    id: string;
};
/**

export type MatrixApi<TProps extends MatrixProps<string> = MatrixProps<string>> = ModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;

 * function.

export declare function resolveItemProp(raw: Record<string, any>, resolver: string | ((item: any) => any)): any;
/**
 * Normalizes a raw cols/rows source (array of primitives, array of objects, or
 * plain object map) into `{ value, label, $raw }` entries. Primitives and
 * object map entries produce synthetic raw objects and ignore the key/label
 * resolvers.
 *
 * @param source The resolved raw cols/rows data.
 * @param key The string key or mapping function resolving each item's value.
 * @param label The string key or mapping function resolving each item's label.
 */
export declare function normalizeSourceItems(source: any[] | Record<string, any>, key: string | ((item: any) => any) | null | undefined, label: string | ((item: any) => any)): {
    value: any;
    label: any;
    $raw: Record<string, any>;
}[];

/**
 * Radio model shape: the `radioValue` prop type, or `null` when unselected.
 */
type RadioModelOf<TRadioValue> = TRadioValue | null;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for radio — `NoInfer` so `modelValue` does not
 * compete with `radioValue` when inferring generics.
 */
type RadioModelProp<TRadioValue> = NoInfer<RadioModelOf<TRadioValue>>;
/**
 * The model value type carried by the radio element's wide props.
 */
type RadioModel = Required<RadioProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Props for the radio element blueprint, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type argument (`radioValue`). Plain usage (`RadioProps`) keeps every member
 * wide, so no separate plain-props alias is needed.
 */
export interface RadioProps<T extends string = 'radio', TRadioValue = any, S = RadioSlots, P = RadioParts, C = RadioClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefault<RadioModelProp<TRadioValue>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, AlignedProps {
    /**
     * The value submitted when this radio is selected. Also drives the model type
     * (as `radioValue | null`). May be an object or array when the radios list is
     * built from complex item values.
     *
     * Includes a naked `boolean` arm alongside `TRadioValue` so the erased schema
     * surface (and blueprint defaults) still accept `true` / `false` literals.
     * Concrete values continue to infer into `TRadioValue`.
     */
    radioValue?: TRadioValue | boolean;
    /**
     * Overrides the HTML `name` attribute for the radio input.
     */
    radioName?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The label text displayed alongside the radio button.
     */
    text?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The alignment of the radio label relative to the radio button.
     */
    align?: 'left' | 'right' | 'auto';
}

import type { LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type DisabledProps, type ModelPropsWithDefault, type BaseElementEmits, type BaseElementProps, type ValidationProps, type ContainerProps, type BaseElementParts, type BaseElementClasses, type BaseElementExpose, type BaseElementSlots, type ItemsProps, type ItemsModelProp, type ItemValueProp, type GroupChildrenProp, type StackedProps, type LayoutProps, type ModelEmits, type InteractionEmits, type ValidationEmits, type AlignedProps, type ItemsProp, type ItemsModelApi } from '../features';

/**
 * Plain props type for the radios element blueprint — the widest instantiation
 * of `RadiosProps`. Use this whenever "the props of a radios" is meant without
 * generic narrowing; it also serves as the constraint for `blueprint` /
 * `RadiosApi` type parameters.

type LooseRadiosProps = RadiosProps<string, ItemsProp, ItemValueProp, GroupChildrenProp>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the radios element blueprint, parameterized by
 * the item-driving type arguments. Reach for `LooseRadiosProps` instead when no
 * narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface RadiosProps<T extends string = 'radios', TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown, S = RadiosSlots, P = RadiosParts, C = RadiosClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ModelPropsWithDefault<ItemsModelProp<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, false, TModel, TItemValueReturn>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, ContainerProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, ItemsProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn, TContext>, StackedProps, AlignedProps {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the radios element.

export interface RadiosEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<any, TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext> {
}

 * Slots available on the radios element blueprint.

/**
 * Factory API produced by the radios blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `RadiosApi<VfRadiosProps<typeof items, 'id'>>`). Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites (Expose / Context
 * layers, extensions).
 */
export type RadiosApi<TProps extends LooseRadiosProps = LooseRadiosProps> = ItemsModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;
/**
 * Builds the radios factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`. Passing `blueprint` as a value lets call-site
 * inference instantiate the API at the SFC's concrete props — the only
 * alternative to a per-blueprint wrapper hosting `typeof blueprint<TProps>`,
 * since conditional-type inference on a captured factory erases its type
 * parameters to constraints (verified empirically).
 */
export declare function blueprint<TProps extends LooseRadiosProps>(props: LooseRequired<TProps>, events: DefineEvents<RadiosEmits>): {
    value: import("vue").WritableComputedRef<import("../features").ModelOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>, import("../features").ModelOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>>;
    label: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | undefined>;
    form$: import("../components/VfForm").VfFormContext<import("../components/VfForm").EntryProps<Record<string, any>>> | undefined;
    register: () => void;
    unregister: (unregisterDataPath?: string) => void;
    name: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<string, string>>;
    id: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    page: import("vue").ComputedRef<import("../types").PageProp | undefined>;
    help: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    description: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    disabled: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    ruleMessages: Record<string, import("vue").ComputedRef<string | undefined>>;
    items: import("vue").Ref<import("../features").ResolvedItem<import("../features").ItemValueOf<(LooseRequired<TProps> extends infer T ? T extends LooseRequired<TProps> ?
