//// blueprints/row.d.ts
import type { BaseComponentEmits, BaseComponentProps, BaseComponentParts, BaseComponentSlots, BaseComponentExpose, BaseComponentClasses, AlignProp, ValignProp, LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type DefineEvents } from '../helpers';
/**
 * Props for the row component blueprint that represents a row within a grid.
 */
export interface RowProps<S = RowSlots, P = RowParts, C = RowClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseComponentProps<S, P, C, TContext> {
    /**
     * The number of grid columns this row spans.
     */
    colspan?: number | string;
    /**
     * The number of grid rows this row spans.
     */
    rowspan?: number | string;
    /**
     * The horizontal alignment of content within the row.
     */
    align?: AlignProp;
    /**
     * The vertical alignment of content within the row.
     */
    valign?: ValignProp;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the row component.
 */
export interface RowEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseComponentEmits<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots of the row component.
 */
export interface RowSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseComponentSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Parts of the row component.
 */
export interface RowParts extends BaseComponentParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes of the row component.
 */
export interface RowClasses extends BaseComponentClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for row-based components.
 */
export interface RowExpose extends BaseComponentExpose, RowApi {
}
/**
 * Factory API produced by the row blueprint's `blueprint` function, optionally
 * parameterized by concrete props. Prefer this over `ReturnType<typeof
 * blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites.
 */
export type RowApi<TProps extends RowProps = RowProps> = ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>;
/**
 * Builds the row factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`.
 */
export declare function blueprint<TProps extends RowProps>(_props: LooseRequired<TProps>, _events: DefineEvents<RowEmits>): {
    uid: number;
    row: import("vue").ComputedRef<number>;
    cols: import("vue").ComputedRef<number[]>;
};
/**
 * Default prop values for the row blueprint.
 *
 * @skipTypeExport
 */
export declare const defaults: {
    readonly align: "left";
    readonly valign: "baseline";
};

//// blueprints/select.d.ts
import type { LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type AriaProps, type DisabledProps, type ModelPropsWithDefault, type AddonsProps, type IconsProps, type BaseElementEmits, type BaseElementProps, type ExpressionProps, type ValidationProps, type BaseElementParts, type BaseElementClasses, type BaseElementSlots, type AddonableProps, type ItemsProps, type ItemsModelProp, type LoadingProps, type PlaceholderProps, type LayoutProps, type InteractionEmits, type InputEmits, type MultipleProps, type ValidationEmits, type ModelEmits, type ItemValueProp, type GroupChildrenProp, type ItemsProp, type BaseElementExpose, type ItemsModelApi } from '../features';
import { type DefineEvents } from '../helpers';
/**
 * Plain props type for the select element blueprint — the widest instantiation
 * of `SelectProps`. Use this whenever "the props of a select" is meant without
 * generic narrowing; it also serves as the constraint for `blueprint` /
 * `SelectApi` type parameters.
 */
type LooseSelectProps = SelectProps<string, ItemsProp, ItemValueProp, GroupChildrenProp, boolean>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the select element blueprint, parameterized by
 * the item-driving type arguments. Reach for `LooseSelectProps` instead when no
 * narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface SelectProps<T extends string = 'select', TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown, S = SelectSlots, P = SelectParts, C = SelectClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefault<ItemsModelProp<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TItemValueReturn>, TContext>, ValidationProps<TContext>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext>, ItemsProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn, TContext>, MultipleProps<TMultiple> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the select element.
 */
export interface SelectEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<any, TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<any, TContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available on the select element blueprint.
 */
export interface SelectSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseElementSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the select element blueprint.
 */
export interface SelectParts extends BaseElementParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the select element blueprint.
 */
export interface SelectClasses extends BaseElementClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for select-based components.
 */
export interface SelectExpose extends BaseElementExpose, SelectApi {
}
/**
 * Factory API produced by the select blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `SelectApi<VfSelectProps<typeof items, 'id'>>`). Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites (Expose / Context
 * layers, extensions).
 */
export type SelectApi<TProps extends LooseSelectProps = LooseSelectProps> = ItemsModelApi<ReturnType<typeof blueprint>, TProps>;
/**
 * Builds the select factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`. Passing `blueprint` as a value lets call-site
 * inference instantiate the API at the SFC's concrete props — the only
 * alternative to a per-blueprint wrapper hosting `typeof blueprint<TProps>`,
 * since conditional-type inference on a captured factory erases its type
 * parameters to constraints (verified empirically).
 */
export declare function blueprint<TProps extends LooseSelectProps>(props: LooseRequired<TProps>, events: DefineEvents<SelectEmits>): {
    value: import("vue").WritableComputedRef<import("../features").ModelOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>, import("../features").ModelOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>>;
    label: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | undefined>;
    form$: import("../components/VfForm").VfFormContext<import("../components/VfForm").EntryProps<Record<string, any>>> | undefined;
    input: import("vue").Ref<any, any>;
    register: () => void;
    unregister: (unregisterDataPath?: string) => void;
    name: Readonly<import("vue").Ref<string, string>>;
    id: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    page: import("vue").ComputedRef<import("../types").PageProp | undefined>;
    help: import("vue").ComputedRef<string>;
    description: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | (string & {}) | undefined>;
    disabled: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    loading: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    ruleMessages: Record<string, import("vue").ComputedRef<string | undefined>>;
    aria: import("vue").ComputedRef<{
        'aria-labelledby'?: string;
        'aria-describedby': string;
        'aria-required': boolean;
        'aria-invalid': boolean;
        'aria-busy': boolean;
    }>;
    items: import("vue").Ref<import("../features").ResolvedItem<import("../features").ItemValueOf<(LooseRequired<TProps> extends infer T ? T extends LooseRequired<TProps> ? T extends import("../features").ItemsGenericsBrand<infer TItems, infer TItemValueKey, infer TGroupChildren, infer TItemValueReturn> ? {
        items: TItems;

//// blueprints/steps.d.ts
import type { BaseComponentEmits, BaseComponentProps, BaseComponentParts, BaseComponentSlots, BaseComponentExpose, BaseComponentClasses, LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type Pager } from '../composables';
import { type DefineEvents } from '../helpers';
/**
 * Props for the steps component blueprint.
 */
export interface StepsProps<S = StepsSlots, P = StepsParts, C = StepsClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseComponentProps<S, P, C, TContext> {
    /**
     * The pager instance managing multi-step form navigation.
     */
    pager: Pager;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the steps component.
 */
export interface StepsEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseComponentEmits<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots of the steps component.
 */
export interface StepsSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseComponentSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Parts of the steps component.
 */
export interface StepsParts extends BaseComponentParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes of the steps component.
 */
export interface StepsClasses extends BaseComponentClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for steps-based components.
 */
export interface StepsExpose extends BaseComponentExpose, StepsApi {
}
/**
 * Factory API produced by the steps blueprint's `blueprint` function,
 * optionally parameterized by concrete props. Prefer this over
 * `ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites.
 */
export type StepsApi<TProps extends StepsProps = StepsProps> = ReturnType<typeof blueprint<TProps>>;
/**
 * Builds the steps container factory API from resolved props and events.
 *
 * SFCs consume it via the shared composable: `useBlueprint(blueprint, props,
 * events, slots, extension?)`.
 */
export declare function blueprint<TProps extends StepsProps>(_props: LooseRequired<TProps>, _events: DefineEvents<StepsEmits>): {};
/**
 * Default prop values for the steps blueprint.
 *
 * @skipTypeExport
 */
export declare const defaults: {};

//// blueprints/text.d.ts
import type { InputTypeProp, LanguagesProp, LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type AriaProps, type ModelPropsWithDefault, type AddonsProps, type IconsProps, type BaseElementEmits, type BaseElementProps, type ExpressionProps, type TranslateProps, type BaseElementParts, type BaseElementClasses, type BaseElementSlots, type BaseElementExpose, type AddonableProps, type TValidationProps, type ReadonlyProps, type DisabledProps, type PlaceholderProps, type LoadingProps, type LayoutProps, type ModelEmits, type TranslateModelProp, type InteractionEmits, type KeyEmits, type InputEmits, type ValidationEmits, type TranslatableModelApi } from '../features';

/**
 * The model value type carried by the text element's wide props.
 */
type TextModel = Required<TextProps>['modelValue'];
/**
 * Props for the text element blueprint, parameterized by the model-driving type
 * arguments (`translate` / `languages`). Plain usage (`TextProps`) keeps every
 * member wide, so no separate plain-props alias is needed.
 */
export interface TextProps<T extends string = 'text', TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, S = TextSlots, P = TextParts, C = TextClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefault<TranslateModelProp<TTranslate, TLanguages>, TContext>, TValidationProps<TContext>, TranslateProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AddonableProps, AriaProps, ReadonlyProps<TContext>, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext> {
    /**
     * The HTML input type (e.g. text, email, password).
     */
    inputType?: InputTypeProp;
    /**
     * The HTML `autocomplete` attribute value for the input.
     */
    autocomplete?: string;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the text element.
 */
export interface TextEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<TextModel, TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, KeyEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<TextModel, TContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available on the text element blueprint.
 */
export interface TextSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseElementSlots<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the text element blueprint.
 */
export interface TextParts extends BaseElementParts {
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the text element blueprint.
 */
export interface TextClasses extends BaseElementClasses {
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for text-based components.
 */
export interface TextExpose extends BaseElementExpose, TextApi {
}
/**
 * Factory API produced by the text blueprint's `blueprint` function, optionally
 * parameterized by concrete props. Prefer this over `ReturnType<typeof
 * blueprint<TProps>>` at consumer sites.
 */

//// blueprints/textarea.d.ts
import type { LanguagesProp, LooseRequired } from '../types';
import { type AriaProps, type ModelPropsWithDefault, type AddonsProps, type IconsProps, type BaseElementEmits, type BaseElementProps, type ExpressionProps, type TranslateProps, type BaseElementParts, type BaseElementClasses, type BaseElementExpose, type BaseElementSlots, type TValidationProps, type ReadonlyProps, type DisabledProps, type LoadingProps, type PlaceholderProps, type LayoutProps, type ModelEmits, type TranslatableModel, type TranslateModelProp, type InteractionEmits, type KeyEmits, type InputEmits, type ValidationEmits, type TranslatableModelApi } from '../features';
import { type DefineEvents } from '../helpers';
/**
 * Props for the textarea element blueprint, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type arguments (`translate` / `languages`). Plain usage (`TextareaProps`)
 * keeps every member wide, so no separate plain-props alias is needed.
 */
export interface TextareaProps<T extends string = 'textarea', TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, S = TextareaSlots, P = TextareaParts, C = TextareaClasses, TContext = any> extends BaseElementProps<T, S, P, C, TContext>, LayoutProps<TContext>, ExpressionProps, ModelPropsWithDefault<TranslateModelProp<TTranslate, TLanguages>, TContext>, TValidationProps<TContext>, TranslateProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>, AddonsProps<TContext>, IconsProps<TContext>, AriaProps, ReadonlyProps<TContext>, DisabledProps<TContext>, LoadingProps<TContext>, PlaceholderProps<TContext> {
    /**
     * The number of visible text rows for the textarea.
     */
    rows?: number;
    /**
     * Whether the textarea automatically grows to fit its content. When true, the
     * height adjusts as lines are added or removed.
     */
    autogrow?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the native browser resize handle is enabled on the textarea.
     */
    resize?: boolean;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the textarea element.
 */
export interface TextareaEmits<TContext = any> extends BaseElementEmits<TContext>, ModelEmits<TranslatableModel, TContext>, ValidationEmits<TContext>, InteractionEmits<TContext>, KeyEmits<TContext>, InputEmits<TranslatableModel, TContext> {
}

 * Slots available on the textarea element blueprint.

export interface TextareaSlots<TContext = any> extends BaseElementSlots<TContext> {
}

export interface TextareaParts extends BaseElementParts {

import type { DefineElementContext, DomAttrsOf, ClassValue, DefineRegistryEntry } from '../../types';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type ButtonApi, type ButtonClasses, type ButtonEmits, type ButtonExpose, type ButtonParts, type ButtonProps, type ButtonSlots } from '../../blueprints/button';
/**
 * Props for the VfButton component.
 *
 * Non-generic — there is no plain-props split because nothing is
 * item-parameterized. The interface itself is the props type.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfButtonProps extends ButtonProps<'button', VfButtonSlots, VfButtonParts, VfButtonClasses, VfButtonContext> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfButton component.
 */
export interface VfButtonEmits extends ButtonEmits<VfButtonContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfButton component.
 */
export interface VfButtonSlots extends ButtonSlots<VfButtonContext> {
    /**
     * Slot for content rendered before the label.
     */
    before: () => VNode[];
    /**
     * Default slot that replaces the button label content.
     *
     * @param props.text The resolved button label text.
     */
    default: (props: {
        text: string | undefined;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot for content rendered after the label.
     */
    after: () => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfButton component.
 */
export interface VfButtonParts extends ButtonParts {
    /**
     * The root button or anchor element.
     *
     * @tag button | a
     */
    button: DomAttrsOf<'button' | 'a'>;
    /**
     * The icon of the button.
     *
     * @tag i
     */
    icon: DomAttrsOf<'i'>;
    /**
     * The text of the button.
     *
     * @tag span
     */
    text: DomAttrsOf<'span'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfButton component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfButtonClasses extends ButtonClasses {
    /**
     * The root button or anchor element.
     */
    button: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The button label text element.
     */
    text: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The button icon element.
     */
    icon: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfButton.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `ButtonExpose` for all button-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfButton'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfButtonExpose extends ButtonExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfButton.
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 *
 * Non-generic: no `TProps` parameter — the api has nothing to narrow from
 * props, so the context is a fixed `DefineElementContext` instantiation.
 */
export interface VfButtonContext extends DefineElementContext<VfButtonProps, VfButtonEmits, VfButtonSlots, VfButtonParts, VfButtonClasses, VfButtonExpose, ButtonApi> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfButton. `TEntry` is accepted for registry uniformity but
 * does not narrow anything — VfButton has no prop-driven generics.
 */
export interface VfButtonEntry<_TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<VfButtonProps, VfButtonEmits, VfButtonSlots, VfButtonParts, VfButtonClasses, VfButtonContext> {

import type { WidenProps, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, AriaProp, ClassValue, DomAttrsOf, EntryPropOr } from '../../types';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type CheckboxApi, type CheckboxClasses, type CheckboxEmits, type CheckboxExpose, type CheckboxParts, type CheckboxProps, type CheckboxSlots } from '../../blueprints/checkbox';
/**
 * VfCheckbox props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the
 * entry's `trueValue` / `falseValue` props as generics.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfCheckboxProps<EntryPropOr<TEntry, 'trueValue', true>, EntryPropOr<TEntry, 'falseValue', false>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfCheckbox component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type arguments (e.g. `VfCheckboxProps<1, 0>`). Reach for
 * `VfCheckboxProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfCheckboxProps<TTrueValue = any, TFalseValue = any> extends CheckboxProps<'checkbox', TTrueValue, TFalseValue, VfCheckboxSlots<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>, VfCheckboxParts, VfCheckboxClasses, VfCheckboxContext<VfCheckboxProps<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfCheckbox component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the
 * narrowed context — same pattern as `VfCheckboxSlots`. Plain usage
 * (`VfCheckboxEmits`) keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxEmits<TTrueValue = any, TFalseValue = any> extends CheckboxEmits<VfCheckboxContext<VfCheckboxProps<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfCheckbox component.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxSlots<TTrueValue = any, TFalseValue = any> extends CheckboxSlots<VfCheckboxContext<VfCheckboxProps<TTrueValue, TFalseValue>>> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the default checkbox rendering. Receives input-specific
     * props.
     */
    default: (props: {
        model: TTrueValue | TFalseValue;
        trueValue: TTrueValue;
        falseValue: TFalseValue;
        inputName: string;
        id: string;
        disabled: boolean;

        handleFocus: (e: FocusEvent) => void;
        handleModelUpdate: (e: Event) => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**

     */
    text: (props: {
        text: string | undefined;

        genericName: string;
    }) => VNode[];

/**
 * Structural parts of the VfCheckbox component.

/**
 * Public context for VfCheckbox, optionally parameterized by concrete props
 * (e.g. `VfCheckboxContext<VfCheckboxProps<1, 0>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →

import type { VfCheckboxSlots } from '../VfCheckbox/types';
import type { ResolvedGroup, ResolvedItem, ItemsProp, ItemValueProp, GroupChildrenProp, ItemValueOf, RawItemOf, EntryItemsOf, EntryItemValueKeyOf, EntryItemValueReturnOf, EntryGroupChildrenOf } from '../../features';
import type { WidenProps, ClassValue, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, DomAttrsOf, PartOf } from '../../types';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';

/**
 * VfCheckboxes props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the
 * entry's `items` / `itemValue` / `groupChildren` props as generics.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfCheckboxesProps<EntryItemsOf<TEntry>, EntryItemValueKeyOf<TEntry>, EntryGroupChildrenOf<TEntry>, any, EntryItemValueReturnOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfCheckboxes component, parameterized by the
 * item-driving type arguments (e.g. `VfCheckboxesProps<typeof items, 'id'>`).
 * Reach for `VfCheckboxesProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxesProps<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> extends CheckboxesProps<'checkboxes', TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn, VfCheckboxesSlots<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn>, VfCheckboxesParts, VfCheckboxesClasses, VfCheckboxesContext<VfCheckboxesProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfCheckboxes component, parameterized by the
 * item-driving type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the
 * narrowed context — same pattern as `VfCheckboxesSlots`. Plain usage
 * (`VfCheckboxesEmits`) keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxesEmits<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> extends CheckboxesEmits<VfCheckboxesContext<VfCheckboxesProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfCheckboxes component.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxesSlots<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> extends CheckboxesSlots<VfCheckboxesContext<VfCheckboxesProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn>>> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the default checkboxes rendering.
     *
     * @param props.checkboxName The shared checkbox name attribute.
     * @param props.disabled Whether the checkboxes are disabled.
     * @param props.label The element's resolved label.
     * @param props.items Resolved flat checkbox items.
     * @param props.groups Resolved checkbox groups.
     * @param props.grouped Whether items are rendered as groups.
     */
    default: (props: {
        checkboxName: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        label: string | undefined;
        items: ResolvedItem<ItemValueOf<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn>, RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>>[];
        groups: ResolvedGroup<ItemValueOf<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn>, RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>>[];
        grouped: boolean;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each option group when items are grouped.
     *
     * @param props.checkboxName The shared checkbox name attribute.
     * @param props.disabled Whether the checkboxes are disabled.
     * @param props.label The element's resolved label.
     * @param props.group The resolved option group.
     */
    group: (props: {
        checkboxName: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        label: string | undefined;
        group: ResolvedGroup<ItemValueOf<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn>, RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>>;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each entire `VfCheckbox` child.
     *
     * @param props.checkboxName The shared checkbox name attribute.
     * @param props.disabled Whether the checkboxes are disabled.
     * @param props.label The element's resolved label.
     * @param props.item The resolved checkbox item.
     */
    item: (props: {
        checkboxName: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        label: string | undefined;
        item: ResolvedItem<ItemValueOf<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn>, RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>>;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual checkbox input rendering.
     *
     * Child checkboxes always use the default `true` / `false` values; the
     * holder's item value is resolved by name, not passed as `trueValue`.
     *
     * @inherits VfCheckbox.default
     */
    checkbox: (props: Parameters<VfCheckboxSlots<true, false>['default']>[0]) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the text/label of each individual checkbox.
     *
     * @inherits VfCheckbox.text
     */
    text: (props: Parameters<VfCheckboxSlots['text']>[0]) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfCheckboxes component.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxesParts extends CheckboxesParts {
    /**
     * The wrapper element containing all checkbox items.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    group: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The fieldset element wrapping each group when items are grouped.
     *
     * @param group The group data.
     * @tag fieldset
     */
    fieldset: (group: Record<string, any>) => DomAttrsOf<'fieldset'>;
    /**
     * The legend element displaying the group label.
     *
     * @param group The group data.
     * @tag legend
     */
    legend: (group: Record<string, any>) => DomAttrsOf<'legend'>;
    /**
     * Props factory for each VfCheckbox child component, receiving the item data.
     *
     * @param items The checkbox item data.
     * @tag VfCheckbox
     */
    item: (items: Record<string, any>) => PartOf<'VfCheckbox'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfCheckboxes component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfCheckboxesClasses extends CheckboxesClasses {
    /**
     * The wrapper element containing all checkbox items.
     */
    group: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfCheckboxes.

export interface VfCheckboxesExpose extends CheckboxesExpose {
}
/**

 * (e.g. `VfCheckboxesContext<VfCheckboxesProps<typeof items, 'id'>>`).

 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →

}

import type { AddonsSlots, IconsClasses, IconsParts, IconsSlots, TranslateSlots, AddonsParts, TranslateParts, AddonGroupClasses, EntryTranslateOf, EntryLanguagesOf } from '../../features';
import type { WidenProps, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, DomAttrsOf, EntryPropOr, LanguagesProp } from '../../types';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type FieldApi, type FieldClasses, type FieldEmits, type FieldExpose, type FieldParts, type FieldProps, type FieldSlots } from '../../blueprints/field';
/**
 * `TNullValue` fallback for a registry `TEntry` payload without a `nullValue`
 * prop: the text scalar when the entry translates (each language's entry),
 * `any` otherwise — an undeclared model shape stays unconstrained. Mirrors the
 * SFC's generic default.
 */
export type EntryNullValueOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOr<TEntry, 'nullValue', [
    EntryTranslateOf<TEntry>
] extends [true] ? string | number | null : any>;
/**
 * VfField props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the entry's
 * `translate` / `languages` / `nullValue` props as generics.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfFieldProps<EntryTranslateOf<TEntry>, EntryLanguagesOf<TEntry>, EntryNullValueOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfField component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type arguments (e.g. `VfFieldProps<true, typeof languages>` /
 * `VfFieldProps<false, LanguagesProp, 0>`). `nullValue` types one value: the
 * model when `translate` is false, each language's entry when it is true. Reach
 * for `VfFieldProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfFieldProps<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, TNullValue = any> extends FieldProps<'field', TTranslate, TLanguages, TNullValue, VfFieldSlots<TTranslate, TLanguages, TNullValue>, VfFieldParts, VfFieldClasses, VfFieldContext<VfFieldProps<TTranslate, TLanguages, TNullValue>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfField component, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the narrowed
 * context — same pattern as `VfFieldSlots`. Plain usage (`VfFieldEmits`) keeps
 * the context wide.
 */
export interface VfFieldEmits<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, TNullValue = any> extends FieldEmits<VfFieldContext<VfFieldProps<TTranslate, TLanguages, TNullValue>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfField component.
 */
export interface VfFieldSlots<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, TNullValue = any> extends FieldSlots<VfFieldContext<VfFieldProps<TTranslate, TLanguages, TNullValue>>>, AddonsSlots, IconsSlots, TranslateSlots {
    /**
     * Default slot where the user renders their 3rd party component. Receives the
     * full component context.

     */
    default: (props: {
        context: VfFieldContext<VfFieldProps<TTranslate, TLanguages, TNullValue>>;

/**
 * Public context for VfField, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfFieldContext<VfFieldProps<true, typeof languages>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).

export interface VfFieldContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfFieldProps, FieldProps> = VfFieldProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfFieldEmits, VfFieldSlots, VfFieldParts, VfFieldClasses, VfFieldExpose, FieldApi<TProps>> {

     * @param props.fileName The display name of the file.
     * @param props.url The URL of the file, if available.
     * @param props.index The index of the file in the list.
     * @param props.removable Whether the file can be removed.
     * @param props.disabled Whether the element is disabled.
     * @param props.type The kind of value: `'file'`, `'string'`, or `'object'`.
     * @param props.remove Callback to remove a file by index.
     */
    file: (props: {
        value: FileProp;
        fileName: string;
        url?: string;
        index: number;
        removable: boolean;
        disabled: boolean;
        type: 'file' | 'string' | 'object';
        remove: (index: number) => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the remove button for a file item.
     *
     * @param props.index The index of the file in the list.
     * @param props.disabled Whether the element is disabled.
     * @param props.remove Callback to remove a file by index.
     */
    remove: (props: {
        index: number;
        disabled: boolean;
        remove: (index: number) => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the file name display for a file item.
     *
     * @param props.value The raw model value of the file item.
     * @param props.fileName The display name of the file.
     * @param props.url The URL of the file, if available.
     * @param props.type The kind of value: `'file'`, `'string'`, or `'object'`.
     */
    name: (props: {
        value: FileProp;
        fileName: string;
        url?: string;
        type: 'file' | 'string' | 'object';
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the file selection button and hidden input.
     *
     * @param props.triggerFileInput Callback to open the native file picker.
     * @param props.disabled Whether the element is disabled.
     * @param props.text The resolved button label text.
     */
    add: (props: {
        triggerFileInput: () => void;
        disabled: boolean;
        text?: string;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfFile component.
 */
export interface VfFileParts extends FileParts {
    /**
     * The container for the list of uploaded files.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    list: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * An individual file entry in the file list.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    item: (file: FileListItem, index: number) => DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The file name text or link.
     *
     * @tag a | span
     */
    name: (file: FileListItem, index: number) => DomAttrsOf<'a' | 'span'>;
    /**
     * The remove button for a file entry.
     *
     * @tag VfButton
     */
    remove: (file: FileListItem, index: number) => PartOf<'VfButton'>;
    /**
     * The add button.
     *
     * @tag VfButton
     */
    add: PartOf<'VfButton'>;
    /**
     * The file input element.
     *
     * @tag input
     */
    input: DomAttrsOf<'input'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfFile component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfFileClasses extends FileClasses {
    /**
     * The container for the list of uploaded files.
     */
    list: ClassValue;
    /**
     * An individual file entry in the file list.
     */
    item: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The file name text or link.
     */
    name: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The remove button for a file entry.
     */
    remove: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfFile.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `FileExpose` for all file-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfFile'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfFileExpose extends FileExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfFile, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfFileContext<VfFileProps<true>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfFileContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfFileProps, FileProps> = VfFileProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfFileEmits, VfFileSlots, VfFileParts, VfFileClasses, VfFileExpose, FileApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfFile. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context by
 * the entry's model-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfFileEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfFileEmits<EntryMultipleOf<TEntry>>, VfFileSlots, VfFileParts, VfFileClasses, VfFileContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

import type { FormApi, FormProps, FormEmits, FormParts, FormSlots, FormExpose, FormClasses } from '../../blueprints/form';

import type { Pager } from '../../composables';
import type { TabbedSlots } from '../../features';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type DefineElementContext, type DefineRegistryEntry, type WidenProps, type FormSchema, type LanguagesProp, type PartOf, type SlotPropsOf, type ClassValue, type DomAttrsOf, type TProp, type ResolvedSchema, type EntrySchemaOf } from '../../types';
/**
 * VfForm props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the entry's
 * `schema` prop (unwrapping a possible `Ref`) as the `TSchema` generic.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfFormProps<EntrySchemaOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Props for the VfForm component, optionally parameterized by a concrete schema
 * type (e.g. `VfFormProps<typeof schema>` with a `defineSchema` result).
 * `TSchema` drives the typed schema API on the form context (`find` / `get` /
 * `set` / `model` / `payload` / `update`). Reach for `VfFormProps` instead when
 * no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfFormProps<TSchema = FormSchema> extends FormProps<VfFormSlots<TSchema>, VfFormParts, VfFormClasses, VfFormContext<VfFormProps<TSchema>>, TSchema> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfForm component, parameterized by the schema type so
 * event handlers (e.g. `@submit`) receive the schema-narrowed context — same
 * pattern as element emits. Plain usage (`VfFormEmits`) keeps the context
 * wide.
 */
export interface VfFormEmits<TSchema = FormSchema> extends FormEmits<VfFormContext<VfFormProps<TSchema>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfForm component, parameterized by the schema type so
 * context-receiving slots (e.g. `#content`) get the schema-narrowed context.
 * Plain usage (`VfFormSlots`) keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfFormSlots<TSchema = FormSchema> extends FormSlots<VfFormContext<VfFormProps<TSchema>>>, TabbedSlots {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the entire form content area. Receives the form's
     * context as a single `context` prop, like the `template` slot.
     *
     * @param props.context The component's context.
     * @context
     */
    content: (props: {
        context: VfFormContext<VfFormProps<TSchema>>;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the language selector. Receives available languages and
     * select handler.
     */
    languages: (props: {
        invalidLanguages: Set<string>;
        languages: LanguagesProp;
        language: string;
        select: (language: string) => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual language option.
     *
     * @inherits VfLanguages.default
     */
    language: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfLanguages', 'default'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the steps navigation bar. Receives the pager instance.
     */
    steps: (props: {
        pager: Pager;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual step indicator.
     *
     * @inherits VfSteps.default
     */
    step: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfSteps', 'default'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the tabs navigation bar. Receives the pager instance.
     */
    tabs: (props: {
        pager: Pager;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual tab.
     *
     * @inherits VfTabs.default
     */
    tab: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfTabs', 'default'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the form-level errors container.
     */
    errors: (props: {
        errors: Record<string, string[]>;
        id: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual error message.
     */
    error: (props: {
        error: string;
        path: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the form-level messages container.
     */
    messages: (props: {
        messages?: string[];
        id: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual message.
     */
    message: (props: {
        message: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the form elements area. Receives the resolved schema.
     */
    elements: (props: {
        resolvedSchema: ResolvedSchema;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot for the default form body content. Receives the resolved schema.
     */
    default: (props: {
        resolvedSchema: ResolvedSchema;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the navigation bar. Receives pager, button labels, and
     * visibility.
     */
    nav: (props: {
        pager: Pager;
        next?: TProp;
        back?: TProp;
        finish?: TProp;
        hideBack?: boolean;
        position?: NavPosProp;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the back button in the navigation bar.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.back
     */
    back: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'back'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the back button's text label.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.backText
     */
    backText: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'backText'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the next button in the navigation bar.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.next
     */
    next: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'next'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the next button's text label.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.nextText
     */
    nextText: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'nextText'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the finish button in the navigation bar.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.finish
     */
    finish: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'finish'>) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the finish button's text label.
     *
     * @inherits VfNav.finishText
     */
    finishText: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfNav', 'finishText'>) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfForm component.
 */
export interface VfFormParts extends FormParts {
    /**
     * The root form element.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    root: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested VfLanguages component.
     *
     * @tag VfLanguages
     */
    languages: PartOf<'VfLanguages'>;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested VfTabs component.
     *
     * @tag VfTabs
     */
    tabs: PartOf<'VfTabs'>;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested VfSteps component.
     *
     * @tag VfSteps
     */
    steps: PartOf<'VfSteps'>;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested VfElements component.
     *
     * @tag VfElements
     */
    elements: PartOf<'VfElements'>;
    /**
     * The errors container element.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    errorsWrapper: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The error list element.
     *
     * @tag ul
     */
    errors: DomAttrsOf<'ul'>;
    /**
     * Each error item element.
     *
     * @tag li
     */
    error: DomAttrsOf<'li'>;
    /**
     * The messages container element.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    messagesWrapper: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The message list element.
     *
     * @tag ul
     */
    messages: DomAttrsOf<'ul'>;
    /**
     * Each message item element.
     *
     * @tag li
     */
    message: DomAttrsOf<'li'>;
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested VfNav component.
     *
     * @tag VfNav
     */
    nav: PartOf<'VfNav'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfForm component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfFormClasses extends FormClasses {
    /**
     * The root form element.
     */
    root: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The errors container element.
     */
    errorsWrapper: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The error list element.
     */
    errors: ClassValue;
    /**
     * Each error item element.
     */
    error: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The messages container element.
     */
    messagesWrapper: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The message list element.
     */
    messages: ClassValue;
    /**
     * Each message item element.
     */
    message: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfForm.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `FormExpose` for all form-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfForm'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfFormExpose extends FormExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfForm, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfFormContext<VfFormProps<typeof schema>>`) so the schema API slice (`find`
 * / `get` / `set` / `model` / `payload` / `update`) narrows to the schema
 * carried by the `schema` prop.
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfFormContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfFormProps, FormProps<FormSlots, FormParts, FormClasses, any, any>> = VfFormProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfFormEmits, VfFormSlots, VfFormParts, VfFormClasses, VfFormExpose, FormApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfForm. `TEntry` narrows the schema API slice of the
 * context by the entry's `schema` prop, the same way the SFC generic does.
 */
export interface VfFormEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfFormEmits<EntrySchemaOf<TEntry>>, VfFormSlots, VfFormParts, VfFormClasses, VfFormContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

//// components/VfGrid/types.d.ts
import type { GridApi, GridClasses, GridEmits, GridExpose, GridParts, GridProps, GridSlots, GridCell } from '../../blueprints/grid';
import type { ObjectModel } from '../../features';
import type { DefineElementContext, ClassValue, AlignProp, ValignProp, DomAttrsOf, DefineRegistryEntry, EntryPropOf, GridToSchema, IsAny, SchemaToModel, WidenProps } from '../../types';
import type { Ref, VNode } from 'vue';
/**
 * Resolves the `grid` schema from a registry `TEntry` payload (unwrapping a
 * possible `Ref`), falling back to `undefined` when absent.
 */
export type EntryGridOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'grid'> extends infer G ? G extends Ref<infer V> ? V : G : undefined;
/**
 * Grids carry a model shaped by their named cell elements regardless of
 * `nested`: nested grids store it under their own key, non-nested grids bind
 * the same shape as a scoped projection of the parent's level. Wide / `any`
 * entries and grids without a `grid` schema stay permissive (`ObjectModel`).
 */
export type GridModelOf<TEntry> = IsAny<EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'nested'>> extends true ? ObjectModel : EntryGridOf<TEntry> extends infer G ? [G] extends [undefined] ? ObjectModel : SchemaToModel<GridToSchema<G>> : ObjectModel;
/**
 * VfGrid props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload — `modelValue` is
 * driven by `grid` the same way select models are driven by `items`. Feeds both
 * `defineSchema` validation and the narrowed `VfGridContext` / `GridApi` model
 * slice used by `find()`.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = Omit<VfGridProps, 'modelValue'> & {
    modelValue?: GridModelOf<TEntry>;
};
/**
 * Props for the VfGrid component.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfGridProps extends GridProps<'grid', VfGridSlots, VfGridParts, VfGridClasses, VfGridContext> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfGrid component.
 */
export interface VfGridEmits extends GridEmits<VfGridContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfGrid component.
 */
export interface VfGridSlots extends GridSlots<VfGridContext> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the default grid content. Receives the resolved grid
     * cells.
     */
    default: (props: {
        cells: GridCell[];
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual grid cell rendering.
     */
    cell: (props: {
        cell: GridCell;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfGrid component.
 */
export interface VfGridParts extends GridParts {
    /**
     * The grid layout element.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    grid: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * Each cell element. Receives alignment, schema, and header options.
     *
     * @param options Alignment, optional schema, and header flags for this cell.
     * @tag div
     */
    cell: (options: {
        align: AlignProp;
        valign: ValignProp;
        schema?: any;
        colHeader?: boolean;
        rowHeader?: boolean;
    }) => DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfGrid component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfGridClasses extends GridClasses {
    /**
     * The grid wrapper element.
     */
    wrapper: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The grid layout element.
     */
    grid: ClassValue;
    /**
     * Each cell element. Receives alignment, schema, and header options.
     *
     * @param options Alignment, optional schema, and header flags for this cell.
     */
    cell: (options: {
        align: AlignProp;
        valign: ValignProp;
        schema?: any;
        colHeader?: boolean;
        rowHeader?: boolean;
    }) => ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfGrid.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `GridExpose` for all grid-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfGrid'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfGridExpose extends GridExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfGrid, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * grid-schema-narrowed `EntryProps` with a typed `modelValue`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfGridContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfGridProps, GridProps<string>> = VfGridProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfGridEmits, VfGridSlots, VfGridParts, VfGridClasses, VfGridExpose, GridApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfGrid. `TEntry` narrows `modelValue` from the entry's
 * `grid` schema so `defineSchema` constrains grid models to their named cell
 * elements (nested and non-nested alike) and types `find()`'s returned `model`
 * the same way.
 */
export interface VfGridEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfGridEmits, VfGridSlots, VfGridParts, VfGridClasses, VfGridContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

    interface VfGroupProps extends PartProps<VfGroupParts, VfGroupContext>, ClassProps<VfGroupClasses, VfGroupContext>, ReclassProps<VfGroupClasses, VfGroupContext> {
    }

//// components/VfGroup/types.d.ts
import type { ObjectModel } from '../../features';
import type { ClassValue, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, DomAttrsOf, EntryPropOf, IsAny, SchemaToModel, WidenProps, ResolvedSchema, EntrySchemaOf } from '../../types';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type GroupApi, type GroupClasses, type GroupEmits, type GroupExpose, type GroupParts, type GroupProps, type GroupSlots } from '../../blueprints/group';
/**
 * Groups carry a model shaped by their child schema regardless of `nested`:
 * nested groups store it under their own key, non-nested groups bind the same
 * shape as a scoped projection of the parent's level (`SchemaToModel` flattens
 * non-nested descendants the same way the runtime projection does). Wide /
 * `any` entries stay permissive (`ObjectModel`).
 */
export type GroupModelOf<TEntry> = IsAny<EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'nested'>> extends true ? ObjectModel : SchemaToModel<EntrySchemaOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * VfGroup props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload — `modelValue` is
 * driven by `schema` the same way select models are driven by `items`. Feeds
 * both `defineSchema` validation and the narrowed `VfGroupContext` / `GroupApi`
 * model slice used by `find()`.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = Omit<VfGroupProps, 'modelValue'> & {
    modelValue?: GroupModelOf<TEntry>;
};
/**
 * Props for the VfGroup component.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfGroupProps extends GroupProps<'group', VfGroupSlots, VfGroupParts, VfGroupClasses, VfGroupContext> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfGroup component.
 */
export interface VfGroupEmits extends GroupEmits<VfGroupContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfGroup component.
 */
export interface VfGroupSlots extends GroupSlots<VfGroupContext> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the wrapper element. Receives the wrapper class and
     * resolved schema.
     */
    wrapper: (props: {
        class: ClassValue;
        resolvedSchema: ResolvedSchema;
        label?: string;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the default content. Receives the resolved schema for
     * rendering children.
     */
    default: (props: {
        resolvedSchema: ResolvedSchema;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfGroup component.
 */
export interface VfGroupParts extends GroupParts {
    /**
     * The wrapper element containing child elements.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    wrapper: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfGroup component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfGroupClasses extends GroupClasses {
    /**
     * The wrapper element containing child elements.
     */
    wrapper: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfGroup.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `GroupExpose` for all group-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfGroup'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfGroupExpose extends GroupExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfGroup, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * schema-narrowed `EntryProps` with a typed `modelValue`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfGroupContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfGroupProps, GroupProps<string>> = VfGroupProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfGroupEmits, VfGroupSlots, VfGroupParts, VfGroupClasses, VfGroupExpose, GroupApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfGroup. `TEntry` narrows `modelValue` from the entry's
 * `schema` prop so `defineSchema` constrains group models to their child schema
 * shape (nested and non-nested alike) and types `find()`'s returned `model` the
 * same way.
 */
export interface VfGroupEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfGroupEmits, VfGroupSlots, VfGroupParts, VfGroupClasses, VfGroupContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

        VfGroup: VfGroupEntry<TEntry>;
    }
}

    }
}

//// components/VfList/types.d.ts
import type { ListApi, ListClasses, ListEmits, ListExpose, ListParts, ListProps, ListSlots } from '../../blueprints/list';
import type { ArrayModel } from '../../features';
import type { DefineElementContext, ClassValue, DomAttrsOf, ElementName, EntryPropOf, FlattenedListModel, IsAny, PartOf, DefineRegistryEntry, SchemaToModel, WidenProps, EntrySchemaOf } from '../../types';
import type { Component, VNode } from 'vue';
/**
 * Lists carry a rows-array model shaped by their child schema and `flat` prop:
 * `flat: true` lists (single-element schema) flatten each row to that element's
 * model, regular lists carry one object per row. Wide / `any` entries stay
 * permissive (`ArrayModel`).
 */
export type ListModelOf<TEntry> = IsAny<EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'flat'>> extends true ? ArrayModel : EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'flat'> extends true ? FlattenedListModel<EntrySchemaOf<TEntry>>[] : SchemaToModel<EntrySchemaOf<TEntry>>[];
/**
 * VfList props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload — `modelValue` is
 * driven by `schema` + `flat` the same way select models are driven by `items`.
 * Feeds both `defineSchema` validation and the narrowed `VfListContext` /
 * `ListApi` model slice used by `find()`.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = Omit<VfListProps, 'modelValue'> & {
    modelValue?: ListModelOf<TEntry>;
};
/**
 * Props for the VfList component.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfListProps extends ListProps<'list', VfListSlots, VfListParts, VfListClasses, VfListContext> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfList component.
 */
export interface VfListEmits extends ListEmits<VfListContext> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfList component.
 */
export interface VfListSlots extends ListSlots<VfListContext> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each list item wrapper. Receives drag state and event
     * handlers.
     *
     * @param props.class CSS classes for the item wrapper.
     * @param props.index The item's index.
     * @param props.beingDragged Whether this item is currently being dragged.
     * @param props.isDropTarget Whether this item is the current drop target.
     * @param props.handleDragEnter Handler for the drag enter event.
     * @param props.handleDragStart Handler for the drag start event.
     * @param props.handleDragEnd Handler for the drag end event.
     * @param props.handleRemove Handler to remove this list item.
     */
    item: (props: {
        class: ClassValue;
        index: number;
        beingDragged: boolean;
        isDropTarget: boolean;
        handleDragEnter: ($event: DragEvent) => void;
        handleDragStart: ($event: DragEvent) => void;
        handleDragEnd: () => void;
        handleRemove: () => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the drag handle. Receives class and drag event handlers.
     *
     * @param props.class CSS classes for the handle element.
     * @param props.handleDragStart Handler for the drag start event.
     * @param props.handleDragEnd Handler for the drag end event.
     */
    sort: (props: {
        class: ClassValue;
        handleDragStart: ($event: DragEvent) => void;
        handleDragEnd: () => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the default element content within each list item.
     *
     * @param props.component The component name for the list item element.
     * @param props.props The props passed to the list item element.
     * @param props.index The element name/index for this item.
     */
    default: (props: {
        component?: string | Component;
        props: Record<string, any>;
        index: ElementName;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the remove button. Receives class and remove handler.
     *
     * @param props.class CSS classes for the remove button.
     * @param props.handleRemove Handler to remove this list item.
     */
    remove: (props: {
        class: ClassValue;
        handleRemove: () => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the placeholder element when the list is empty.
     *
     * @param props.class CSS classes for the placeholder element.
     */
    placeholder: (props: {
        class: ClassValue;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the add button. Receives class, add handler, and label.
     *
     * @param props.class CSS classes for the add button.
     * @param props.handleAdd Handler to add a new list item.
     * @param props.label The button label text.
     */
    add: (props: {
        class: ClassValue;
        handleAdd: () => void;
        label: any;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfList component.

export interface VfListParts extends ListParts {

     * The items container element.

     * @tag div

    items: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * Each list item wrapper. Receives drag state.
     *
     * @param beingDragged Whether this item is currently being dragged.
     * @param isDropTarget Whether this item is the current drop target.
     * @tag div
     */
    item: (beingDragged: boolean, isDropTarget: boolean) => DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The element wrapper within each list item.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    element: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The drag handle element.
     *
     * @tag VfButton
     */
    sort: PartOf<'VfButton'>;
    /**
     * The remove action element.
     *
     * @tag VfButton
     */
    remove: PartOf<'VfButton'>;
    /**
     * The placeholder element displayed when the list is empty.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    placeholder: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The add action element.
     *
     * @tag VfButton
     */
    add: PartOf<'VfButton'>;
}

     *
     * @param beingDragged Whether this item is currently being dragged.
     * @param isDropTarget Whether this item is the current drop target.

    item: (beingDragged: boolean, isDropTarget: boolean) => ClassValue;

    element: ClassValue;
    /**

/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfList.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `ListExpose` for all list-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfList'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.

export interface VfListExpose extends ListExpose {

/**
 * Public context for VfList, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * schema-narrowed `EntryProps` with a typed `modelValue`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfListContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfListProps, ListProps<string>> = VfListProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfListEmits, VfListSlots, VfListParts, VfListClasses, VfListExpose, ListApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfList. `TEntry` narrows `modelValue` from the entry's
 * `schema` + `flat` props so `defineSchema` constrains list models (and
 * `default`s) to their row shape and types `find()`'s returned `model` the same
 * way.
 */
export interface VfListEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfListEmits, VfListSlots, VfListParts, VfListClasses, VfListContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

 * runtime resolution.

        handleRemove: () => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the row remove button.

     * @param props.class CSS classes for the remove button.

        class: ClassValue;
        handleRemove: () => void;
    }) => VNode[];

     * @param props.class CSS classes for the add button.
     * @param props.label The button label text.
     * @param props.handleAdd Handler to add a new row.
     */
    add: (props: {
        class: ClassValue;
        label: TProp | string;
        handleAdd: () => void;
    }) => VNode[];
}

//// components/VfRadio/types.d.ts
import type { WidenProps, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, AriaProp, ClassValue, DomAttrsOf, EntryPropOr } from '../../types';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type RadioApi, type RadioClasses, type RadioEmits, type RadioExpose, type RadioParts, type RadioProps, type RadioSlots } from '../../blueprints/radio';
/**
 * VfRadio props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the entry's
 * `radioValue` prop as a generic.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfRadioProps<EntryPropOr<TEntry, 'radioValue', true>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfRadio component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type argument (e.g. `VfRadioProps<'a'>`). Reach for
 * `VfRadioProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfRadioProps<TRadioValue = any> extends RadioProps<'radio', TRadioValue, VfRadioSlots<TRadioValue>, VfRadioParts, VfRadioClasses, VfRadioContext<VfRadioProps<TRadioValue>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfRadio component, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type argument so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the narrowed context
 * — same pattern as `VfRadioSlots`. Plain usage (`VfRadioEmits`) keeps the
 * context wide.
 */
export interface VfRadioEmits<TRadioValue = any> extends RadioEmits<VfRadioContext<VfRadioProps<TRadioValue>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfRadio component.
 */
export interface VfRadioSlots<TRadioValue = any> extends RadioSlots<VfRadioContext<VfRadioProps<TRadioValue>>> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the default radio input rendering. Receives
     * input-specific props.
     */
    default: (props: {
        value: TRadioValue;
        model: TRadioValue | null;
        aria: AriaProp;
        inputName: string;
        id: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        input: any;
        text: string | undefined;
        handleBlur: (e: FocusEvent) => void;
        handleFocus: (e: FocusEvent) => void;
        handleModelUpdate: (e: Event) => void;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the text/label portion of the radio.
     */
    text: (props: {
        text: string | undefined;
        id: string;
        genericName: string;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfRadio component.
 */
export interface VfRadioParts extends RadioParts {
    /**
     * The wrapper element surrounding the input and text.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    wrapper: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The radio input element.
     *
     * @tag input
     */
    input: DomAttrsOf<'input'>;
    /**
     * The label/text element.
     *
     * @tag label
     */
    text: DomAttrsOf<'label'>;
    /**
     * The screen-reader-only text element.
     *
     * @tag label
     */
    srOnlyText: DomAttrsOf<'label'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfRadio component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfRadioClasses extends RadioClasses {
    /**
     * The wrapper element surrounding the input and text.
     */
    wrapper: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The radio input element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
    /**
     * The label/text element.
     */
    text: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfRadio.
 *
 * Plugins that add runtime API members should declaration-merge the same
 * members here (or on `RadioExpose` for all radio-based components) so they
 * appear on `ContextOf<'VfRadio'>` / `context$` / `defineExpose`.
 */
export interface VfRadioExpose extends RadioExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfRadio, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfRadioContext<VfRadioProps<'a'>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfRadioContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfRadioProps, RadioProps> = VfRadioProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfRadioEmits, VfRadioSlots, VfRadioParts, VfRadioClasses, VfRadioExpose, RadioApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfRadio. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context by
 * the entry's model-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfRadioEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfRadioEmits<EntryPropOr<TEntry, 'radioValue', true>>, VfRadioSlots, VfRadioParts, VfRadioClasses, VfRadioContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

import type { GroupChildrenProp, ItemValueProp, ItemsProp } from '../../features';

declare module './types' {
    interface VfRadiosProps<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> extends PartProps<VfRadiosParts, VfRadiosContext>, ClassProps<VfRadiosClasses, VfRadiosContext>, ReclassProps<VfRadiosClasses, VfRadiosContext> {
    }

//// components/VfRadios/types.d.ts
import type { VfRadioSlots } from '../VfRadio/types';
import type { ResolvedGroup, ResolvedItem, ItemsProp, ItemValueProp, GroupChildrenProp, ItemValueOf, RawItemOf, EntryItemsOf, EntryItemValueKeyOf, EntryItemValueReturnOf, EntryGroupChildrenOf } from '../../features';
import type { WidenProps, ClassValue, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, DomAttrsOf, PartOf } from '../../types';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type RadiosApi, type RadiosClasses, type RadiosEmits, type RadiosExpose, type RadiosParts, type RadiosProps, type RadiosSlots } from '../../blueprints/radios';
/**
 * VfRadios props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the
 * entry's `items` / `itemValue` / `groupChildren` props as generics.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfRadiosProps<EntryItemsOf<TEntry>, EntryItemValueKeyOf<TEntry>, EntryGroupChildrenOf<TEntry>, any, EntryItemValueReturnOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfRadios component, parameterized by the
 * item-driving type arguments (e.g. `VfRadiosProps<typeof items, 'id'>`). Reach
 * for `VfRadiosProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface VfRadiosProps<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> extends RadiosProps<'radios', TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn, VfRadiosSlots<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn>, VfRadiosParts, VfRadiosClasses, VfRadiosContext<VfRadiosProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfRadios component, parameterized by the item-driving
 * type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the narrowed
 * context — same pattern as `VfRadiosSlots`. Plain usage (`VfRadiosEmits`)
 * keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfRadiosEmits<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> extends RadiosEmits<VfRadiosContext<VfRadiosProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfRadios component.
 */
export interface VfRadiosSlots<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown, TValue = ItemValueOf<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn>, TRaw = RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>> extends RadiosSlots<VfRadiosContext<VfRadiosProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TModel, TItemValueReturn>>> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the default radios rendering. Receives resolved items,
     * groups, and shared state.
     */
    default: (props: {
        radioName: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        label: string | undefined;
        items: ResolvedItem<TValue, TRaw>[];
        groups: ResolvedGroup<TValue, TRaw>[];
        grouped: boolean;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each option group when items are grouped.
     */
    group: (props: {
        radioName: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        label: string | undefined;
        group: ResolvedGroup<TValue, TRaw>;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each entire `VfRadio` child. Receives the resolved item
     * and shared state.
     */
    item: (props: {
        radioName: string;
        disabled: boolean;
        label: string | undefined;
        item: ResolvedItem<TValue, TRaw>;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces each individual radio input rendering inside the default
     * `VfRadio` child.
     *
     * Child radios always use the default `true` radio value; the holder's item
     * value is resolved by name, not passed as `radioValue`.
     *
     * @inherits VfRadio.default
     */
    radio: (props: Parameters<VfRadioSlots<true>['default']>[0]) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the text/label of each individual radio.
     *
     * @inherits VfRadio.text
     */
    text: (props: Parameters<VfRadioSlots['text']>[0]) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfRadios component.
 */
export interface VfRadiosParts extends RadiosParts {
    /**
     * The wrapper element containing all radio items.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    group: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The fieldset element wrapping each group when items are grouped.
     *
     * @param group The group data.
     * @tag fieldset
     */
    fieldset: (group: Record<string, any>) => DomAttrsOf<'fieldset'>;
    /**
     * The legend element displaying the group label.
     *
     * @param group The group data.
     * @tag legend
     */
    legend: (group: Record<string, any>) => DomAttrsOf<'legend'>;
    /**
     * Props factory for each VfRadio child component, receiving the item data.
     *
     * @param item The radio item data.
     * @tag VfRadio
     */
    item: (item: Record<string, any>) => PartOf<'VfRadio'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfRadios component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfRadiosClasses extends RadiosClasses {
    /**
     * The wrapper element containing all radio items.
     */
    group: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfRadios.
 */
export interface VfRadiosExpose extends RadiosExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfRadios, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfRadiosContext<VfRadiosProps<typeof items, 'id'>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfRadiosContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfRadiosProps, RadiosProps<string, ItemsProp, ItemValueProp, GroupChildrenProp>> = VfRadiosProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfRadiosEmits, VfRadiosSlots, VfRadiosParts, VfRadiosClasses, VfRadiosExpose, RadiosApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfRadios. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context by
 * the entry's item-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfRadiosEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfRadiosEmits<EntryItemsOf<TEntry>, EntryItemValueKeyOf<TEntry>, EntryGroupChildrenOf<TEntry>, any, EntryItemValueReturnOf<TEntry>>, VfRadiosSlots, VfRadiosParts, VfRadiosClasses, VfRadiosContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}
