//// components/VfSelect/types.d.ts
import type { AddonsParts, AddonsSlots, IconsClasses, IconsParts, IconsSlots, AddonGroupClasses, ItemsProp, ItemValueProp, GroupChildrenProp, ItemValueOf, RawItemOf, ResolvedItem, EntryItemsOf, EntryItemValueKeyOf, EntryItemValueReturnOf, EntryGroupChildrenOf, EntryMultipleOf } from '../../features';
import type { WidenProps, ClassValue, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, DomAttrsOf } from '../../types';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type SelectApi, type SelectClasses, type SelectEmits, type SelectExpose, type SelectParts, type SelectProps, type SelectSlots } from '../../blueprints/select';
/**
 * VfSelect props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the
 * entry's `items` / `itemValue` / `groupChildren` / `multiple` props as
 * generics.
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfSelectProps<EntryItemsOf<TEntry>, EntryItemValueKeyOf<TEntry>, EntryGroupChildrenOf<TEntry>, EntryMultipleOf<TEntry>, any, EntryItemValueReturnOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfSelect component, parameterized by the
 * item-driving type arguments (e.g. `VfSelectProps<typeof items, 'id'>`). Reach
 * for `VfSelectProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 */
export interface VfSelectProps<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> extends SelectProps<'select', TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TItemValueReturn, VfSelectSlots<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TItemValueReturn>, VfSelectParts, VfSelectClasses, VfSelectContext<VfSelectProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TItemValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfSelect component, parameterized by the item-driving
 * type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the narrowed
 * context — same pattern as `VfSelectSlots`. Plain usage (`VfSelectEmits`)
 * keeps the context wide.
 */
export interface VfSelectEmits<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> extends SelectEmits<VfSelectContext<VfSelectProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TItemValueReturn>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfSelect component.
 */
export interface VfSelectSlots<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown, TValue = ItemValueOf<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn>, TRaw = RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>> extends SelectSlots<VfSelectContext<VfSelectProps<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TItemValueReturn>>>, AddonsSlots, IconsSlots {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the label of each native option.
     *
     * @param props.item The resolved option item.
     */
    option: (props: {
        item: ResolvedItem<TValue, TRaw>;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfSelect component.
 */
export interface VfSelectParts extends SelectParts, AddonsParts, IconsParts {
    /**
     * The addon group wrapper element.
     *
     * @tag div
     */
    addonGroup: DomAttrsOf<'div'>;
    /**
     * The select input element.
     *
     * @tag select
     */
    input: DomAttrsOf<'select'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfSelect component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfSelectClasses extends SelectClasses, AddonGroupClasses, IconsClasses {
    /**
     * The select input element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfSelect.
 */
export interface VfSelectExpose extends SelectExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfSelect, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfSelectContext<VfSelectProps<typeof items, 'id'>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfSelectContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfSelectProps, SelectProps<string, ItemsProp, ItemValueProp, GroupChildrenProp>> = VfSelectProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfSelectEmits, VfSelectSlots, VfSelectParts, VfSelectClasses, VfSelectExpose, SelectApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfSelect. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context by
 * the entry's item-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfSelectEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfSelectEmits<EntryItemsOf<TEntry>, EntryItemValueKeyOf<TEntry>, EntryGroupChildrenOf<TEntry>, EntryMultipleOf<TEntry>, any, EntryItemValueReturnOf<TEntry>>, VfSelectSlots, VfSelectParts, VfSelectClasses, VfSelectContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

//// components/VfText/types.d.ts
import type { AddonsSlots, IconsClasses, IconsParts, IconsSlots, TranslateSlots, AddonsParts, TranslateParts, AddonGroupClasses, AddonGroupParts, EntryTranslateOf, EntryLanguagesOf } from '../../features';
import type { WidenProps, DefineElementContext, DefineRegistryEntry, ClassValue, DomAttrsOf, LanguagesProp } from '../../types';
import { type TextApi, type TextClasses, type TextEmits, type TextExpose, type TextParts, type TextProps, type TextSlots } from '../../blueprints/text';
/**
 * VfText props narrowed from a registry `TEntry` payload, applying the entry's
 * `translate` / `languages` props as generics (so `translate: true` forces a
 * locale-keyed `modelValue`).
 */
export type EntryProps<TEntry> = VfTextProps<EntryTranslateOf<TEntry>, EntryLanguagesOf<TEntry>>;
/**
 * Generic props interface for the VfText component, parameterized by the
 * model-driving type arguments (e.g. `VfTextProps<true, typeof languages>`).
 * Reach for `VfTextProps` instead when no narrowing is needed.
 *
 * The `part:*` / `class:*` / `reclass:*` shorthand attrs are injected into dist
 * by `@vueform/utils` (see the `#shorthands` marker import on `unstyled.ts`).
 */
export interface VfTextProps<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> extends TextProps<'text', TTranslate, TLanguages, VfTextSlots<TTranslate, TLanguages>, VfTextParts, VfTextClasses, VfTextContext<VfTextProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>>> {
}
/**
 * Events emitted by the VfText component, parameterized by the model-driving
 * type arguments so event handlers (e.g. `@change`) receive the narrowed
 * context — same pattern as `VfTextSlots`. Plain usage (`VfTextEmits`) keeps
 * the context wide.
 */
export interface VfTextEmits<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> extends TextEmits<VfTextContext<VfTextProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>>> {
}
/**
 * Slots available in the VfText component.
 */
export interface VfTextSlots<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> extends TextSlots<VfTextContext<VfTextProps<TTranslate, TLanguages>>>, AddonsSlots, IconsSlots, TranslateSlots {
}
/**
 * Structural parts of the VfText component.
 */
export interface VfTextParts extends TextParts, AddonsParts, AddonGroupParts, IconsParts, TranslateParts {
    /**
     * The text input element.
     *
     * @tag input
     */
    input: DomAttrsOf<'input'>;
}
/**
 * CSS classes for the VfText component's structural parts.
 */
export interface VfTextClasses extends TextClasses, AddonGroupClasses, IconsClasses {
    /**
     * The text input element.
     */
    input: ClassValue;
}
/**
 * Augmentable public API surface for VfText.
 */
export interface VfTextExpose extends TextExpose {
}
/**
 * Public context for VfText, optionally parameterized by concrete props (e.g.
 * `VfTextContext<VfTextProps<true, typeof languages>>`).
 *
 * Must be an interface — it sits on the recursive type loop (props → context →
 * api → props) and only a nominal, lazily-resolved interface breaks that cycle
 * (a type alias here degrades the whole registry with TS2456).
 */
export interface VfTextContext<TProps extends WidenProps<VfTextProps, TextProps> = VfTextProps> extends DefineElementContext<TProps, VfTextEmits, VfTextSlots, VfTextParts, VfTextClasses, VfTextExpose, TextApi<TProps>> {
}
/**
 * Registry entry for VfText. `TEntry` narrows the props / emits / context by
 * the entry's model-driving props, the same way SFC generics do.
 */
export interface VfTextEntry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends DefineRegistryEntry<EntryProps<TEntry>, VfTextEmits<EntryTranslateOf<TEntry>, EntryLanguagesOf<TEntry>>, VfTextSlots, VfTextParts, VfTextClasses, VfTextContext<EntryProps<TEntry>>> {
}

//// composables/useAutosave.d.ts
import { type AutosaveInstance, type MakeAutosaveOptions } from '../modules/autosave';
/**
 * Configuration options for the `useAutosave` composable — the form-specific
 * wiring options, with the context-dependent members (`form$`,
 * `resolveEndpoint`) resolved by the composable itself.
 */
export type UseAutosaveOptions = Omit<MakeAutosaveOptions, 'form$' | 'resolveEndpoint'>;
/**
 * Wires a form's autosave behavior through the `autosave` module: remote saves
 * to `endpoint` on the configured events and interval (deferred while the form
 * is invalid unless `invalid: true`), and a `local` draft mirror that saves the
 * model to storage on every action, loads it back on mount, and clears it on
 * successful submit. Setup-only: throws when called outside a component setup
 * context. When the `autosave` module is not registered, its inert surface
 * takes over: the `autosave` prop has no effect (with a dev warning) and the
 * returned methods are no-ops.
 *
 * @private
 * @param options Form-specific autosave wiring options.
 */
export declare function useAutosave(options: UseAutosaveOptions): AutosaveInstance;

//// composables/useBlueprint.d.ts
import { type ComputedRef, type Ref } from 'vue';
import type { LocaleModule } from '../modules/locale';
import { type VueformGlobals, type DefineEvents, type VueformConfig } from '../helpers';
import { type ClassesProp, type LooseClasses, type LooseRequired, type PartsProp, type SpreadMerge, type UnwrapApiRefs } from '../types';
import { type GenericInstance } from '../utils';
/**
 * The shape returned by `useParts`: the original part type (callable parts
 * remain callable, static parts remain spreadable) plus arbitrary extra keys.
 */
type ResolvedParts<T> = Partial<T>;
/**
 * Resolves the factory API type: `ReturnType` when given a factory function,
 * otherwise the API object type as-is (e.g. from `useBlueprint`).
 */
type ApiOf<T> = T extends (...args: any) => infer R ? R : T;
/**
 * Resolves event helpers: emit maps (`SelectEmits`) are wrapped with
 * `DefineEvents`; already-built `defineEvents()` returns (with `fire`) pass
 * through unchanged (e.g. from `useBlueprint`).
 */
type EventsOf<T extends Record<string, any>> = T extends {
    fire: (...args: any) => any;
} ? T : DefineEvents<T>;
/**
 * The public `props` shape on the context: resolved props minus type-only brand
 * keys (symbol keys such as the items generics brand). The brand varies with
 * each component instance's inferred type parameters, so keeping it would make
 * generic instances unassignable to a component's canonical context (e.g.
 * `VfSelectContext` built from bare `VfSelectProps`). The brand is type-only
 * (never set at runtime) and its consumers (`ItemsGenericsOf`) read blueprint
 * setup props, not context props.
 */
type ContextProps<TProps> = {
    [K in keyof TProps as K extends symbol ? never : K]: TProps[K];
};
/**
 * Lazy `toRef` proxy over resolved props, used by `propRefs` and as the second
 * argument to `useClasses` factories.
 */
type PropRefsOf<TProps> = {
    [K in keyof TProps]-?: Ref<TProps[K]>;
};
/**
 * First argument to `useClasses` factories: the factory API plus event helpers
 * and the resolved (non-ref) `props` object. Kept as a pick of assembled fields
 * rather than the full `Blueprint2Api` to avoid a circular type through
 * `useClasses`.
 */
type ClassFactoryApi<TApi extends Record<string, any>, TProps extends Record<string, any>, TEvents extends Record<string, any> = {}> = TApi & TEvents & {
    props: TProps;
};
/**
 * Extracts the component's class map from its props' `classes` prop, mirroring
 * how `useParts` recovers the parts map from `parts`.
 */
type ClassesOfProps<TProps> = TProps extends {
    classes?: ClassesProp<infer C>;
} ? C extends Record<string, any> ? C : Record<string, any> : Record<string, any>;
/**
 * Optional extension callback that may add or overwrite members on the
 * blueprint API before plugins run. May return nothing when it only registers
 * hooks/watchers.
 */
type BlueprintExtension<TApi extends Record<string, any>, TProps extends Record<string, any>, TEvents extends Record<string, any>, TExt = void> = (api: TApi, props: TProps, events: TEvents) => TExt;
/**
 * Normalizes an extension return: `void` / non-objects become `{}` so
 * `SpreadMerge` does not collapse the API when the callback only runs hooks.
 */
type ResolvedExtension<T> = T extends Record<string, any> ? T : {};
/**
 * Adds `ForwardsApi` to the api type when the blueprint carries a
 * `makeForwards` declaration — the type-level counterpart of `useBlueprint`
 * noticing `api.forwards` and assigning the built computeds.
 */
type ForwardsOf<TApi> = TApi extends {
    forwards: ForwardsConfig;
} ? ForwardsApi : {};
type Blueprint2Api<TApi extends Record<string, any>, TProps extends Record<string, any>, TEvents extends Record<string, any>, TParts extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, TClasses extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, TSlots extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>> = {
    /**
     * Factory API plus event helpers and the resolved (non-ref) `props` object.
     * For SFC destructuring and class factories — not the public context shape.
     */
    api: ClassFactoryApi<TApi, TProps, TEvents> & ForwardsOf<TApi>;
    /**
     * Resolved part attribute overrides.
     */
    parts: TParts;
    /**
     * Resolved CSS classes for the component.
     */
    classes: TClasses;
    /**
     * Merged named outlets: inline template slots (`useSlots`) combined with
     * prop-based slot component overrides. Uses the blueprint's own merged
     * `outlets` (e.g. from `makeElement`) when available, otherwise the raw
     * `defineSlots` map.
     */
    outlets: ComputedRef<TSlots>;
    /**
     * Lazy `toRef` proxy over resolved props for reactive destructuring.
     */
    propRefs: PropRefsOf<TProps>;
    /**
     * The component's single public context: the context proxy over the exposed
     * object — ref members read unwrapped and are assignable, `toRefs` / `toRaw`
     * work. Bind it to the `#template` slot and the template outlet as
     * `:context`; it is also what event handlers receive as `context$`, what
     * `find()` returns, and what `useContext()` returns.
     */
    context: BlueprintContext<TApi, TProps, TEvents, TSlots, TParts, TClasses>;
    /**
     * The object to hand to `defineExpose`: `toRaw(context)` — the raw API (refs
     * intact) plus the resolved `props`, `parts`, `classes`, and `outlets`. Every
     * public view of the component — `context`, template refs — reads through
     * it.
     */
    expose: ClassFactoryApi<TApi, ContextProps<TProps>, TEvents> & {
        props: ContextProps<TProps>;
        parts: TParts;
        classes: TClasses;
        outlets: ComputedRef<TSlots>;
    };
    /**
     * Registers component-level class definitions. Factories are deferred until
     * first class-key access and receive `(api, propRefs)`.
     *
     * @param defs Class definition objects or factories.
     */
    useClasses: (...defs: ClassDefsArg<TClasses, ClassFactoryApi<TApi, TProps, TEvents>, PropRefsOf<TProps>>[]) => void;
};
/**
 * A class definition factory that receives the component API and prop refs when
 * invoked (lazily, on first class-key access).
 */
type ClassDefsFactory<C, TApi = Record<string, any>, TPropRefs = Record<string, any>> = (api: TApi, propRefs: TPropRefs) => LooseClasses<C>;
/**
 * A class definition object or a factory that returns one. Factories are
 * deferred until first key access and receive `(api, propRefs)` so they need
 * not close over setup bindings.
 */
type ClassDefsArg<C, TApi = Record<string, any>, TPropRefs = Record<string, any>> = LooseClasses<C> | ClassDefsFactory<C, TApi, TPropRefs>;
/**
 * Assembled blueprint return. Factory members live under `api` for internal
 * destructuring; `context` is the flat public shape used by `defineExpose` and
 * the `#template` slot.
 */
/**
 * The members `useBlueprint` builds for a `makeForwards` declaration and
 * assigns onto the api (see `buildForwards`).
 */
export type ForwardsApi = {
    /**
     * Component attrs with forwarded event listeners routed through the Vueform
     * event system.
     */
    forwardProps: ComputedRef<Record<string, any>>;
    /**
     * Outlets filtered to only include those designated for the underlying
     * adapter component.
     */
    forwardSlots: ComputedRef<Record<string, any>>;
};
/**
 * Unified public component context: factory API and event helpers at the root,
 * plus resolved `props` / `parts` / `classes` / `outlets`.
 *
 * This is the single shape shared by:
 *
 * - event-handler `context$` (proxy over `instance.exposed`)
 * - `defineExpose` / `#template` slot payload
 *
 * `$config`, `$locale`, and `$globals` are always present — injected by
 * `createComponentContext` for every component, not only those that expose them
 * from a factory.
 *
 * `TApi` may be a factory (`typeof setup<…>`) or an already-built API object
 * type — factories are resolved via `ReturnType`. `TEvents` may be an emit map
 * (`SelectEmits`) or a `defineEvents()` return — emit maps are wrapped with
 * `DefineEvents`. `TParts` is always exposed as `Partial<TParts>`. Top-level
 * refs are unwrapped via `UnwrapApiRefs`.
 */
export type BlueprintContext<TApi, TProps extends Record<string, any>, TEvents extends Record<string, any> = {}, TSlots extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, TParts extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, TClasses extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>> = UnwrapApiRefs<Omit<ApiOf<TApi>, 'outlets'> & EventsOf<TEvents> & {
    props: ContextProps<TProps>;
    parts: Partial<TParts>;
    classes: TClasses & Record<string, any>;
    outlets: ComputedRef<TSlots>;
    /**
     * The resolved Vueform configuration for the injecting app.
     */
    $config: VueformConfig;
    /**
     * The locale module instance, or its inert surface when the `locale`
     * module is not registered.
     */
    $locale: LocaleModule;
    /**
     * Form-level layout globals derived from the Vueform configuration.
     */
    $globals: VueformGlobals;
}>;
/**
 * The events and slots an adapter component forwards to the underlying
 * third-party component. Declared on the api as `forwards` by `makeForwards`;
 * `useBlueprint` notices it and builds `forwardProps` / `forwardSlots`.
 */
export type ForwardsConfig = {
    /**
     * Event names to forward through the Vueform event system with `context$`
     * appended (kebab-case or camelCase).
     */
    events?: readonly string[];
    /**
     * Slot names to forward from the resolved outlets to the underlying
     * component.
     */
    slots?: readonly string[];
};
/**
 * Resolves part overrides for a component. Each part sources from, in priority
 * order: the resolved `part:<key>` prop (config defaults, presets, and user
 * values merged by `useProps`), the raw `part:<key>` attr, then the `parts`
 * prop. Static-object values are returned as-is (zero allocation overhead).
 * Function values are wrapped in a Proxy that is both spreadable and callable,
 * so the same wrapper supports both consumption patterns: `v-bind="parts.X"`
 * for non-callable parts using the `(context) => obj` pattern, and
 * `parts.X(args)` for callable parts.
 *
 * Accepts the resolved props object directly (any `Record` with an optional
 * `parts` field) so blueprint generics flow without an `as any` cast.
 *
 * @param props Resolved props from `useProps`.
 */
declare function useParts<TProps extends Record<string, any>>(props: TProps): ResolvedParts<TProps extends {
    parts?: PartsProp<infer P>;
} ? P : Record<string, any>>;
/**
 * Returns the resolved props object `useProps` created for a component
 * instance, or `undefined` when the component doesn't use `useProps`.
 *
 * @param instance The component's instance (VDOM or Vapor).
 * @internal
 */
export declare function getResolvedProps(instance: GenericInstance): Record<string, any> | undefined;
/**
 * Universal SFC-side blueprint consumer for prop-generic blueprints:
 *
 * ```ts
 * const { api, context } = useBlueprint(
 *   setup,
 *   props,
 *   events,
 *   slots,
 *   extension
 * )
 * ```
 *
 * Takes the blueprint's generic `setup` as a value so `TApi` is instantiated
 * from the SFC's concrete props at the call site. Call-site generic-argument
 * instantiation is the one TypeScript mechanism (besides `typeof setup<TProps>`
 * instantiation expressions) that preserves prop-generic narrowing, and it
 * works with deferred SFC generics (`TItems` etc.), so no per-blueprint
 * `useBlueprint` wrapper is needed.
 *
 * Prop validation flows through the `setup` argument: if the SFC's props don't
 * satisfy the blueprint's loose-props constraint, the error surfaces on `setup`
 * rather than on `rawProps`.
 *
 * Component-level defaults come from Vue's `withDefaults` on the SFC;
 * `useProps` only merges global config defaults and presets.
 *
 * @private
 * @param setup Blueprint setup receiving resolved props and events.
 * @param rawProps Raw props from `defineProps` / `withDefaults`.
 * @param events Event emitter from `defineEvents`.
 * @param slots Slot map from `defineSlots`. Type-only: it instantiates the
 *   outlets' `TSlots`; the runtime outlets come from `useOutlets` (which reads
 *   the same slots via `useSlots()`).
 * @param extension Optional callback to add or overwrite API members.
 */
export declare function useBlueprint<TProps extends Record<string, any>, TEvents extends Record<string, any>, TApi extends Record<string, any>, TSlots extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, TExt = void>(setup: (props: LooseRequired<TProps>, events: TEvents) => TApi, rawProps: Readonly<TProps>, events: TEvents, _slots?: TSlots, extension?: BlueprintExtension<TApi, LooseRequired<TProps>, TEvents, TExt>): Blueprint2Api<SpreadMerge<TApi, ResolvedExtension<TExt>>, LooseRequired<TProps>, TEvents, ReturnType<typeof useParts<LooseRequired<TProps>>>, ClassesOfProps<LooseRequired<TProps>>, TSlots>;
export {};

//// composables/useChildren.d.ts
import { type MaybeRef, type ShallowReactive, type Ref } from 'vue';
import type { ElementName } from '../types';
/**
 * Options for `useChildren`.
 */
type UseChildrenOptions = {
    /**
     * Also keep a map of every registered descendant keyed by full path, not only
     * direct children. Used by the form to expose `elements$`.
     */
    flat?: boolean;
};
/**
 * Registry of child element instances within a container or form.
 */
export type VueformChildren = {
    /**
     * The reactive map of all registered child element instances, keyed by their
     * relative path.
     */
    children$: ShallowReactive<Map<ElementName, any>>;
    /**
     * Map of every registered descendant keyed by full path. Only present when
     * `useChildren` is created with `flat: true`.
     */
    flatChildren$?: ShallowReactive<Map<string, any>>;
    /**
     * A computed list of all registered stateful (non-static) child element
     * instances. Created on first access.
     */
    statefulChildren$: Ref<any[]>;
    /**
     * A computed list of all available (visible) stateful child element
     * instances. Created on first access.
     */
    availableStatefulChildren$: Ref<any[]>;
    /**
     * A computed list of all available (visible) stateful and hoisted child
     * element instances. Created on first access.
     */
    hoistedChildren$: Ref<any[]>;
    /**
     * Registers a child element context at the given path.
     *
     * @param path The full path of the child element.
     * @param context$ The child element's component context.
     */
    register: (path: string, context$: any) => void;
    /**
     * Unregisters a child element at the given path.
     *
     * @param path The full path of the child element to remove.
     * @param instance When provided, the entry is only removed if it still
     *   belongs to this instance (prevents deleting a sibling's registration
     *   after paths were re-keyed by a reorder).
     */
    unregister: (path: string, instance?: any) => void;
    /**
     * Subscribes a callback to a children registry event.
     */
    on: {
        /**
         * Listens for child element registration.
         *
         * @param e The event name.
         * @param callback The handler invoked with the child's path and component
         *   context.
         */
        (e: 'register', callback: (path: string, context$: any) => any): any;
        /**
         * Listens for child element unregistration.
         *
         * @param e The event name.
         * @param callback The handler invoked with the child's path and optionally
         *   the specific instance being unregistered.
         */
        (e: 'unregister', callback: (path: string, instance?: any) => any): any;
    };
    /**
     * Unsubscribes a callback from a children registry event.
     */
    off: {
        /**
         * Stops listening for child element registration.
         *
         * @param e The event name.
         * @param callback The handler previously registered with `on`.
         */
        (e: 'register', callback: (path: string, context$: any) => any): any;
        /**
         * Stops listening for child element unregistration.
         *
         * @param e The event name.
         * @param callback The handler previously registered with `on`.
         */
        (e: 'unregister', callback: (path: string, instance?: any) => any): any;
    };
};
/**
 * Manages a registry of child element instances within a container or form,
 * providing reactive lists and event hooks. Derived child lists are lazy
 * computeds — they are not allocated until first read.
 *
 * @private
 * @param namespace Optional base path used to compute relative child paths.
 * @param options Optional registry flags.
 * @related useContainer
 */
export declare function useChildren(namespace?: MaybeRef<string>, options?: UseChildrenOptions): VueformChildren;
export {};

//// composables/useClasses.d.ts
import { type Ref } from 'vue';
import type { ClassesOf, ClassInput, ClassValue, ComponentNames, ComponentRegistry, ContextOf, LooseClasses, PropsOf } from '../types';
/**
 * Keys a single class definition introduces: for factories, the keys of the
 * returned object; for definition objects, their own keys.
 */
type TemplateClassKeys<D> = D extends (...args: any[]) => infer R ? keyof R : keyof D;
/**
 * Class definitions accepted by `useClasses` from outside a component's own
 * setup: the host's declared keys stay typed, and any extra key is allowed so a
 * template can introduce class keys of its own.
 */
export type TemplateClasses<T extends ComponentNames> = LooseClasses<ComponentRegistry[T]['classes']> & Record<string, ClassInput<ClassValue>>;
/**
 * Lazy `toRef` proxy over the host's resolved props, passed to class factories
 * as their second argument.
 */
export type TemplatePropRefs<T extends ComponentNames> = {
    [K in keyof PropsOf<T>]-?: Ref<PropsOf<T>[K]>;
};
/**
 * A class definition object, or a factory receiving the host's public context
 * and prop refs. Factories are invoked lazily on first class-key access and
 * re-run reactively.
 */
export type TemplateClassDefs<T extends ComponentNames> = TemplateClasses<T> | ((context$: ContextOf<T>, propRefs: TemplatePropRefs<T>) => TemplateClasses<T>);
/**
 * The classes object `useClasses` returns: the host component's declared keys
 * plus every key the passed definitions introduce. At runtime it is the host's
 * own `context.classes` proxy — the type just widens it with the template's
 * keys, so they read as `ClassValue` without a module augmentation.
 */
export type TemplateClassesOf<T extends ComponentNames, D extends TemplateClassDefs<T>[]> = ClassesOf<T> & {
    [K in Exclude<TemplateClassKeys<D[number]>, keyof ClassesOf<T>> & string]: ClassValue;
};
/**
 * Registers class definitions on the nearest Vueform component from a custom
 * template or slot. A key you set **replaces** the component's own value for
 * that key (the last definition wins per key); keys you leave out keep the
 * component's value. The result still resolves through the regular chain, so
 * user `classes` / `reclass` props, defaults, and presets apply on top. Keys
 * the component doesn't define (e.g. an `icon` node only the template renders)
 * are accepted and resolve the same way.
 *
 * Returns the host's `context.classes` proxy, typed with the built-in keys plus
 * the keys the definitions introduce — so the template can bind its own keys
 * type-safely without augmenting the component's `Classes` interface.
 *
 * @param name The host component name, used for type inference.
 * @param defs Class definition objects or factories over the host context.
 */
export declare function useClasses<T extends ComponentNames, D extends TemplateClassDefs<T>[]>(_name: T, ...defs: D): TemplateClassesOf<T, D>;
export {};

//// composables/useContext.d.ts
import type { ComponentNames, ContextOf } from '../types';
/**
 * Returns the public context of the nearest Vueform component — the very same
 * object it passes to the `#template` slot and to a reusable template as the
 * `context` prop, and the one event handlers receive as `context$`. It is Vue
 * `reactive()` state over the object the component exposes: ref members read
 * unwrapped (`context.value`) and can be assigned (`context.value = 'x'` writes
 * the underlying ref); a destructured member is a snapshot, so go through
 * `toRefs(context)` for live, writable refs.
 *
 * Reach for it where the `context` prop isn't at hand — a helper component
 * rendered inside a custom template, without passing the prop down. Inside a
 * template itself, declaring the `context` prop (typed `ContextOf<'VfName'>`)
 * is the primary route.
 *
 * @param name The component name used for type inference.
 */
export declare function useContext<T extends ComponentNames>(_name: T): ContextOf<T>;

//// composables/useData.d.ts
import { type ComputedRef, type MaybeRef, type Ref } from 'vue';
import { type VueformChildren } from './';
import type { FeatureEvents } from '../helpers';
import type { ElementName, RuleMessagesProp, ResolvedLanguagesProp, Booleanish } from '../types';
import { type ContainerContext } from '../contexts';
import { type TRulesProp } from '../modules/validation';
/**
 * Configuration options for the useData composable.
 */
type UseDataOptions = {
    /**
     * The element's own children registry. Children with the `hoist` prop have
     * their errors surfaced by this element.
     */
    children: VueformChildren;
    /**
     * The element's name, used as the key in the parent model and for
     * registration.
     */
    name?: Ref<ElementName>;
    /**
     * Whether the element is currently available (visible). Unavailable elements
     * are excluded from form data.
     */
    available?: Ref<boolean>;
    /**
     * The element's path in the form tree (e.g. `address.city`).
     */
    path?: Ref<string>;
    /**
     * The element's dot-notation data path in the root model.
     */
    dataPath?: Ref<string>;
    /**
     * The parent container context that owns the model this element reads from
     * and writes to.
     */
    container?: ContainerContext;
    /**
     * The external `v-model` ref bound by the parent, if any.
     */
    modelValue?: Ref<any>;
    /**
     * Validation rules to apply to this element. Can be multilingual when
     * `translatable` is `true`.
     */
    rules?: Ref<TRulesProp | undefined>;
    /**
     * Maximum number of error messages to display at once.
     */
    maxErrors?: Ref<number | undefined>;
    /**
     * Whether this element pushes its errors to its nearest ancestor element.
     */
    hoist?: Ref<boolean | undefined>;
    /**
     * Whether the value is included in form submission data.
     */
    submit?: Ref<boolean | undefined>;
    /**
     * Whether the element holds sensitive data, excluded from locally stored
     * autosave drafts.
     */
    sensitive?: Ref<boolean | undefined>;
    /**
     * The element-specific null value override. When translatable, this is
     * expanded into a per-language object.
     */
    nullValue?: Ref<any>;
    /**
     * The value representing the "on" / checked state. Used by checkbox-style
     * inputs to determine the model value when checked.
     */
    trueValue?: MaybeRef<any>;
    /**
     * The value representing the "off" / unchecked state. When defined, it is
     * used as the default null value and the element is considered empty when its
     * model equals this value.
     */
    falseValue?: MaybeRef<any>;
    /**
     * Whether the element accepts multiple values. When true, the default null
     * value is an empty array instead of `null`.
     */
    multiple?: MaybeRef<Booleanish | undefined>;
    /**
     * A ref tracking whether the user has interacted with this element.
     */
    touched?: Ref<boolean>;
    /**
     * An explicit initial model value, bypassing the default coalescing logic.
     */
    startupModel?: Ref<any>;
    /**
     * The raw default value or expression for the element. When translatable,
     * expanded to a per-language object with expression resolution.
     */
    default?: Ref<any>;
    /**
     * Custom validation messages keyed by rule name, resolved as text props.
     */
    ruleMessages?: Ref<RuleMessagesProp | undefined>;
    /**
     * A function to transform outgoing data when reading the element's `payload`
     * computed.
     */
    transformPayload?: Ref<((value: any, context$: any) => any) | undefined>;
    /**
     * The element's unique DOM id, used to derive sub-region ids like
     * `languageId`.
     */
    id?: Ref<string>;
    /**
     * Pre-resolved translatable flag from makeMultilingual. When provided,
     * useData uses it instead of computing its own.
     */
    translatable?: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Pre-resolved active language ref from makeMultilingual. When provided,
     * useData uses it instead of creating its own.
     */
    language?: Ref<string>;
    /**
     * Pre-resolved languages map from makeMultilingual. When provided, useData
     * uses it instead of computing its own.
     */
    languages?: Ref<ResolvedLanguagesProp>;
    /**
     * Pre-resolved language indicator DOM id from makeMultilingual. When
     * provided, useData uses it instead of computing its own.
     */
    languageId?: ComputedRef<string | undefined>;
    /**
     * Whether this element aggregates children's data as a nested container
     * (group, list, grid, matrix, form).
     */
    nested?: MaybeRef<boolean | undefined>;
    /**
     * The items definition for dynamic list containers (array of schemas or a
     * count). Only relevant when `nested` is `true`.
     */
    rows?: Ref<any[] | number | undefined>;
    /**
     * Whether this element operates as the form root, owning the root model:
     * adopting a `useModel` instance passed via `modelValue`, or creating an
     * internal store from the plain `modelValue`. Mutually exclusive with
     * `container`.
     */
    root?: boolean;
    /**
     * When set, the model value is cast to the specified type before being stored
     * or read. Values that are `null` or `undefined` are not cast.
     */
    cast?: CastOption;
} & FeatureEvents<{
    reset: [context$: any];
    clear: [context$: any];
    load: [value: any, context$: any];
    change: [newValue: any, oldValue: any, context$: any];
    'update:modelValue': [value: any];
    valid: [context$: any];
    invalid: [context$: any];
}>;
/**
 * Optional cast applied to the element's model value (`string` or `number`).
 */
export type CastOption = MaybeRef<'string' | 'number' | undefined>;
/**
 * Manages element-level data, validation state, error handling, and lifecycle
 * for all stateful form elements — leaf inputs, containers, and the form root.
 *
 * Behavior is configured via options:
 *
 * - `nested` activates children aggregation (groups, lists, grids, matrices)
 * - `flat` skips data path registration and payload wrapping
 * - `items` enables dynamic list operations (add/remove/sort)
 * - `translatable` enables per-language validation
 * - `root` designates the form root
 *
 * @private
 * @param options Element data configuration object.
 */
export declare function useData(options: UseDataOptions): {
    validation: import("vue").ShallowReactive<Record<string, import("@vueform/core").ValidationView>>;
    currentValidation: Readonly<Ref<import("@vueform/core").ValidationView, import("@vueform/core").ValidationView>>;
    validator: import("@vueform/core").Validator;
    shouldValidate: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    onUserInput: () => void;
    isContainer: Readonly<Ref<boolean, boolean>>;
    isFlatContainer: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    containerModel: ComputedRef<unknown>;
    update: (data: any) => void;
    handleModelUpdate: (data: Event) => void;
    reset: () => void;
    clear: () => void;
    load: (data: any) => void;
    validate: (options?: {
        force?: boolean;
    }) => Promise<boolean>;
    validateSelf: () => Promise<boolean>;
    validateChildren: (options?: {
        force?: boolean;
    }) => Promise<boolean>;
    validateCurrent: () => Promise<boolean>;
    unvalidate: () => void;
    invalidate: () => void;
    clean: () => void;
    clearErrors: () => void;
    clearMessages: () => void;
    clearMessageBag: () => void;
    add: (count?: number) => Promise<void>;
    remove: (index?: number) => void;
    sort: (fromIndex: number, toIndex: number) => Promise<void>;
    filled: (value: any) => boolean;
    tracking: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    track: () => void;
    untrack: () => void;
    init: () => void;
    reinit: () => void;
    destroy: () => void;
    register: () => void;
    unregister: (unregisterDataPath?: string) => void;
    initModel: (() => void) | (() => void);
    reinitModel: (unregisterDataPath?: string) => void;
    destroyModel: (() => void) | (() => void);
    initValidation: () => void;
    destroyValidation: () => void;
    invalidLanguages?: ComputedRef<Set<string>> | undefined;
    dragIndex: Ref<any, any>;
    dropIndex: Ref<any, any>;
    items?: ComputedRef<any[]> | undefined;
    value: import("vue").WritableComputedRef<any, any>;
    /**
     * The element's reactive model value within the form data tree.
     */
    model: ComputedRef<any> | Ref<Record<string, any>, Record<string, any>>;

    initialModel: Ref<any, any> | Ref<Record<string, any>, Record<string, any>>;

//// composables/useDynamicProp.d.ts
import { type ComputedRef, type MaybeRef, type Ref } from 'vue';
import type { DProp } from '../types';
/**
 * Extracts the underlying value type from a `DProp` by unwrapping its `Ref`
 * member — the only union member where the value type appears alone. Falls back
 * to the type itself for non-dynamic values.
 */
type UnwrapDynamicProp<D> = [Extract<D, Ref<any>>] extends [never] ? Exclude<D, undefined> : [Extract<D, Ref<any>>] extends [Ref<infer T>] ? T : Exclude<D, undefined>;
/**
 * The computed's value type: the return override `V` when provided, otherwise
 * the value type unwrapped from the prop's declared type.
 */
type ResolvedValue<V, D> = [V] extends [void] ? UnwrapDynamicProp<D> : V;
/**
 * Factory function signature for resolving raw dynamic prop values into
 * computeds. Helpers are pre-bound so the maker can be called after setup —
 * including inside other computeds.
 */
type MakeDynamicPropFn = {
    /**
     * Resolves a raw dynamic prop value into an expression-aware computed.
     *
     * @param key The expression allow-list key.
     * @param prop The dynamic prop value or ref to resolve.
     * @param options Resolution options.
     */
    <V = any, T = any>(key: string, prop: MaybeRef<DProp<T> | undefined>, options?: UseDynamicPropOptions<V, T>): ComputedRef<any>;
    /**
     * Resolves an unknown prop value into an expression-aware computed.
     *
     * @param key The expression allow-list key.
     * @param prop The unknown prop value or ref to attempt to resolve.
     * @param options Resolution options.
     */
    (key: string, prop: MaybeRef<unknown>, options?: UseDynamicPropOptions): ComputedRef<any>;
};
/**
 * Options for resolving a dynamic prop.
 */
type UseDynamicPropOptions<V = any, T = any> = {
    /**
     * The component context passed to contextual functions. Falls back to the
     * nearest component context when not provided.
     */
    context$?: any;
    /**
     * Overrides the key used when checking whether expressions are allowed. When
     * omitted, defaults to the kebab-case form of the first argument.
     */
    key?: string;
    /**
     * Fallback value returned when the prop is `undefined` or resolves to an
     * empty string.
     */
    default?: any;
    /**
     * Whether to localize the resolved value. When enabled, strings and locale
     * record objects are passed through the locale module before further
     * processing.
     */
    localize?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to run the resolved string through the security module's
     * `sanitizeHtml` — only when it actually contains markup (`containsHtml`), so
     * plain text never touches the engine (no mangling of comparisons like `score
     * < 10`, and no interaction with the engineless production fallback). Runs
     * after localization and expression resolution, so the sanitizer sees the
     * final bytes.
     */
    sanitize?: boolean;
    /**
     * URL schemes the resolved value may carry, without the trailing colon (e.g.
     * `['http', 'https']`). Relative URLs always pass; a value with any other
     * scheme — `javascript:` above all — resolves to `undefined` with a dev
     * warning (the security module's `sanitizeUrl`; without the module, URLs pass
     * through unchecked). Validation runs on the final string, after localization
     * and expression resolution.
     */
    safeUrl?: string[];
    /**
     * Whether to coerce the resolved value to a string. When enabled and no
     * `transform` is provided, `undefined` and empty values become `''` and all
     * other values are passed through `String()`. The computed is typed as
     * `string` (never `undefined`).
     */
    string?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to convert the resolved value to a number. When enabled and no
     * `transform` is provided, empty or undefined values resolve to `undefined`
     * and all other values are passed through `Number()`.
     */
    number?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to convert the resolved value to a `Date`. When enabled and no
     * `transform` is provided, string values are passed through `new Date()` and
     * non-string values are returned as-is.
     */
    date?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether to resolve the value as an icon CSS class string via the config
     * icon resolver. When enabled and no `transform` is provided, string values
     * are resolved through the config icon helper (`$`-prefixed names are mapped
     * through the semantic `config.icons` map first) and non-string values
     * resolve to `undefined`.
     */
    icon?: boolean;
    /**
     * When truthy, appends a required marker (`*`) to the resolved string. The
     * caller decides whether the marker should appear — pass a ref or computed
     * that encodes that decision.
     */
    required?: MaybeRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Transforms the resolved value before returning. When provided, replaces the
     * default `normalize` step and its return type becomes the computed's value
     * type.
     *
     * @param value The resolved value after expression evaluation.
     */
    transform?: (value: T | (string & {}) | undefined) => V | undefined;
};
/**
 * Resolves a raw ref value into an expression-aware computed.
 *
 * @private
 * @param key The expression allow-list key.
 * @param prop The dynamic prop value ref to resolve.
 * @param options Resolution options.
 */
export declare function useDynamicProp(key: string, prop: Ref<any>, options: UseDynamicPropOptions<void, any> & {
    string: true;
}): ComputedRef<string>;
export declare function useDynamicProp(key: string, prop: Ref<any>, options: UseDynamicPropOptions<void, any> & {
    number: true;
}): ComputedRef<number | undefined>;
export declare function useDynamicProp(key: string, prop: Ref<any>, options: UseDynamicPropOptions<void, any> & {
    date: true;
}): ComputedRef<Date | undefined>;
export declare function useDynamicProp(key: string, prop: Ref<any>, options: UseDynamicPropOptions<void, any> & {
    icon: true;
}): ComputedRef<string | undefined>;
export declare function useDynamicProp<V = void, T = any>(key: string, prop: Ref<T>, options?: UseDynamicPropOptions<V, UnwrapDynamicProp<T>>): ComputedRef<ResolvedValue<V, T> | undefined>;
/**
 * Resolves a `DProp` from a props object into an expression-aware computed. The
 * computed's value type is inferred from the prop's declared type, or the
 * `transform` option's return type when provided.
 *
 * @private
 * @param name The prop name (key in the props object).
 * @param props The component props object.
 * @param options Resolution options.
 */
export declare function useDynamicProp<P extends Record<string, any>, K extends keyof P & string>(name: K, props: P, options: UseDynamicPropOptions<void, UnwrapDynamicProp<P[K]>> & {
    string: true;
}): ComputedRef<string>;
export declare function useDynamicProp<P extends Record<string, any>, K extends keyof P & string>(name: K, props: P, options: UseDynamicPropOptions<void, UnwrapDynamicProp<P[K]>> & {
    number: true;
}): ComputedRef<number | undefined>;
export declare function useDynamicProp<P extends Record<string, any>, K extends keyof P & string>(name: K, props: P, options: UseDynamicPropOptions<void, UnwrapDynamicProp<P[K]>> & {
    date: true;
}): ComputedRef<Date | undefined>;
export declare function useDynamicProp<P extends Record<string, any>, K extends keyof P & string>(name: K, props: P, options: UseDynamicPropOptions<void, UnwrapDynamicProp<P[K]>> & {
    icon: true;
}): ComputedRef<string | undefined>;
export declare function useDynamicProp<V = void, P extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, K extends keyof P & string = keyof P & string>(name: K, props: P, options?: UseDynamicPropOptions<V, UnwrapDynamicProp<P[K]>>): ComputedRef<ResolvedValue<V, P[K]> | undefined>;
/**
 * Creates a factory function for resolving raw dynamic prop values into
 * expression-aware computeds. Helpers are bound once so the returned maker can
 * be invoked outside of setup (e.g. inside `reactiveComputed`).
 *
 * @private
 */
export declare function useDynamicPropFactory(): MakeDynamicPropFn;

//// composables/useFeatures.d.ts
import type { Prettify } from '../types';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';
/**
 * Resolves the narrowed element `type` literal from the props, falling back to
 * the factory result's own `type` (or `string`) when the props don't carry a
 * usable string literal.
 */
type ResolveElementTypeValue<Result, Props> = Props extends {
    type: infer T;
} ? [Extract<NonNullable<T>, string>] extends [never] ? Result extends {
    type: Ref<infer RT>;
} ? RT : string : Extract<NonNullable<T>, string> : Result extends {
    type: Ref<infer RT>;
} ? RT : string;
/**
 * Resolves the element type string from props or factory result. The narrowing
 * conditional is kept inside the `type` field instead of wrapping the whole
 * object, so the surrounding API type stays a concrete intersection and remains
 * inspectable even when instantiated with a still-generic `Props` (e.g. when a
 * blueprint is composed across a package boundary through its built `.d.ts`).
 */
type ResolveElementType<Result, Props> = Omit<Result, 'type'> & {
    type: Ref<ResolveElementTypeValue<Result, Props>>;
};
/**
 * One composable step in a `useFeatures` chain.
 *
 * Props are checked as `P` directly (blueprints pass `LooseRequired<TProps>` /
 * `useProps` output, so required-key factory constraints like `template: T |
 * undefined` still apply).
 *
 * `NoInfer` on events keeps that position from poisoning inference of `P`.
 *
 * Factories that do not use props/deps in their return type should declare
 * concrete `MakeXOptions` (not unused `P`/`D` generics). Only prop-dependent
 * returns (e.g. `MakeItemsReturn<P>`) need a generic `P`.
 */
type FeatureSlot<P, E, D, R> = (o: {
    props: P;
    events: NoInfer<E>;
    deps: D;
}) => R;
/**
 * Fluent factory chain. Each `.use()` adds one composable whose return is
 * merged into the accumulator; `.build()` returns the merged API.
 *
 * `Acc` is the intersection of factory returns (fed through
 * `ResolveElementType`). `I` is the optional `initial` seed, intersected onto
 * the final result at the top level so unresolved generics on the seed cannot
 * collapse the inferred API.
 */
type FeatureBuilder<P, E, Acc extends Record<string, any> = {}, I extends Record<string, any> = {}> = {
    /**
     * Runs a composable with the current accumulated deps and merges its return
     * into the chain.
     *
     * @param fn Factory composable receiving `props`, `events`, and `deps`.
     */
    use: <R extends Record<string, any>>(fn: FeatureSlot<P, E, I & Acc, R>) => FeatureBuilder<P, E, Acc & R, I>;
    /**
     * Returns the merged factory API.
     */
    build: () => Prettify<ResolveElementType<Acc, P>> & I;
};
/**
 * Starts a factory chain that merges composables via `.use(…)` and returns the
 * API with `.build()`.
 *
 * Each `.use()` receives the accumulated results of all previous steps (plus
 * `initial` when provided) as `deps`, so factories can declare
 * props/deps/events requirements and prop-dependent returns (e.g.
 * `MakeItemsReturn<P>`) stay intact.
 *
 * @private
 * @example
 *   ;```ts
 *   return useFeatures(props, events)
 *     .use(makeElement())
 *     .use(makeLayout())
 *     .use(makeData())
 *     .build()
 *   ```
 *
 * @param props The component's props to pass to each composable.
 * @param events The component's events to pass to each composable.
 */
export declare function useFeatures<P, E>(props: P, events: E): FeatureBuilder<P, E>;
/**
 * Starts a factory chain seeded with `initial` deps. Seed members are passed to
 * the first `.use()` as `deps` and are included in `.build()`'s return type at
 * the top level (not through `type`-narrowing).
 *
 * @private
 * @example
 *   ;```ts
 *   return useFeatures(props, events, { nullValue, multiple: true })
 *     .use(makeElement())
 *     .use(makeData())
 *     .use(makeItems({ multiple: true }))
 *     .build()
 *   ```
 *
 * @param props The component's props to pass to each composable.
 * @param events The component's events to pass to each composable.
 * @param initial Dependencies used as the starting accumulator value.
 */
export declare function useFeatures<P, E, I extends Record<string, any>>(props: P, events: E, initial: I): FeatureBuilder<P, E, {}, I>;
export {};

//// composables/useForm.d.ts
import { type Component, type MaybeRef, type Ref } from 'vue';
import type { VfFormContext, VfFormEmits, VfFormProps } from '../components/VfForm/types';
import type { VueformInstance } from '../helpers';
import type { ModelInstance } from '../modules/model';
import type { ArraySchema, DeepPartial, EmitsToProps, ExactValidatedSchema, FormSchema, MatchesSchemaModel, ObjectSchema, SchemaToModel, StandardSchemaV1 } from '../types';
/**
 * Registers a callback fired with the form context once the form is mounted
 * (immediately when it already is). With no argument returns a Promise
 * resolving to the form context.
 */
type FormReady<C> = {
    (cb: (form$: C) => void): void;
    (): Promise<C>;
};
/**
 * The accepted shapes of `useForm`'s model argument: a `useModel` instance
 * (adopted by the form), a ref (two-way synced), a reactive object (keys synced
 * back on update), or a plain object (initial value).
 */
type UseFormModelArg<M extends Record<string, any>> = ModelInstance<any> | Ref<DeepPartial<M> | Record<string, any> | undefined> | (DeepPartial<M> & Record<string, any>);
/**
 * Widens each form option to also accept a ref or computed — `useForm` unwraps
 * them at render time, so any option can be reactive.
 */
type MaybeRefProps<T> = {
    [K in keyof T]: MaybeRef<T[K]>;
};
/**
 * The tuple returned by `useForm`: the renderable form component, the unwrapped
 * form context, and the ready registrar.
 */
export type UseFormReturn<TSchema = FormSchema> = [
    Component,
    VfFormContext<VfFormProps<TSchema>>,
    FormReady<VfFormContext<VfFormProps<TSchema>>>
];
/**
 * Creates a form component preconfigured with the given props and model,
 * returning it alongside the (not yet mounted) form context and a ready
 * registrar:
 *
 * ```ts
 * const [MyForm, form$, formReady] = useForm({ schema }, model)
 *
 * formReady((form$) => {
 *   form$.find('email')
 * })
 * ```
 *
 * The component renders VfForm with the merged props, forwards extra attrs and
 * slots, and binds the model according to its shape: `useModel` instances are
 * adopted (shared store), refs are two-way synced, reactive objects get their
 * keys synced back on update, and plain objects seed the initial value.
 *
 * Any option may be a ref or computed — unwrapped reactively at render time, so
 * changing it re-renders the form with the new value (e.g. a computed
 * `autosave` config, a `disabled` ref).
 *
 * `form$` is a live proxy to the mounted form's full context (`undefined`
 * members before mount) — use `formReady` for work that needs the mounted form.
 * When the model is a `useModel` instance, the members shared with the instance
 * (`model`, `get` / `set` / `update`, `validate`, …) already answer before
 * mount, backed by the instance's store.
 *
 * Setup-only when called without `vueform` — it resolves the calling
 * component's instance. Outside a component — plain modules, stores, tests —
 * pass your instance, or use its bound method, which does the same:
 * `vueform.useForm({ schema }, model)`.
 *
 * @private
 * @param formProps Props forwarded to VfForm (e.g. `schema`).
 * @param model The form data: `useModel` instance, ref, reactive, or plain
 *   object.
 * @param vueform The Vueform instance to build from. Required outside a
 *   component context.
 */
export declare function useForm<const S extends (ObjectSchema | ArraySchema) & ExactValidatedSchema<S>, Z extends StandardSchemaV1 = StandardSchemaV1>(formProps: {
    schema: S;
    validationSchema?: Z & MatchesSchemaModel<S, Z>;
} & MaybeRefProps<Omit<VfFormProps<S>, 'schema' | 'modelValue' | 'validationSchema'>> & EmitsToProps<VfFormEmits<S>> & Record<string, unknown>, model?: UseFormModelArg<SchemaToModel<S>>, vueform?: VueformInstance): UseFormReturn<S>;
export declare function useForm(formProps?: Record<string, any>, model?: UseFormModelArg<Record<string, any>>, vueform?: VueformInstance): UseFormReturn;
export {};

import type { VueformInstance } from '../helpers';

/**
 * Returns an instance over the http module configured via `config.$http` (the
 * module's `make()`): the full client surface plus `onRequest` / `onResponse`
 * interceptors that apply only to this instance's calls — form submissions,
 * autosave, and other instances are untouched, and the interceptors are
 * released with the instance. App-wide interceptors belong in the `$http`
 * config.

 * component's instance. Pass your `createVueform()` instance to use it anywhere

 * returned instance's requests reject with a descriptive error instead, so

 *   component context.

export declare function useHttp(vueform?: VueformInstance): HttpInstance;

//// composables/useItemsSource.d.ts
import { type MaybeRef } from 'vue';
import type { ItemsProp } from '../features';
import type { ConditionsTriggerProp } from '../modules/conditions';
import type { ExpressionableKeys } from '../types';
/**
 * Options for resolving a raw items source (plain data, endpoint URL, or
 * function) into loaded data.
 */
type UseItemsSourceOptions = {
    /**
     * Reactive props describing the items source and its loading behavior.
     */
    props: {
        /**
         * The raw items source: plain data, an endpoint URL string (supporting
         * expressions), or a (possibly async) function receiving the component
         * context.
         */
        items: MaybeRef<ItemsProp> | undefined;
        /**
         * The source that triggers re-resolution of function-based items. Accepts
         * an array of element paths whose values are watched, a `Ref`, or a
         * function used as a watch getter.
         */
        itemsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp;
        /**
         * The debounce delay in milliseconds applied before re-resolving items when
         * an expression path or trigger source changes.
         */
        itemsDebounce?: number;
        /**
         * Custom HTTP headers to include when loading items from an endpoint.
         */
        headers?: Record<string, string>;
        /**
         * The HTTP method to use when loading items from an endpoint. Defaults to
         * `'GET'`.
         */
        method?: string;
        /**
         * Transforms data received from an endpoint or function into the items
         * format before normalization.
         */
        transformItems?: (data: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>;
    };
    /**
     * The expressionable prop key checked against the expression allow list when
     * the source is an endpoint URL. Defaults to `'items'`.
     */
    key?: ExpressionableKeys;
    /**
     * Whether to resolve the source immediately on setup. Defaults to `true`.
     */
    immediate?: boolean;
};
/**
 * Resolves a raw items source into loaded data. Plain arrays and objects are
 * passed through, endpoint URL strings are fetched via HTTP (with expression
 * resolution and automatic refetching when referenced paths change), and
 * (async) functions are invoked with the component context. Re-resolution can
 * be driven by an optional trigger source with debouncing.
 *
 * @private
 * @param options Items source configuration object.
 */
export declare function useItemsSource(options: UseItemsSourceOptions): {
    resolving: import("vue").ShallowRef<boolean, boolean>;
    resolvedItems: import("vue").ShallowRef<Record<string, any>, Record<string, any>> | import("vue").ShallowRef<any[], any[]>;
    resolveItems: () => void;
};
export {};

//// composables/useMessageBag.d.ts
import { type ComputedRef } from 'vue';
/**
 * A reactive bag of user-facing error and message strings with prepend/append
 * ordering and index-based removal.
 */
export type MessageBagInstance = {
    /**
     * Prepended errors and messages storage.
     */
    prepends: {
        errors: string[];
        messages: string[];
    };
    /**
     * Appended errors and messages storage.
     */
    appends: {
        errors: string[];
        messages: string[];
    };
    /**
     * All current errors (prepended + appended).
     */
    errors: ComputedRef<string[]>;
    /**
     * All current messages (prepended + appended).
     */
    messages: ComputedRef<string[]>;
    /**
     * The first error string, or `undefined` if there are none.
     */
    error: ComputedRef<string>;
    /**
     * The first message string, or `undefined` if there are none.
     */
    message: ComputedRef<string>;
    /**
     * Adds a string to the front of the errors or messages list.
     *
     * @param msg The string to prepend.
     * @param type Whether to prepend an error or a message.
     * @param keep Whether to keep the message when clearing.
     */
    prepend: (msg: string, type?: 'error' | 'message', keep?: boolean) => void;
    /**
     * Adds a string to the end of the errors or messages list.
     *
     * @param msg The string to append.
     * @param type Whether to append an error or a message.
     * @param keep Whether to keep the message when clearing.
     */
    append: (msg: string, type?: 'error' | 'message', keep?: boolean) => void;
    /**
     * Removes a specific string from the errors, messages, or both lists.
     *
     * @param msg The string to remove.
     * @param type Which list(s) to search — `'any'` searches both.
     */
    remove: (msg: string, type?: 'error' | 'message' | 'any') => void;
    /**
     * Removes an item by index from a specific group and type.
     *
     * @param group Whether to target prepended or appended items.
     * @param type Whether to target errors or messages.
     * @param index The index of the item to remove.
     */
    rm: (group: 'prepends' | 'appends', type: 'errors' | 'messages', index: number) => void;
    /**
     * Clears all errors, all messages, or both from the bag.
     *
     * @param type Which list(s) to clear.
     */
    clear: (type?: 'all' | 'errors' | 'messages') => void;
    /**
     * Clears only prepended errors, messages, or both.
     *
     * @param type Which prepended list(s) to clear.
     */
    clearPrepended: (type?: 'all' | 'errors' | 'messages') => void;
    /**
     * Clears only appended errors, messages, or both.
     *
     * @param type Which appended list(s) to clear.
     */
    clearAppended: (type?: 'all' | 'errors' | 'messages') => void;
    /**
     * Returns a plain snapshot of the current prepend/append contents.
     */
    snapshot: () => MessageBagSnapshot;
    /**
     * Replaces the current contents with a previously captured snapshot.
     *
     * @param data The snapshot to restore.
     */
    restore: (data: MessageBagSnapshot) => void;
};
/**
 * A serializable snapshot of a message bag's prepend/append contents.
 */
export type MessageBagSnapshot = {
    /**
     * Snapshot of prepended errors and messages.
     */
    prepends: {
        errors: string[];
        messages: string[];
    };
    /**
     * Snapshot of appended errors and messages.
     */
    appends: {
        errors: string[];
        messages: string[];
    };
};
/**
 * Creates a new message bag: reactive prepend/append storage for user-facing
 * error and message strings, owned by the caller. Every call returns a fresh,
 * independent bag — elements create one each for their custom errors and
 * messages.
 *
 * Callable anywhere; it has no configuration and no app dependency.
 *
 * @private
 */
export declare function useMessageBag(): MessageBagInstance;

//// composables/useModel.d.ts
import type { ArraySchema, DeepPartial, ExactValidatedSchema, MatchesSchemaModel, ObjectSchema, SchemaToModel, StandardSchemaV1 } from '../types';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';
import { type ModelInstance } from '../modules/model';
/**
 * Creates a standalone form model from a schema: the full data shape is built
 * up front from the elements' model metadata (defaults, null values,
 * translatable expansion), without mounting any components.
 *
 * Resolves the Vueform instance of the calling component, so it is setup-only.
 * Outside a component — stores, utilities, server code, module scope — use your
 * instance directly: `vueform.useModel(schema, data)`.
 *
 * The returned instance owns the data and exposes the familiar data API
 * (`update` / `load` / `clear` / `reset` / `clean`, `dirty` / `empty`,
 * path-based `get` / `set`, `toJSON` / `toFormData`). Passing it to a form's
 * `v-model` (or `useForm`) makes the form adopt it — the same store is shared
 * without cloning, and `submit()` becomes available.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const model$ = useModel(schema, { name: 'John' })
 *
 * model$.model.name // 'John'
 * model$.set('email', 'john@example.com')
 * model$.dirty // true
 * ```
 *
 * @private
 * @param schema The form schema describing the model's shape. When a
 *   ref/computed is passed (e.g. from `defineComputedSchema`), the instance
 *   follows schema changes: added elements seed their defaults, removed
 *   elements drop their data, validation/conditions/expressions re-wire —
 *   existing values and expression untrack state survive.
 * @param model Initial (partial) data cloned over the schema defaults. A Vue
 *   ref is rejected (dev warn, seed ignored) — pass a plain or reactive object.
 *   Later mutations of the seed are ignored.
 * @param validationSchema A Standard Schema (Zod, Valibot, ArkType, …) run by
 *   `validate()` against the whole model for form-level (cross-field)
 *   validation. Overrides a Standard Schema attached via `defineSchema`'s
 *   second argument.
 */
export declare function useModel<const S extends (ObjectSchema | ArraySchema) & ExactValidatedSchema<S>, Z extends StandardSchemaV1 = StandardSchemaV1>(schema: S | Ref<S>, model?: DeepPartial<SchemaToModel<S>> & Record<string, any>, validationSchema?: Z & MatchesSchemaModel<S, Z>): ModelInstance<S>;

//// composables/useOutlets.d.ts
import { type Component, type ComputedRef } from 'vue';
import type { ComponentProp } from '../types';
/**
 * Configuration options for the useOutlets composable.
 */
type UseOutletsOptions = {
    /**
     * An optional component or string that overrides the resolved template
     * entirely. When `null`, template resolution is disabled.
     */
    template?: string | Component | null;
    /**
     * An optional record of prop-based slot overrides keyed by slot name.
     * Normalized into outlets (HTML strings are sanitized, object components
     * patched with `inheritAttrs: false`).
     */
    slots?: Record<string, ComponentProp> | undefined;
};
/**
 * Return type for the useOutlets composable.
 */
type UseOutletsReturn = {
    /**
     * The merged and normalized outlets map. Includes a resolved `template` entry
     * from the template prop or `slots.template`.
     */
    outlets: ComputedRef<Record<string, any>>;
};
/**
 * Builds the standard outlets map every Vueform component exposes as
 * `context.outlets`: inline Vue template slots merged with normalized
 * prop-based slot overrides, plus the component template resolved into
 * `outlets.template`.
 *
 * Inline slots are included as-is (wrapped into VDOM-renderable slot functions
 * on vapor, where compiled slots return DOM blocks that VDOM consumers like
 * `<component :is>` can't render). Kebab-case slot names are normalized to
 * camelCase. Inline slots take priority over prop-based ones — the same order
 * the components' render pattern produces (`<slot name="x">` renders the inline
 * content and only falls back to the prop-based outlet), so `outlets.x` always
 * holds what actually renders.
 *
 * Slot overrides are normalized: a string entry listed in
 * `$security.allowComponents` is passed through for Vue to resolve as that
 * component; every other string is content — plain text renders escaped, and
 * HTML renders only through `$security.allowHtml` with the sanitizer applied
 * after expression resolution; object components are unwrapped via `toRaw` and
 * marked raw (so schemas held in refs or stores work without user-side
 * `markRaw`), and ones without an explicit `inheritAttrs: true` are patched to
 * `false` — through a per-original cache so the patched copy keeps its identity
 * across re-evaluations.
 *
 * Template resolution order (mirroring the documented component resolution):
 * inline `#template` slot, then the `template` prop (which config `defaults`
 * and presets feed like any other prop), then `slots.template`. A string
 * `template` prop goes through the same component allowlist.
 *
 * Called by `useBlueprint` for every component; blueprints only call it
 * directly to post-process the result (e.g. the layout blueprint resolving the
 * element's `layout` prop into `template`).
 *
 * @private
 * @param options Outlet resolution options.
 */
export declare function useOutlets(options: UseOutletsOptions): UseOutletsReturn;
export {};

//// composables/usePager.d.ts
import { type ComputedRef, type MaybeRef } from 'vue';
import { type VueformChildren } from './';
import type { ComponentProp, ElementName, EmitsToProps, NamedElementSchema, PageName } from '../types';
import { type EventListener, type TypeEmitsToOptions } from '../helpers';
/**
 * Event map for pager navigation actions.
 */
type PagerEmits = {
    /**
     * Fired after a page is selected.
     *
     * @param newPage The page being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page being navigated away from.
     */
    select: [newPage: ResolvedPage, oldPage: ResolvedPage];
    /**
     * Fired after a step transition (next or back).
     *
     * @param newPage The page being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page being navigated away from.
     */
    step: [newPage: ResolvedPage, oldPage: ResolvedPage];
    /**
     * Fired after navigating to the previous page.
     *
     * @param newPage The page being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page being navigated away from.
     */
    back: [newPage: ResolvedPage, oldPage: ResolvedPage];
    /**
     * Fired after advancing to the next page.
     *
     * @param newPage The page being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page being navigated away from.
     */
    next: [newPage: ResolvedPage, oldPage: ResolvedPage];
    /**
     * Fired when all pages are validated and the pager completes.
     */
    finish: [];
    /**
     * Fired when a page fails validation during navigation.
     *
     * @param page The page that failed validation.
     */
    invalid: [page: ResolvedPage];
    /**
     * Fired before a page selection is applied. Return `false` to cancel.
     *
     * @param newPage The page about to be navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page about to be navigated away from.
     */
    beforeSelect: [newPage: ResolvedPage, oldPage: ResolvedPage];
    /**
     * Fired before a step transition. Return `false` to cancel.
     *
     * @param newPage The page about to be navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page about to be navigated away from.
     */
    beforeStep: [newPage: ResolvedPage, oldPage: ResolvedPage];
    /**
     * Fired before navigating back. Return `false` to cancel.
     *
     * @param newPage The page about to be navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page about to be navigated away from.
     */
    beforeBack: [newPage: ResolvedPage, oldPage: ResolvedPage];
    /**
     * Fired before advancing to the next page. Return `false` to cancel.
     *
     * @param newPage The page about to be navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page about to be navigated away from.
     */
    beforeNext: [newPage: ResolvedPage, oldPage: ResolvedPage];
    /**
     * Fired before the pager finishes. Return `false` to cancel.
     */
    beforeFinish: [];
};
/**
 * Configuration options for the usePager composable.
 */
type UsePagesOptions = {
    /**
     * Whether pages must be completed in order. When `true`, users cannot skip
     * ahead to unvisited pages.
     */
    sequential?: MaybeRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether to integrate with browser history via `pushState`, enabling
     * back/forward navigation.
     */
    history?: MaybeRef<boolean | undefined>;
    /**
     * Whether the pager is active. When `false`, pager behavior is disabled.
     */
    active?: MaybeRef<boolean | undefined>;
    /**
     * The children registry providing access to registered child element
     * instances.
     */
    children: VueformChildren;
    /**
     * A computed array of page schemas, each containing the page's element props
     * and component definition.
     */
    schema: ComputedRef<{
        props: NamedElementSchema;
        component: ComponentProp;
    }[]>;
} & Partial<EmitsToProps<PagerEmits>>;
/**
 * A fully resolved page object containing its metadata, navigation state,
 * validation helpers, and keyboard/focus handlers.
 */
export type ResolvedPage = {
    /**
     * The resolved label text for the page tab.
     */
    label: string | undefined;
    /**
     * The metadata object from the page prop's tuple form (including `label`).
     * `undefined` when the page prop is a plain text value.
     */
    meta: Record<string, any> | undefined;
    /**
     * The element names contained in this page.
     */
    elements: ElementName[];
    /**
     * The unique name identifying this page.
     */
    name: PageName;
    /**
     * The zero-based index of this page in the page list.
     */
    index: number;
    /**
     * The HTML `id` for the page's tab element (accessibility).
     */
    pageId: string;
    /**
     * The HTML `id` for the page's panel element (accessibility).
     */
    panelId: string;
    /**
     * The tab's `tabindex` value for keyboard navigation.
     */
    tabindex: number;
    /**
     * Whether the page is currently available (visible).
     */
    available: boolean | boolean;
    /**
     * Whether this page is the currently selected page.
     */
    selected: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the page has been completed (validated without errors and not the
     * current page).
     */
    completed: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the page is enabled for navigation (based on sequential progress).
     */
    enabled: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the page has validation errors.
     */
    invalid: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the page is busy validating or processing an event.
     */
    loading: boolean;
    /**
     * The page's element component context, if registered.
     */
    el$: any | undefined;
    /**
     * Validates all elements within this page and returns whether it passed.
     */
    validate: () => Promise<boolean>;
    /**
     * Resets the validation state for all elements within this page.
     */
    unvalidate: () => void;
    /**
     * Selects this page, making it the active page.
     */
    select: () => void;
    /**
     * Handles keyboard navigation events on the page tab.
     *
     * @param $event The keyboard event to handle.
     */
    keydown: ($event: KeyboardEvent) => void;
    /**
     * Focuses the page tab for keyboard navigation.
     */
    focus: () => void;
    /**
     * Blurs the page tab, removing keyboard focus.
     */
    blur: () => void;
};
/**
 * The public API surface returned by `usePager`, providing page state,
 * navigation methods, validation, and event subscription.
 */
export type Pager = {
    /**
     * The name of the currently selected page.
     */
    page: PageName | undefined;
    /**
     * The name of the previously selected page.
     */
    oldPage: PageName | undefined;
    /**
     * The zero-based index of the currently selected page.
     */
    index: number;
    /**
     * Whether the pager is active and should render pages.
     */
    active: boolean;
    /**
     * The index of the last enabled page (used in sequential mode to track
     * progress).
     */
    lastEnabled: number;
    /**
     * Whether any page is currently loading (busy or has an event in progress).
     */
    loading: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether any page has validation errors.
     */
    invalid: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether pages must be navigated in sequential order.
     */
    sequential: boolean | undefined;
    /**
     * The array of resolved page objects containing metadata, state, and methods
     * for each page.
     */
    pages: ResolvedPage[];
    /**
     * The next available page after the current one, or undefined if none exists.
     */
    nextPage: ResolvedPage | undefined;
    /**
     * The previous available page before the current one, or undefined if none
     * exists.
     */
    previousPage: ResolvedPage | undefined;
    /**
     * The currently selected resolved page object.
     */
    currentPage: ResolvedPage | undefined;
    /**
     * The name of the last available page.
     */
    lastPage: PageName | undefined;
    /**
     * Selects a page by name or index, optionally reverting enabled state and
     * pushing to browser history.
     *
     * @param name The page name or index to select.
     * @param reverting Whether to allow reverting the last enabled index.
     * @param pushHistory Whether to push the selection to browser history.
     */
    select: (name: PageName, reverting?: boolean, pushHistory?: boolean) => Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Advances to the next available page after validating the current one.
     */
    next: () => Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Navigates back to the previous available page.
     */
    back: () => Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Completes the pager by validating all enabled pages and firing the `finish`
     * event.
     */
    finish: () => Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Resets the pager to the first page and unvalidates all subsequent pages.
     */
    reset: () => void;
    /**
     * Reverts the pager to a specific page, unvalidating all pages after it.
     *
     * @param page The page name or index to revert to.
     */
    revertTo: (page: PageName) => void;
    /**
     * Subscribes a callback to a specific event.
     *
     * @param e The event name.
     * @param callback The handler to invoke when the event fires.
     */
    on: EventListener<TypeEmitsToOptions<PagerEmits>>;
    /**
     * Removes a previously registered event callback.
     *
     * @param e The event name.
     * @param callback The handler to remove. Omit to remove all listeners for the
     *   event.
     */
    off: EventListener<TypeEmitsToOptions<PagerEmits>>;
    /**
     * Enables all pages up to the given page index, optionally allowing revert to
     * an earlier index.
     *
     * @param page The page name or index to enable up to.
     * @param allowRevert Whether to allow reverting to an earlier enabled index.
     */
    enableUntil: (page: PageName | undefined, allowRevert?: boolean) => void;
    /**
     * Returns the resolved page object for the given page name or index.
     *
     * @param page The page name or index to look up.
     */
    getPage: (page: PageName | undefined) => ResolvedPage | undefined;
};
/**
 * Manages multi-page form navigation with sequential/free-form modes,
 * validation, history, and keyboard support.
 *
 * @private
 * @param options Pager configuration object.
 */
export declare function usePager(options: UsePagesOptions): Pager;
export {};
