//// contexts/component.d.ts
import type { UnknownComponent } from '../types';
/**
 * Symbol key under which a component's exposed context carries its class
 * registrar. Lets `useClasses()` called from a custom template or slot add
 * class definitions to the host component without the registrar becoming part
 * of the public context surface.
 */
export declare const CLASS_REGISTRAR: unique symbol;
/**
 * Symbol key under which a component's exposed context carries its base class
 * setter. Lets the element layout (`VfLayout`) install the shared wrapper
 * classes (`root`, `label`, `errors`, …) at the bottom of the host element's
 * class chain — below `reclass`, which replaces them, and `classes`, which
 * merges on top — without the setter becoming part of the public context
 * surface.
 */
export declare const BASE_CLASS_REGISTRAR: unique symbol;
/**
 * Marks a value placed on a context's raw object as opaque to Vue's reactivity.
 * The rule this enforces: `ref(context)` (or a deep reactive collection holding
 * a context) builds Vue's `reactive()` view over the raw object, and that view
 * would wrap any plain object it reaches — so whatever lands on the raw object
 * and is not reactive state is `markRaw`ed at placement. A no-op for
 * non-objects, refs, Vue proxies (incl. other contexts), and already-marked
 * objects, so shared values (the config) are only reshaped once.
 *
 * @param value The value being placed on a context's raw object.
 */
export declare function opaque<T>(value: T): T;
/**
 * Creates and provides the component's public context: a proxy over the object
 * the component later hands to `defineExpose` (`toRaw(context)`) with Vue's
 * `proxyRefs` semantics — ref members read unwrapped and write through on
 * assignment — plus one rule of its own: a read of a member the blueprint has
 * not assigned yet subscribes to the context's readiness, so effects that saw a
 * half-built sibling (a list row reading another row's model through the
 * registry) re-run once the API is in place.
 *
 * Deliberately not `reactive()`: that would track a dependency per key on the
 * context itself for every property read in every render — a Dep and a Link per
 * key per component on top of the refs' own tracking, measured at +40–85% mount
 * time. The proxy answers Vue's `__v_raw` probe, so `isProxy`, `toRefs`, and
 * `toRaw` work; storing it in a `ref` yields Vue's deep view over the raw
 * object rather than this proxy, as with `shallowReactive`.
 *
 * `form$`, the modules, and the resolved `props` are available from the start.
 * Idempotent within a single setup: a second call on the same instance returns
 * the already-created context (needed when both `useBlueprint` / `useProps`
 * create the context).
 */
export declare function createComponentContext(): UnknownComponent;
/**
 * Marks a context as fully assembled: effects that read members before the
 * blueprint assigned them re-run. Called by `useBlueprint` after the API has
 * been put in place.
 *
 * @param context The component context (proxy or raw).
 */
export declare function markContextReady(context: any): void;
/**
 * Injects the nearest ancestor's component context, throwing if none is
 * available.
 *
 * @context
 */
export declare function useComponentContext(): UnknownComponent;

//// contexts/container.d.ts
import { type MaybeRef, type Ref } from 'vue';
import type { Pager, VueformChildren } from '../composables';
/**
 * Context for a container component (form, list, group, etc.) managing child
 * registration, model, and visibility.
 */
export type ContainerContext = {
    /**
     * The unique identifier of the container component.
     */
    id: Ref<string>;
    /**
     * The children registry managing child element instances.
     */
    children?: VueformChildren;
    /**
     * The reactive model value managed by this container.
     */
    model: Ref<any>;
    /**
     * The pager instance when the container uses pagination (e.g. steps).
     */
    pager?: Ref<Pager | undefined>;
    /**
     * Whether the container is available (not excluded by conditions).
     */
    available: Ref<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether the container is visible in the DOM.
     */
    visible: Ref<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether the container is disabled, propagating to all children.
     */
    disabled: Ref<boolean>;
    /**
     * The dot-separated path used for data binding.
     */
    dataPath: Ref<string>;
    /**
     * The dot-separated path used for element lookup.
     */
    path: Ref<string>;
    /**
     * The container type identifier (e.g. `root`, `list`, `group`).
     */
    type: keyof ContainerTypes;
    /**
     * Registers a child element context within this container.
     *
     * @param context$ The child element context$ to register.
     * @param path The element's lookup path.
     * @param dataPath The element's data-binding path.
     * @param initialModel The initial model value for the element.
     */
    register: (context$: any, path: string, dataPath?: string, initialModel?: any) => void;
    /**
     * Unregisters a child element from this container.
     *
     * @param path The element's lookup path.
     * @param dataPath The element's data-binding path.
     * @param instance When provided, registry entries are only removed if they
     *   still belong to this instance (prevents deleting a sibling's registration
     *   after paths were re-keyed by a reorder).
     */
    unregister: (path: string, dataPath?: string, instance?: any) => void;
    /**
     * Updates the model value at the given data path.
     *
     * @param dataPath The dot-separated data path to update.
     * @param value The new value to set.
     */
    update: (dataPath: string, value: any) => void;
    /**
     * Subscribes a callback to changes at the given absolute data path. Delegates
     * up the container chain to the root model's path-keyed registry. Returns an
     * unsubscribe function.
     *
     * @param dataPath The absolute dot-separated data path to listen on.
     * @param cb The callback invoked when the path's subtree changes.
     */
    subscribe: (dataPath: string, cb: () => void) => () => void;
};
/**
 * Maps container type identifiers to their corresponding component types.
 */
export interface ContainerTypes {
    /**
     * The root form container.
     */
    root: any;
    /**
     * A holder group container (eg. checkboxes and radios).
     */
    holder: any;
    /**
     * A grid layout container.
     */
    grid: any;
    /**
     * A list container managing repeatable elements.
     */
    list: any;
    /**
     * A matrix container for tabular input layouts.
     */
    matrix: any;
    /**
     * A group container.
     */
    group: any;
    /**
     * A transparent input container forwarding registration to its parent while
     * tracking opted-in descendants (e.g. addons) that push their errors up.
     */
    input: any;
}
/**
 * Options for creating a container element context.
 */
type CreateContainerContextOptions = {
    /**
     * The container type identifier (e.g. `root`, `list`, `group`).
     */
    type: keyof ContainerTypes;
    /**
     * The unique identifier of the container component.
     */
    id: Ref<string>;
    /**
     * The reactive model value managed by this container.
     */
    model: Ref<any>;
    /**
     * The dot-separated path used for data binding.
     */
    dataPath?: MaybeRef<string>;
    /**
     * The dot-separated path used for element lookup.
     */
    path?: MaybeRef<string>;
    /**
     * The pager instance when the container uses pagination.
     */
    pager?: MaybeRef<Pager | undefined>;
    /**
     * Whether the container is available (not excluded by conditions).
     */
    available?: MaybeRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether the container is visible in the DOM.
     */
    visible?: MaybeRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether the container is disabled, propagating to all children.
     */
    disabled?: MaybeRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * The children registry for managing child element instances.
     */
    children?: VueformChildren;
    /**
     * The parent container context to delegate registration to.
     */
    container?: ContainerContext;
    /**
     * Custom register function overriding the default registration behavior.
     *
     * @param context$ The child element context to register.
     * @param path The element's lookup path.
     * @param dataPath The element's data-binding path.
     * @param initialModel The initial model value for the element.
     */
    register?: (context$: any, path: string, dataPath?: string, initialModel?: any) => void;
    /**
     * Custom unregister function overriding the default unregistration behavior.
     *
     * @param path The element's lookup path.
     * @param dataPath The element's data-binding path.
     * @param instance When provided, registry entries are only removed if they
     *   still belong to this instance.
     */
    unregister?: (path: string, dataPath?: string, instance?: any) => void;
    /**
     * Custom update function overriding the default model update behavior.
     *
     * @param dataPath The dot-separated data path to update.
     * @param value The new value to set.
     */
    update?: (dataPath: string, value: any) => void;
    /**
     * Custom subscribe function overriding the default delegation to the parent
     * container. Provided by the root container to expose the root model's
     * path-keyed change registry.
     *
     * @param dataPath The absolute dot-separated data path to listen on.
     * @param cb The callback invoked when the path's subtree changes.
     */
    subscribe?: (dataPath: string, cb: () => void) => () => void;
};
/**
 * Creates and provides a container context with child registration, model
 * binding, and visibility tracking.
 *
 * @param options Container context configuration including type, model, and
 *   optional parent container.
 */
export declare function createContainerContext(options: CreateContainerContextOptions): ContainerContext;
/**
 * Injects the nearest ancestor container's context, providing access to the
 * container's model, child registration, and visibility state.
 *
 * @context
 */
export declare function useContainerContext(): ContainerContext | undefined;
export {};

//// features/button/types.d.ts
import type { DProp, LooseContext, TProp } from '../../types';
/**
 * @write
 */
export interface BtnProps<TContext = any> {
    /**
     * The label text displayed on the button.
     */
    text?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The action performed when the button is clicked. Use `'submit'` to submit
     * the parent form or `'reset'` to reset it. Custom string values can be used
     * for application-specific actions handled via the `click` event.
     */
    action?: 'submit' | 'reset' | (string & {});
    /**
     * Horizontal alignment of the button within its container.
     */
    align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right';
    /**
     * The icon to display inside the button.
     */
    icon?: DProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The position of the icon relative to the button label.
     */
    iconPos?: 'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom';
    /**
     * When set the button renders as an `<a>` element instead of `<button>`.
     */
    href?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * The `target` attribute for the anchor element.
     */
    target?: string;
    /**
     * The `rel` attribute for the anchor element.
     */
    rel?: string;
    /**
     * The `download` attribute for the anchor element.
     */
    download?: string | boolean;
    /**
     * Route location to navigate to when using `vue-router`.
     */
    to?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Whether the button spans the full width of its container.
     */
    fluid?: boolean;
}
/**
 * @write
 */
export interface BtnEmits {
    /**
     * Emitted when the button is clicked.
     *
     * @param event The native mouse event.
     * @param context$ The element's component context.
     */
    click: [event: MouseEvent, context$: LooseContext];
}

//// features/element/element.d.ts
import type { ConditionalProp, ConditionsTriggerProp } from '../../modules/conditions';
import type { BaseComponentClasses, BaseComponentEmits, BaseComponentExpose, BaseComponentParts, BaseComponentProps, BaseComponentSlots, ElementName, ExpressionsProp, LooseContext, TProp } from '../../types';
/**

 */
export interface BaseElementProps<T extends string, S, P, C, TContext = any> extends BaseComponentProps<S, P, C, TContext> {
    /**
     * The element type identifier.
     */
    type?: T;
    /**
     * The element's unique identifier and path in the current level of form data
     * model.
     */
    name: ElementName;
    /**
     * The HTML `id` attribute for the input element.
     */
    id?: TProp<string, TContext>;
    /**
     * Conditions that control the element's visibility and availability.
     */
    conditions?: ConditionalProp<TContext>;
    /**
     * The source that triggers re-evaluation of this element's async conditional
     * props (`conditions`, `disabled`, `readonly`, and validation rule
     * conditions). Accepts an array of element paths whose values are watched, a
     * `Ref`, or a function used as a watch getter. When omitted, any change in
     * the form model re-triggers evaluation.
     */
    conditionsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp<TContext>;
    /**
     * The debounce delay in milliseconds applied before re-evaluating this
     * element's async conditional props when the trigger source changes.
     * Overrides the global `$conditions.debounce` config (default `300`).
     */
    conditionsDebounce?: number;
    /**
     * Whether the element is detached from the form's element registry and data
     * model (if applicable).
     */
    detached?: boolean;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    expressions?: ExpressionsProp;
}
/**
 * Base events emitted by all form element types.
 */
export interface BaseElementEmits<TContext = LooseContext> extends BaseComponentEmits<TContext> {
}
/**
 * Base slots shared by all form element types. Threads `TContext` through to
 * `BaseComponentSlots` (including the `#template` slot).
 */
export interface BaseElementSlots<TContext = LooseContext> extends BaseComponentSlots<TContext> {
}
export interface BaseElementParts extends BaseComponentParts {
}
export interface BaseElementClasses extends BaseComponentClasses {
}
export interface BaseElementExpose extends BaseComponentExpose {
}

//// features/input/makeInput.d.ts
import { type MaybeRefOrGetter } from 'vue';
import type { makeData, makeInteraction } from '..';
import type { LooseContext, ReturnsOf } from '../../types';
import { type FeatureEvents } from '../../helpers';
/**
 * @write
 */
interface MakeInputOptions {
    deps: ReturnsOf<[
        [typeof makeData, ['onUserInput', 'update', 'value']]
    ], [
        [typeof makeInteraction, ['handleFocus', 'handleBlur']]
    ]>;
    events: FeatureEvents<{
        input: [value: any, e: Event | undefined, context$: LooseContext];
    }>;
}
/**
 * Configuration for the input factory.
 */
export type MakeInputConfig = {
    /**
     * Whether the registered input's DOM value is the model's own serialization —
     * i.e. copying the DOM value into the model as-is is always safe. When on
     * (the default), `handleInput` may adopt values resolved from native events,
     * and the registered input gains recovery listeners that pick up value
     * changes no bound event reported (change-only autofill, password managers,
     * the composition trailing edge without `v-model`). Blueprints whose DOM
     * shows a _formatted_ representation (masks, formatted dates) must pass
     * `false` — for them the DOM string is display, not data.
     *
     * Accepts a ref/getter so the answer can change at runtime (e.g. a `mask`
     * prop appearing on a text element).
     */
    canonicalDomValue?: MaybeRefOrGetter<boolean>;
};
/**
 * Provides the user-input pipeline: the template ref to the underlying input,
 * the unified `handleInput` intent handler, DOM recovery for value changes no
 * bound event reported, and the spreadable binding bags.
 */
export declare const makeInput: (config?: MakeInputConfig | undefined) => (options: MakeInputOptions) => {
    input: import("vue").Ref<any, any>;
    setInputRef: (el: any) => void;
    canonicalDomValue: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
    handleInput: (payload: any, e?: Event) => void;
    inputBindings: import("vue").ComputedRef<{
        ref: (el: any) => void;
        onBlur?: ((e: Event) => void) | undefined;
        onFocus?: ((e: Event) => void) | undefined;
        onInput: (payload: any, e?: Event) => void;
    }>;
    componentBindings: import("vue").ComputedRef<{
        onBlur?: ((e: Event) => void) | undefined;
        onFocus?: ((e: Event) => void) | undefined;
        modelValue: any;
        'onUpdate:modelValue': (value: any) => void;
    }>;
};
export {};

export * from './makeItems';

//// features/items/makeItems.d.ts
import { type ComputedRef, type MaybeRef, type Ref, type ShallowRef } from 'vue';
import { type ItemsProp, type ItemValueOf, type ItemsGenericsBrand, type RawItemOf } from './types';
import type { makeData, MakeDataModelApi } from '..';
import type { ReturnsOf } from '../../types';
import { type ConditionsResult, type ConditionsTriggerProp } from '../../modules/conditions';
/**
 * Intermediate normalized item before conditions/disabled are resolved.
 */
type NormalizedItem = {
    $raw: any;
    value: any;
    label: string;
};
/**
 * Extracts the item value from a raw item. A string key or a mapping function.
 */
export type ItemValue = string | ((item: any) => any);
/**
 * Extracts the item label from a raw item. A string key or a mapping function.
 */
export type ItemLabel = string | ((item: any) => string);
/**
 * Determines whether an item is disabled. A string key for direct property
 * lookup, or a function returning a `ConditionalProp` for reactive evaluation.
 */
export type ItemDisabled = string | ((item: any) => ConditionsResult | undefined);
/**
 * Determines whether an item is available (visible). A string key for direct
 * property lookup, or a function returning a `ConditionalProp` for reactive
 * evaluation. Items whose conditions are not met are omitted from the list.
 */
export type ItemConditions = string | ((item: any) => ConditionsResult | undefined);
/**
 * Determines whether a group is available. A string key for direct property
 * lookup, or a function returning a `ConditionalProp`. Groups whose conditions
 * are not met are omitted entirely.
 */
export type GroupConditions = string | ((group: any) => ConditionsResult | undefined);
/**
 * Resolves the label for a group. A string key or a mapping function.
 */
export type GroupLabel = string | ((group: any) => string);
/**
 * Resolves the children items from a group. A string key or a function
 * returning children in any ItemsProp format.
 */
export type GroupChildren = string[] | string | ((group: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>);
/**
 * A normalized item with resolved value, label, and disabled state. Items
 * originating from an array of objects also include `$raw` with the original.
 */
export type ResolvedItem<TValue = any, TRaw = Record<string, any>> = {
    /**
     * The resolved option value.
     */
    value: TValue;
    /**
     * The resolved display label.
     */
    label: string;
    /**
     * Whether the option is currently disabled.
     */
    disabled: boolean;
    /**
     * Stable index key for the option within the flat item list.
     */
    key: number;
    /**
     * The original raw item object before normalization.
     */
    $raw?: TRaw;
};
/**
 * A resolved group containing a label, its normalized child items, and the
 * original group object as `$raw`.
 */
export type ResolvedGroup<TValue = any, TRaw = Record<string, any>> = {
    /**
     * The resolved group label.
     */
    label: string;
    /**
     * The group's normalized child items.
     */
    items: ResolvedItem<TValue, TRaw>[];
    /**
     * The original raw group object before normalization.
     */
    $raw: Record<string, any>;
};
/**
 * Configuration for the items factory that normalizes option items.
 */
type MakeItemsOptions = {
    props: {
        /**
         * Optional key (matches `ItemsProps`): may be absent on the props object.
         * When present, the value may still be `undefined`.
         */
        items?: MaybeRef<ItemsProp>;
        itemValue?: ItemValue;
        itemLabel?: ItemLabel;
        itemDisabled?: ItemDisabled;
        itemConditions?: ItemConditions;
        itemsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp;
        itemsDebounce?: number;
        conditionsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp;
        conditionsDebounce?: number;
        headers?: Record<string, string>;
        method?: string;
        groupLabel?: GroupLabel;
        groupChildren?: GroupChildren;
        groupConditions?: GroupConditions;
        multiple?: boolean;
        /**
         * @write
         */
        minLength?: number;
        transformItems?: (data: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>;
    };
    deps: ReturnsOf<[[typeof makeData, ['nullValue', 'update', 'model']]]>;
};
/**
 * Props generics carried by an items-based element, recovered from the
 * `ItemsGenericsBrand` heritage on `ItemsProps`. (`extends ItemsProps<infer…>`
 * re-infers a wide `itemValue` union and collapses values to `any`.)
 *
 * Matches against the named `ItemsGenericsBrand` interface — not an inline
 * `[itemsGenericsBrandKey]` object — so declaration emit can name the type in
 * deferred conditionals (computed symbol keys cannot be named across modules,
 * TS4023/TS4058).
 */
type ItemsGenericsOf<P> = P extends ItemsGenericsBrand<infer TItems, infer TItemValueKey, infer TGroupChildren, infer TItemValueReturn> ? {
    items: TItems;
    itemValueKey: TItemValueKey;
    groupChildren: TGroupChildren;
    itemValueReturn: TItemValueReturn;
} : {
    items: ItemsProp;
    itemValueKey: undefined;
    groupChildren: undefined;
    itemValueReturn: unknown;
};
type ItemValueFromProps<P> = ItemValueOf<ItemsGenericsOf<P>['items'], ItemsGenericsOf<P>['itemValueKey'], ItemsGenericsOf<P>['groupChildren'], ItemsGenericsOf<P>['itemValueReturn']>;
type RawItemFromProps<P> = RawItemOf<ItemsGenericsOf<P>['items'], ItemsGenericsOf<P>['groupChildren']>;
/**
 * Factory that normalizes option items (arrays, objects, arrays of objects)
 * into a uniform structure with resolved value, label, and disabled state.
 * Supports conditional disabled and conditional availability via
 * `ConditionalProp`. Automatically clears selected values whose items become
 * unavailable. Also exposes library-friendly `rawItems` plus label/value/
 * disabled accessors for adapters that forward options to third-party
 * components.
 */
type MakeItemsFn = <P extends MakeItemsOptions['props']>(options: {
    props: P;
    deps: MakeItemsOptions['deps'];
}) => MakeItemsReturn<P>;
/**
 * @write
 */
export type MakeItemsConfig = {
    /**
     * @write
     */
    conditions?: boolean;
    /**
     * @write
     */
    multiple?: boolean;
};
/**
 * Prop-dependent return type of `makeItems`. `items` / `groups` element types
 * follow the generics carried by `P` (typically via `ItemsProps`).
 */
export type MakeItemsReturn<P = MakeItemsOptions['props']> = {
    items: Ref<ResolvedItem<ItemValueFromProps<P>, RawItemFromProps<P>>[]>;
    groups: Ref<ResolvedGroup<ItemValueFromProps<P>, RawItemFromProps<P>>[]>;
    rawItems: ComputedRef<any[]>;
    resolvedItems: ShallowRef<any[] | Record<string, any>>;
    normalizedItems: ComputedRef<NormalizedItem[]>;
    selectedLabel: ComputedRef<string | string[] | undefined>;
    itemLabel: ComputedRef<string | ((item: any) => string) | undefined>;
    itemValue: ComputedRef<string | ((item: any) => any) | undefined>;
    itemDisabled: ComputedRef<string | ((item: any) => boolean) | undefined>;
    grouped: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    resolving: ShallowRef<boolean>;
    synthetic: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    resolveItems: () => void;
};
/**
 * Blueprint API overlay for elements that use `makeData` and `makeItems`.
 * Caches the wide `Base` (typically `ReturnType<typeof blueprint>`) and
 * re-binds the prop-dependent model slice plus `items` / `groups`.
 */
export type ItemsModelApi<Base, P> = Omit<Base, keyof MakeDataModelApi | 'items' | 'groups'> & MakeDataModelApi<P> & Pick<MakeItemsReturn<P>, 'items' | 'groups'>;
export declare const makeItems: (config?: MakeItemsConfig) => MakeItemsFn;
export {};

//// features/items/types.d.ts
import type { ConditionalProp, ConditionsTriggerProp } from '../../modules/conditions';
import type { EntryPropOf } from '../../types';
import type { MaybeRef, Ref } from 'vue';
/**
 * Type-only key carrying `ItemsProps` generics for consumers like
 * `MakeItemsReturn<P>`. A `unique symbol`, so it never appears among prop
 * completions. Never set (nor existing) at runtime.
 */
export declare const itemsGenericsBrandKey: unique symbol;
/**
 * Resolves the children collection from a group via a `groupChildren` key or
 * mapping function. Returns `never` when the key is not present on the group
 * (so invalid `groupChildren` values do not poison item inference).
 */
type ChildrenOfGroup<TGroup, TGroupChildren> = TGroupChildren extends undefined | never ? never : TGroupChildren extends keyof TGroup ? TGroup[TGroupChildren] : TGroupChildren extends (group: any) => infer R ? R : never;
/**
 * The raw items data after unwrapping functions and, when grouped, extracting
 * children via `groupChildren`. Falls back to the ungrouped items shape when
 * `groupChildren` is missing or not a valid group key.
 */
type FlatItemsData<TItems, TGroupChildren> = [TGroupChildren] extends [
    undefined | never
] ? UnwrappedItems<TItems> : [ChildrenOfGroup<GroupOf<TItems>, TGroupChildren>] extends [never] ? UnwrappedItems<TItems> : ChildrenOfGroup<GroupOf<TItems>, TGroupChildren>;
/**
 * Whether `T` is a plain object/record map (not an array, function, or string).
 */
type IsPlainRecord<T> = [T] extends [readonly any[]] ? false : [T] extends [(...args: any) => any] ? false : [T] extends [object] ? [T] extends [string] ? false : true : false;
/**
 * String keys available on an item object for `itemValue` / `itemLabel` / etc.
 * Falls back to `string` for non-object items.
 */
type ItemKeyOf<TItem> = [TItem] extends [Record<string, any>] ? Extract<keyof TItem, string> : string;
/**
 * Whether `TItemValueKey` is unset: either explicitly `undefined`, or still a
 * whole-constraint union (`string | undefined` / all item keys) left by an
 * uninferred Vue generic with no default.
 */
type IsUnsetItemValueKey<TItem, TItemValueKey> = [TItemValueKey] extends [
    undefined
] ? true : [ItemKeyOf<TItem> | undefined] extends [TItemValueKey] ? true : false;
/**
 * Resolves the selected value from an item given a string key and/or a mapper
 * return type.
 *
 * - Mapper return (`TItemValueReturn`) wins when it is not `unknown`.
 * - Otherwise a concrete string key picks `item[key]`.
 * - Otherwise (both unset) the whole item is used.
 * - A function type in the key slot is also accepted for type-level tests:
 *   `ItemValueOf<Items, (item: Item) => R>`.
 */
type ResolveItemValue<TItem, TItemValueKey, TItemValueReturn> = TItemValueKey extends (...args: any) => infer R ? R : unknown extends TItemValueReturn ? IsUnsetItemValueKey<TItem, TItemValueKey> extends true ? TItem : TItemValueKey extends keyof TItem ? TItem[TItemValueKey] : any : TItemValueReturn;
/**
 * Unwraps a `Ref` wrapper that may appear on a registry entry's `items`.
 */
type UnwrapEntryRef<T> = T extends Ref<infer V> ? V : T;
/**
 * Widens a literal scalar to its primitive.
 */
type WidenLiteral<T> = T extends string ? string : T extends number ? number : T extends boolean ? boolean : T extends bigint ? bigint : T;
/**
 * Recursively widens an `items` shape: literal scalars become primitives,
 * readonly arrays / tuples become mutable arrays, and object item prop values
 * are widened (keys are preserved, so record-map models and `itemValue` key
 * lookups keep working).
 *
 * Schema `items` are const-narrowed by `defineSchema`'s `const` type parameter
 * (indistinguishable from an explicit `as const`), which would otherwise lock
 * `modelValue` / `default` — and the element's `model` — to the exact item
 * literals. Registry-entry consumers widen instead: `items: [1, 2, 3]` yields a
 * `number` model, not `1 | 2 | 3`.
 */
type WidenItems<T> = T extends (...args: any) => any ? T : T extends readonly (infer E)[] ? WidenItems<E>[] : T extends object ? {
    -readonly [K in keyof T]: WidenItems<T[K]>;
} : WidenLiteral<T>;
/**
 * Type-parameter payload stored under `itemsGenericsBrandKey`.
 */
export type ItemsGenericsBrandPayload<TItems = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey = undefined, TGroupChildren = undefined, TItemValueReturn = unknown> = {
    items: TItems;
    itemValueKey: TItemValueKey;
    groupChildren: TGroupChildren;
    itemValueReturn: TItemValueReturn;
};
/**
 * Type-only brand carrying `ItemsProps` generics for `makeItems` consumers
 * (`extends ItemsProps<infer …>` re-infers a wide `itemValue` union and
 * collapses values to `any`, hence the brand).
 *
 * `ItemsProps` extends this behind a `@vue-ignore` heritage clause: the SFC
 * compiler skips it when generating runtime props (it cannot resolve symbol
 * members), while the type still flows through `defineProps` into the blueprint
 * props. The symbol key keeps it out of prop completions.
 */
export interface ItemsGenericsBrand<TItems = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey = undefined, TGroupChildren = undefined, TItemValueReturn = unknown> {
    [itemsGenericsBrandKey]?: ItemsGenericsBrandPayload<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn>;
}
/**
 * Whether `TItems` is still the unconstrained `ItemsProp` default (no concrete
 * items shape has been inferred yet).
 */
export type IsDefaultItems<TItems> = [TItems] extends [ItemsProp] ? [ItemsProp] extends [TItems] ? true : false : false;
/**
 * Unwraps function and async-function item sources to their resolved data
 * shape.
 */
export type UnwrappedItems<T> = T extends (...args: any[]) => infer R ? UnwrappedItems<Awaited<R>> : T;
/**
 * The group object type extracted from an array of groups.
 */
export type GroupOf<TItems> = UnwrappedItems<TItems> extends readonly (infer G)[] ? G extends Record<string, any> ? G : never : never;
/**
 * The effective raw item type resolved from `items` (and optional
 * `groupChildren`). Handles arrays, object maps, endpoint URLs, and function
 * sources.
 */
export type RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren = undefined> = IsDefaultItems<TItems> extends true ? any : FlatItemsData<TItems, TGroupChildren> extends infer D ? D extends string ? unknown : D extends readonly (infer E)[] ? E : IsPlainRecord<D> extends true ? {
    value: Extract<keyof D, string | number>;
    label: D[Extract<keyof D, string | number>];
} : unknown : unknown;
/**
 * The selected value type derived from `items` and an optional `itemValue` key
 * / mapper return.
 *
 * - Record map → the key type.
 * - Object array with `itemValue` unset → the whole item object (matches runtime
 *   when `itemValue` is omitted).
 * - Object array with a string `itemValue` → `item[itemValue]`.
 * - Object array with a mapper `itemValue` → the mapper's return type.
 * - Scalar array → the scalar type.
 */
export type ItemValueOf<TItems, TItemValueKey = undefined, TGroupChildren = undefined, TItemValueReturn = unknown> = IsDefaultItems<TItems> extends true ? any : UnwrappedItems<TItems> extends string ? any : IsPlainRecord<UnwrappedItems<TItems>> extends true ? Extract<keyof UnwrappedItems<TItems>, string | number> : RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren> extends infer Item ? Item extends Record<string, any> ? ResolveItemValue<Item, TItemValueKey, TItemValueReturn> : Item : any;
/**
 * The model value type for an items-based element. When `items` is an endpoint
 * URL string, `TModel` is used so `v-model` can drive inference; otherwise the
 * value is derived from `items` / `itemValue` / `multiple`.
 */
export type ItemsModel<TItems, TItemValueKey = undefined, TGroupChildren = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> = IsDefaultItems<TItems> extends true ? TModel : UnwrappedItems<TItems> extends string ? TModel : TMultiple extends true ? ItemValueOf<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn>[] : ItemValueOf<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn> | null;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for items-based elements.
 *
 * Always includes `NoInfer<ItemsModel<…>>` so `modelValue` / `default` /
 * `v-model` do not compete with `itemValue` (and `items`) when inferring
 * generics. An outer conditional around `NoInfer` (e.g. `IsDefaultItems ?
 * TModel : NoInfer<…>`) is resolved against unbound Vue type parameters and
 * never re-evaluated after inference — which collapsed the prop to `any`.
 *
 * Endpoint URL `items` also union in a naked `TModel` arm so `v-model` can
 * still drive `TModel` when the items shape is a string.
 */
export type ItemsModelProp<TItems, TItemValueKey = undefined, TGroupChildren = undefined, TMultiple extends boolean = false, TModel = any, TItemValueReturn = unknown> = NoInfer<ItemsModel<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TMultiple, TModel, TItemValueReturn>> | ([UnwrappedItems<TItems>] extends [string] ? TModel : never);
/**
 * Whether item/group key props are allowed for the given `items` shape.
 *
 * Gates `itemValue`, `itemLabel`, `itemDisabled`, `itemConditions`,
 * `groupLabel`, `groupChildren`, and `groupConditions`.
 *
 * Based on the unwrapped `items` shape only (not `groupChildren`), so an
 * invalid `groupChildren` value cannot disable enforcement of the other key
 * props.
 *
 * - Allowed for arrays of objects, endpoint URLs, and the unconstrained
 *   `ItemsProp` default.
 * - Forbidden for plain scalar arrays and plain object/record maps, which use a
 *   synthetic `{ value, label }` shape at runtime — those key props are not
 *   meaningful there.
 */
export type AllowsItemKeyProps<TItems> = IsDefaultItems<TItems> extends true ? true : UnwrappedItems<TItems> extends infer D ? D extends string ? true : D extends readonly (infer E)[] ? E extends Record<string, any> ? true : false : IsPlainRecord<D> extends true ? false : true : true;
/**
 * Allowed string keys for `itemValue` on the resolved item shape.
 *
 * Functions are intentionally excluded — they are typed via a separate
 * `TItemValueReturn` generic so the `item` parameter stays concrete (and
 * contextually typed) in inline arrows.
 */
export type AllowedItemValueKey<TItems, TGroupChildren = undefined> = ItemKeyOf<RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>>;
/**
 * Allowed type for item key props (`itemLabel`, `itemDisabled`, etc.) given an
 * item shape. String keys are only applicable to object items; function mappers
 * stay allowed for plain scalar arrays and record maps, where they receive the
 * synthetic `{ value, label }` item.
 */
export type ItemKeyProp<TItems, TGroupChildren, TReturn> = AllowsItemKeyProps<TItems> extends true ? ItemKeyOf<RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>> | ((item: RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>) => TReturn) : (item: RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>) => TReturn;
/**
 * Allowed type for group key props given an items shape. Resolves to `never`
 * for plain scalar arrays and plain object/record maps.
 */
export type GroupKeyProp<TItems, TReturn> = AllowsItemKeyProps<TItems> extends true ? [GroupOf<TItems>] extends [never] ? string | ((group: any) => TReturn) : Extract<keyof GroupOf<TItems>, string> | ((group: GroupOf<TItems>) => TReturn) : never;
/**
 * Allowed keys / mappers for `groupChildren`. When the group shape is unknown
 * (e.g. unconstrained `ItemsProp`), fall back to a loose string / mapper so the
 * prop stays assignable to runtime `GroupChildren` (`(group: any) => …`).
 */
export type AllowedGroupChildren<TItems> = [GroupOf<TItems>] extends [never] ? string | ((group: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>) : Extract<keyof GroupOf<TItems>, string> | ((group: GroupOf<TItems>) => any[] | Record<string, any>);
/**
 * Raw option items for select, checkbox group, and radio elements, supporting
 * shorthand scalars and full objects. Arrays may be mutable or `readonly` / `as
 * const` tuples so literal unions can drive `modelValue` inference.
 */
export type ItemsProp<TContext = any> = Record<string, string | number> | readonly any[] | string | ((context$: TContext) => any);
/**
 * Bound for the `TItemValueKey` generic of items-based elements: a string item
 * key, or `undefined` when unset.
 *
 * Intentionally simple so component `generic="…"` declarations stay readable.
 * Whether a key is actually valid for the current `items` shape is enforced by
 * the `itemValue` prop type itself (via `AllowedItemValueKey`), not by this
 * bound.
 */
export type ItemValueProp = string | undefined;
/**
 * Bound for the `TGroupChildren` generic of items-based elements: a group key,
 * a function mapping a group to its children, or `undefined` when unset.
 *
 * Intentionally simple so component `generic="…"` declarations stay readable.
 * Whether a key is actually valid for the current `items` shape is enforced by
 * the `groupChildren` prop type itself (via `AllowedGroupChildren`), not by
 * this bound.
 */
export type GroupChildrenProp = string | ((group: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>) | undefined;
/**
 * Resolves the `TItems` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's `items`
 * prop, widening const-narrowed literals via `WidenItems` (schema items do not
 * drive literal models). Missing / invalid values fall back to the
 * unconstrained `ItemsProp` (matching SFC generic defaults, so the model stays
 * wide).
 */
export type EntryItemsOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'items'> extends infer I ? [I] extends [undefined] ? ItemsProp : WidenItems<UnwrapEntryRef<I>> extends infer U extends ItemsProp ? U : ItemsProp : ItemsProp;
/**
 * Resolves the `TItemValueKey` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `itemValue` prop — the string-key arm only (mappers are typed via
 * `EntryItemValueReturnOf`).
 */
export type EntryItemValueKeyOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'itemValue'> extends infer IV ? [IV] extends [undefined] ? undefined : IV extends string ? IV : undefined : undefined;
/**
 * Resolves the `TItemValueReturn` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `itemValue` prop — the mapper-return arm (`unknown` = unset).
 */
export type EntryItemValueReturnOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'itemValue'> extends (...args: any) => infer R ? R : unknown;
/**
 * Resolves the `TGroupChildren` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `groupChildren` prop, coerced to the `GroupChildrenProp` bound.
 */
export type EntryGroupChildrenOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'groupChildren'> extends infer G ? G extends GroupChildrenProp ? G : undefined : undefined;
/**
 * Resolves a `TMultiple` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's `multiple`
 * prop, defaulting to the component's runtime default when absent or invalid.
 */
export type EntryMultipleOf<TEntry, TDefault extends boolean = false> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'multiple'> extends infer M ? M extends boolean ? M : TDefault : TDefault;
/**
 * Props for elements that resolve option items from arrays, objects, endpoints,
 * or functions.
 *
 * `itemValue` is split across two generics so Vue can contextually type the
 * mapper's `item` argument from `items` while still inferring the return type
 * into the model:
 *
 * - `TItemValueKey` — string property key
 * - `TItemValueReturn` — mapper return type (defaults to `unknown` = unset)
 */
export interface ItemsProps<TItems extends ItemsProp = ItemsProp, TItemValueKey extends ItemValueProp = undefined, TGroupChildren extends GroupChildrenProp = undefined, TItemValueReturn = unknown, TContext = any> extends /* @vue-ignore */ ItemsGenericsBrand<TItems, TItemValueKey, TGroupChildren, TItemValueReturn> {
    /**
     * The option items for the element.
     */
    items?: MaybeRef<TItems>;
    /**
     * Resolves the label for an item. A string key for property lookup, or a
     * function returning the label string. Not allowed for plain scalar arrays or
     * plain object/record maps.
     */
    itemLabel?: ItemKeyProp<TItems, TGroupChildren, string>;
    /**
     * Resolves the value for an item. A string key for property lookup, or a
     * function returning the value. Not allowed for plain scalar arrays or plain
     * object/record maps.
     *
     * Typed as `(TItemValueKey & AllowedItemValueKey) | AllowedItemValueKey |
     * ((item) => TItemValueReturn)` so:
     *
     * - string keys infer into `TItemValueKey` through the intersection, which also
     *   rejects keys missing from the item shape (the generic itself is only
     *   bounded by the simple `ItemValueProp`, so validation must happen here)
     * - keys remain assignable on the defaulted `ElementSchema` / `FormSchema`
     *   surface where `TItemValueKey` is still `undefined`
     * - mapper return types infer into `TItemValueReturn`
     * - the `item` parameter stays concrete and is contextually typed even for bare
     *   inline arrows (whose return type cannot drive generics under Vue's
     *   single-pass inference — annotate the param or use a named function for
     *   full model inference)
     */
    itemValue?: AllowsItemKeyProps<TItems> extends true ? (TItemValueKey & AllowedItemValueKey<TItems, TGroupChildren>) | AllowedItemValueKey<TItems, TGroupChildren> | ((item: RawItemOf<TItems, TGroupChildren>) => TItemValueReturn) : never;
    /**
     * Determines whether an item is disabled. A string key for property lookup,
     * or a function returning a `ConditionalProp`. Not allowed for plain scalar
     * arrays or plain object/record maps.
     */
    itemDisabled?: ItemKeyProp<TItems, TGroupChildren, ConditionalProp<TContext> | undefined>;
    /**
     * Determines whether an item is available. A string key for property lookup,
     * or a function returning a `ConditionalProp`. Items whose conditions are not
     * met are omitted from the list. Not allowed for plain scalar arrays or plain
     * object/record maps.
     */
    itemConditions?: ItemKeyProp<TItems, TGroupChildren, ConditionalProp<TContext> | undefined>;
    /**
     * Resolves the label for a group. A string key for property lookup on the
     * group object, or a function returning the label string. Not allowed for
     * plain scalar arrays or plain object/record maps.
     */
    groupLabel?: GroupKeyProp<TItems, string>;
    /**
     * Resolves the children items for a group. A string key for property lookup
     * on the group object, or a function returning the children in any
     * `ItemsProp` format. Not allowed for plain scalar arrays or plain
     * object/record maps.
     *
     * The intersection arm infers keys into `TGroupChildren` while rejecting keys
     * missing from the group shape (the generic itself is only bounded by the
     * simple `GroupChildrenProp`). The bare `AllowedGroupChildren` arm keeps keys
     * assignable on the defaulted `ElementSchema` / `FormSchema` surface where
     * `TGroupChildren` is still `undefined`.
     */
    groupChildren?: AllowsItemKeyProps<TItems> extends true ? (TGroupChildren & AllowedGroupChildren<TItems>) | AllowedGroupChildren<TItems> : never;
    /**
     * Determines whether a group is available. A string key for property lookup
     * on the group object, or a function returning a `ConditionalProp`. Groups
     * whose conditions are not met are omitted entirely. Not allowed for plain
     * scalar arrays or plain object/record maps.
     */
    groupConditions?: GroupKeyProp<TItems, ConditionalProp<TContext> | undefined>;
    /**
     * Custom HTTP headers to include when loading items from an endpoint.
     */
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    /**
     * The HTTP method to use when loading items from an endpoint. Defaults to
     * `'GET'`.
     */
    method?: string;
    /**
     * The source that triggers re-resolution of function-based items. Accepts an
     * array of element paths whose values are watched, a `Ref`, or a function
     * used as a watch getter. When omitted, function-based items are only
     * re-resolved when the `items` prop reference itself changes.
     */
    itemsTrigger?: ConditionsTriggerProp<TContext>;
    /**
     * The debounce delay in milliseconds applied before re-resolving
     * function-based items when the `itemsTrigger` source changes. Defaults to no
     * debounce (immediate re-resolution).
     */
    itemsDebounce?: number;
    /**
     * Transforms data received from an endpoint into the items format. When
     * `items` is a string (endpoint URL), the HTTP response data is passed
     * through this function before normalization.
     */
    transformItems?: (data: any) => any[] | Record<string, any>;
}
export {};

//// features/model/index.d.ts
export * from './makeData';
export type * from './types';

//// features/model/makeData.d.ts
import type { RulesProp, TRulesProp } from '../../modules/validation';
import type { Booleanish, ElementName, LanguagesProp, ReturnsOf, RuleMessagesProp } from '../../types';
import type { Ref, WritableComputedRef } from 'vue';
import { useData, type CastOption } from '../../composables';
import { type makeElement, type makeInteraction, type makeMultilingual } from '..';
import { type FeatureContext, type FeatureEvents } from '../../helpers';
/**
 * Keys returned by useData only when the element is a dynamic list (has the
 * `rows` option).
 */
type UseDataRepeatableKeys = 'items' | 'dragIndex' | 'dropIndex' | 'add' | 'remove' | 'sort';
/**
 * Keys returned by useData only when the element supports translation (has the
 * `translate` option).
 */
type UseDataTranslatableKeys = 'currentValidation' | 'invalidLanguages' | 'validateCurrent';
/**
 * The full return type of useData, including all conditional groups.
 */
type UseDataReturn = ReturnType<typeof useData>;
/**
 * The non-generic slice of the `useData` return shared by every default
 * `makeData` instantiation (model fields and conditional groups excluded).
 *
 * Hoisted to a module-level alias — unlike the generic-parameter `Base` of the
 * previous `MakeDataReturn<P, Base>` shape — so the heavy `Omit` over
 * `UseDataReturn` is computed and cached once instead of being re-derived per
 * prop instantiation. Only the small `MakeDataModelApi<P>` slice varies with
 * `P` (same structure `MakeItemsReturn<P>` uses).
 */
type MakeDataBase = Omit<UseDataReturn, UseDataRepeatableKeys | UseDataTranslatableKeys | keyof MakeDataModelApi>;
/**
 * `MakeDataBase` counterpart for repeatable elements (keeps list keys, drops
 * translatable keys).
 */
type MakeDataRepeatableBase = Omit<UseDataReturn, UseDataTranslatableKeys | keyof MakeDataModelApi> & Required<Pick<UseDataReturn, UseDataRepeatableKeys>>;
/**
 * `MakeDataBase` counterpart for translatable elements (keeps translate keys,
 * drops list keys).
 */
type MakeDataTranslatableBase = Omit<UseDataReturn, UseDataRepeatableKeys | keyof MakeDataModelApi> & Required<Pick<UseDataReturn, UseDataTranslatableKeys>>;
/**
 * `Required`, guarded for model types that mapped types can't process
 * member-wise: `null` / `undefined` and arrays pass through, and so does a
 * model whose `keyof` collapsed to `never` — the `NoInfer`-wrapped wide model
 * union, which blocks both mapped-type and conditional-type distribution and
 * would otherwise become `{}`.
 */
type RequiredModelOf<M> = M extends null | undefined ? M : M extends readonly any[] ? M : [keyof M] extends [never] ? M : Required<M>;
/**
 * Config flags for makeData controlling which optional return-type groups are
 * excluded. By default (no config), all groups are included.
 */
type MakeDataConfig = {
    /**
     * When `true`, repeatable-only keys (`items`, `dragIndex`, `dropIndex`,
     * `add`, `remove`, `sort`) are excluded from the return type.
     */
    repeatable?: true;
    /**
     * When `true`, translatable-only keys (`currentValidation`,
     * `invalidLanguages`, `validateCurrent`) are excluded from the return type.
     */
    translatable?: true;
    /**
     * When set, the model value is cast to the specified type before being stored
     * or read. Values that are `null` or `undefined` are not cast.
     */
    cast?: CastOption;
};
/**
 * Overloaded factory type for makeData. The overload order ensures:
 *
 * - Call sites match the most specific overload (narrowed return type)
 * - `FeatureReturn<typeof makeData>` picks the last overload (full return)
 *
 * Each overload returns a prop-generic inner function (like `makeItems`), so
 * model fields follow the blueprint's concrete `modelValue` type.
 */
interface MakeDataFeature {
    /**
     * Requires `rows` in deps, excludes translatable keys from the return type.
     *
     * @param config Config with `repeatable` set.
     */
    (config: {
        repeatable: true;
    }): <P extends MakeDataOptions<{
        repeatable: true;
    }>['props']>(options: FeatureContext<P, MakeDataOptions<{
        repeatable: true;
    }>['deps'], MakeDataOptions<{
        repeatable: true;
    }>['events']>) => MakeDataReturnRepeatable<P>;
    /**
     * Requires `translate` in props, excludes repeatable keys from the return
     * type.
     *
     * @param config Config with `translatable` set.
     */
    (config: {
        translatable: true;
    }): <P extends MakeDataOptions<{
        translatable: true;
    }>['props']>(options: FeatureContext<P, MakeDataOptions<{
        translatable: true;
    }>['deps'], MakeDataOptions<{
        translatable: true;
    }>['events']>) => MakeDataReturnTranslatable<P>;
    /**
     * Accepts optional cast config, returns the full type excluding repeatable
     * and translatable keys.
     *
     * @param config Optional config with `cast` set.
     */
    (config?: {
        cast?: CastOption;
    }): <P extends MakeDataOptions['props']>(options: FeatureContext<P, MakeDataOptions['deps'], MakeDataOptions['events']>) => MakeDataReturn<P>;
}
/**
 * Configuration for the data factory that wraps useData with the standard
 * factory props/deps/events pattern.
 *
 * The generic parameter narrows the options based on the factory config:
 *
 * - `{ repeatable: true }` makes `rows` required in deps.
 * - `{ translatable: true }` makes `translate` required in props.
 */
export type MakeDataOptions<C extends MakeDataConfig = {}> = {
    props: {
        name: ElementName;
        /**
         * The `v-model` value of the element.
         */
        modelValue: any;
        hoist: boolean | undefined;
        maxErrors: number | undefined;
        ruleMessages: RuleMessagesProp | undefined;
        submit: boolean | undefined;
        /**
         * Whether the element holds sensitive data, excluded from locally stored
         * autosave drafts.
         */
        sensitive?: boolean;
        /**
         * Validation rules to apply to the input.
         */
        rules: RulesProp | TRulesProp | undefined;
        /**
         * The default value of the element.
         */
        default?: any;
        /**
         * Whether the container nests its data under its own key in the form model.
         */
        nested?: boolean;
        /**
         * The value used when a boolean style input is "checked".
         */
        trueValue?: any;
        /**
         * The value used when a boolean style input is "unchecked".
         */
        falseValue?: any;
        /**
         * Whether the element allows picking multiple items (eg. multiselect,
         * multiple files).
         */
        multiple?: Booleanish;
        languages?: LanguagesProp | undefined;
        nullValue?: any;
        transformPayload: ((value: any, context$: any) => any) | undefined;
    };
    deps: ReturnsOf<[
        [
            typeof makeElement,
            [
                'container',
                'available',
                'path',
                'children',
                'id'
            ]
        ]
    ], [
        [typeof makeInteraction, ['touched']]
    ] & {
        nullValue?: Ref<any>;
    }> & (C extends {
        repeatable: true;
    } ? {
        rows: Ref<any[] | number>;
    } : {}) & (C extends {
        translatable: true;
    } ? ReturnsOf<[
        [
            typeof makeMultilingual,
            [
                'language',
                'languages',
                'translatable',
                'languageId'
            ]
        ]
    ]> : {});
    events: FeatureEvents<{
        reset: [context$: any];
        clear: [context$: any];
        load: [value: any, context$: any];
        change: [newValue: any, oldValue: any, context$: any];
        'update:modelValue': [value: any];
        valid: [context$: any];
        invalid: [context$: any];
    }>;
};
/**
 * Model type carried by data props (`modelValue`).
 *
 * Uses indexed access (not `infer` in a conditional) so unbound blueprint
 * `TProps` resolves through its constraint instead of staying opaque.
 */
export type ModelOfProps<P> = 'modelValue' extends keyof P ? Exclude<P['modelValue'], undefined> : any;
/**
 * The prop-dependent slice of the `makeData` return: model fields and mutators
 * following `P['modelValue']`. Single source of truth for model narrowing —
 * blueprints receive it automatically through `MakeDataReturn<P>` without any
 * per-component overlay.
 */
export type MakeDataModelApi<P = MakeDataOptions['props']> = {
    /**
     * The element's reactive model value within the form data tree.
     */
    model: Ref<ModelOfProps<P>>;
    /**
     * A snapshot of the model at initialization time.
     */
    initialModel: Ref<ModelOfProps<P>>;
    /**
     * The element's current value.
     */
    value: WritableComputedRef<ModelOfProps<P>>;
    /**
     * Updates the element's model value.
     *
     * @param data The new model value.
     */
    update: (data: ModelOfProps<P>) => void;
    /**
     * Loads data into the element's model.
     *
     * @param data The value to load.
     */
    load: (data: ModelOfProps<P>) => void;
};
/**
 * Prop-dependent return type of `makeData`. Model fields and mutators follow
 * `P['modelValue']` via `MakeDataModelApi`; everything else comes from the
 * cached non-generic base.
 */
export type MakeDataReturn<P = MakeDataOptions['props']> = MakeDataBase & MakeDataModelApi<P>;
/**
 * Repeatable `makeData` return (keeps list keys, drops translatable keys).
 */
export type MakeDataReturnRepeatable<P = MakeDataOptions['props']> = MakeDataRepeatableBase & MakeDataModelApi<P>;
/**
 * The prop-dependent slice of the translatable `makeData` return —
 * `MakeDataModelApi` counterpart for translatable elements.
 *
 * The `modelValue` prop may provide a partial locale object (optional keys),
 * but the runtime model always carries every language key — so `model` /
 * `initialModel` are `Required` versions of the prop shape. `update` / `load`
 * follow the `modelValue` prop shape via `MakeDataModelApi`.
 *
 * `TValue` is the type of the element's current value — the active language's
 * entry when translating, the model itself otherwise. It is supplied by each
 * blueprint from its own generics (text/textarea pass their fixed scalar, field
 * derives it from `nullValue`) rather than being dissected out of the model
 * type, which cannot distinguish a locale record from an object-shaped model
 * and collapses entirely on the `NoInfer`-wrapped wide model union.
 */
export type MakeDataModelApiTranslatable<P = MakeDataOptions['props'], TValue = any> = Pick<MakeDataModelApi<P>, 'update' | 'load'> & {
    /**
     * The element's reactive model value within the form data tree. Always
     * contains every language key for translatable elements.
     */
    model: Ref<RequiredModelOf<ModelOfProps<P>>>;
    /**
     * A snapshot of the model at initialization time.
     */
    initialModel: Ref<RequiredModelOf<ModelOfProps<P>>>;
    /**
     * The element's current value — the active language's entry for translatable
     * elements.
     */
    value: WritableComputedRef<TValue>;
};
/**
 * Translatable `makeData` return (keeps translate keys, drops list keys).
 */
export type MakeDataReturnTranslatable<P = MakeDataOptions['props'], TValue = any> = MakeDataTranslatableBase & MakeDataModelApiTranslatable<P, TValue>;
/**
 * Blueprint API overlay for elements that use `makeData` / `makeRData`. Caches
 * the wide `Base` (typically `ReturnType<typeof blueprint>`) and re-binds only
 * the prop-dependent model slice to `P`.
 */
export type ModelApi<Base, P> = Omit<Base, keyof MakeDataModelApi> & MakeDataModelApi<P>;
/**
 * Blueprint API overlay for elements that use `makeTData`. Same caching as
 * `ModelApi`, with the translatable model slice (`model` required per language,
 * `value` typed by the blueprint-supplied `TValue` — see
 * `MakeDataModelApiTranslatable`).
 */
export type TranslatableModelApi<Base, P, TValue = any> = Omit<Base, keyof MakeDataModelApiTranslatable> & MakeDataModelApiTranslatable<P, TValue>;
/**
 * Wraps useData with the standard factory props/deps/events pattern,
 * eliminating repetitive prop wiring in element factories.
 *
 * Pass a config object to exclude list-only or translatable-only keys from the
 * return type. When no config is provided, the full return type is used. Model
 * value field types follow `props.modelValue`.
 *
 * @param config Optional flags to exclude conditional return-type groups.
 */
export declare const makeData: MakeDataFeature;
/**
 * Data factory for repeatable (list) elements.
 */
export declare function makeRData(): <P extends MakeDataOptions<{
    repeatable: true;
}>["props"]>(options: FeatureContext<P, MakeDataOptions<{
    repeatable: true;
}>["deps"], MakeDataOptions<{
    repeatable: true;
}>["events"]>) => MakeDataReturnRepeatable<P>;
/**
 * Data factory for translatable elements.
 */
export declare function makeTData(): <P extends MakeDataOptions<{
    translatable: true;
}>["props"]>(options: FeatureContext<P, MakeDataOptions<{
    translatable: true;
}>["deps"], MakeDataOptions<{
    translatable: true;
}>["events"]>) => MakeDataReturnTranslatable<P>;
export {};

//// features/model/types.d.ts
import type { ExpressionString, LooseContext, FileProp } from '../../types';
/**
 * @write
 */
export type TextModel = string | null;
/**
 * @write
 */
export type TextArrayModel = string[];
/**
 * @write
 */
export type TextMaybeArrayModel = string | string[] | null;
/**
 * @write
 */
export type TextishModel = string | number | null;
/**
 * @write
 */
export type TextishArrayModel = (string | number)[];
/**
 * @write
 */
export type TextishMaybeArrayModel = string | number | null | (string | number)[];
/**
 * @write
 */
export type DateModel = Date | string | (Date | string)[] | null;
/**
 * Wide file model (single file, list, or empty). Prefer `FileModelOf` /
 * `FileModelProp` when the shape should follow a `multiple` prop.
 */
export type FileModel = FileProp | FileProp[] | null;
/**
 * File element model shaped by `multiple`:
 *
 * Values are `FileProp` (File instance, URL/filename string, or a FileObject
 * for pre-existing uploads) — the same contract the runtime normalizes.
 *
 * - `multiple: false` — `FileProp | null`
 * - `multiple: true` — `FileProp[]`
 * - `multiple` unset / wide `boolean` — `FileProp | FileProp[] | null`
 */
export type FileModelOf<TMultiple extends boolean = boolean> = [
    boolean
] extends [TMultiple] ? FileProp | FileProp[] | null : [TMultiple] extends [true] ? FileProp[] : FileProp | null;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for file elements — `NoInfer` so `modelValue` does
 * not compete with `multiple` when inferring generics.
 */
export type FileModelProp<TMultiple extends boolean = boolean> = NoInfer<FileModelOf<TMultiple>>;
/**
 * @write
 */
export type ObjectModel = Record<string, any>;
/**
 * @write
 */
export type ArrayModel = any[];
/**
 * A model value that supports multilingual content as a locale-keyed object, or
 * a plain scalar. Record values include `undefined` so partially provided
 * locale objects (optional keys) stay assignable — missing languages are
 * initialized by the element at runtime.
 */
export type TranslatableModel = Record<string, string | number | null | undefined> | string | number | null;
/**
 * Props for elements with a model value (`v-model`) and optional
 * submit/transform hooks. Use `ModelPropsWithDefault` when the element also has
 * a `default` prop — plain interfaces so Vue's SFC compiler can resolve
 * `extends` chains.
 */
export interface ModelProps<T = any, TContext = any> {
    /**
     * The current value of the element (v-model).
     */
    modelValue?: T;
    /**
     * Whether the element value is included in form submission data.
     */
    submit?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element holds sensitive data (passwords, payment details, …).
     * Sensitive values are excluded from locally stored autosave drafts. On a
     * container, the whole subtree is excluded.
     */
    sensitive?: boolean;
    /**
     * Transforms the element's value when submitting the form.
     *
     * @param value The raw value being submitted.
     * @param context$ The element's component context.
     */
    transformPayload?: (value: any, context$: TContext) => any;
}
/**
 * `ModelProps` plus a core-style `default` prop (same type as `modelValue`).
 */
export interface ModelPropsWithDefault<T = any, TContext = any> extends ModelProps<T, TContext> {
    /**
     * The default/initial value of the element. Being expressionable, a `{...}`
     * expression string is accepted alongside the model type.
     */
    default?: T | ExpressionString;
}
/**
 * @write
 */
export interface ModelEmits<T = any, TContext = LooseContext> {
    /**
     * Emitted when the element value changes.
     *
     * @param newValue The new element value.
     * @param oldValue The previous element value.
     * @param context$ The component context.
     */
    change: [newValue: T, oldValue: T, context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted to update the v-model binding.
     *
     * @param value The new model value.
     */
    'update:modelValue': [value: T];
    /**
     * Emitted when the element's value is loaded programmatically via the `load`
     * method.
     *
     * @param value The loaded model value.
     * @param context$ The element's component context.
     */
    load: [value: T, context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when the element is reset to its default value.
     *
     * @param context$ The element's component context.
     */
    reset: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when the element's value is cleared.
     *
     * @param context$ The element's component context.
     */
    clear: [context$: TContext];
}
/**
 * Props for the element's default/initial value.
 *
 * @deprecated Use `ModelPropsWithDefault` instead.
 */
export type DefaultProps<T = any> = Pick<ModelPropsWithDefault<T>, 'default'>;

//// features/tabs/types.d.ts
import type { PartOf, SlotPropsOf } from '../../types';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type Pager, type ResolvedPage } from '../../composables';
/**
 * Props for components that support tabbed navigation.
 */
export interface TabbedProps {
    /**
     * Whether to render the form in a tabbed layout.
     */
    tabbed?: boolean;
}
/**
 * Events emitted by components that support tabbed navigation.
 */
export interface TabbedEmits {
    /**
     * Emitted when the active tab changes.
     *
     * @param newPage The page being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page being navigated from.
     * @param pager The pager instance managing tab state.
     * @param context$ The component's context instance.
     */
    tab: [
        newPage: ResolvedPage,
        oldPage: ResolvedPage,
        pager: Pager,
        context$: any
    ];
    /**
     * Emitted before the active tab changes, allowing cancellation.
     *
     * @param newPage The page being navigated to.
     * @param oldPage The page being navigated from.
     * @param pager The pager instance managing tab state.
     * @param context$ The component's context instance.
     */
    beforeTab: [
        newPage: ResolvedPage,
        oldPage: ResolvedPage,
        pager: Pager,
        context$: any
    ];
}
export interface TabbedSlots {
    /**
     * Slot for customizing the tab navigation bar.
     *
     * @param props.pager The pager instance managing tab state.
     */
    tabs: (props: {
        pager: Pager;
    }) => VNode[];
    /**
     * Slot for customizing an individual tab button.
     *
     * @inherits VfTabs.default
     */
    tab: (props: SlotPropsOf<'VfTabs', 'default'>) => VNode[];
}
export interface TabbedParts {
    /**
     * Props forwarded to the nested VfTabs component.
     *
     * @tag VfTabs
     */
    tabs: PartOf<'VfTabs'>;
}

//// features/translate/makeMultilingual.d.ts
import { type Ref } from 'vue';
import type { makeElement } from '..';
import type { AddonSchema, LanguagesProp, ResolvedLanguagesProp, ReturnsOf } from '../../types';
/**
 * Configuration for the translatable factory handling language resolution and
 * the language selector addon.
 */
type makeMultilingualOptions = {
    props: {
        languages: LanguagesProp | undefined;
        language: string | undefined;
        translate: boolean | undefined;
    };
    deps: ReturnsOf<[[typeof makeElement, ['id']]]>;
};
/**
 * Provides translatable state, language resolution, and the language selector
 * addon schema for elements that support multilingual values.
 *
 * @param options Factory options containing element props and dependencies.
 */
export declare const makeMultilingual: (config?: unknown) => (options: makeMultilingualOptions) => {
    translateAddon: import("vue").ComputedRef<AddonSchema>;
    language: Ref<string, string>;
    languageId: import("vue").ComputedRef<string | undefined>;
    languages: Ref<ResolvedLanguagesProp, ResolvedLanguagesProp>;
    translatable: import("vue").ComputedRef<boolean>;
};

//// features/translate/types.d.ts
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { type LanguagesProp, type PartOf, type EntryPropOf } from '../../types';
/**
 * Resolves the `TTranslate` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `translate` prop. Missing / invalid values fall back to `false` (the runtime
 * default); wide payloads (`any`) resolve to `boolean`.
 */
export type EntryTranslateOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'translate'> extends infer T ? T extends boolean ? T : false : false;
/**
 * Resolves the `TLanguages` generic from a registry `TEntry` payload's
 * `languages` prop, falling back to the wide `LanguagesProp` when absent — so
 * `translate: true` without `languages` yields a `string`-keyed model.
 */
export type EntryLanguagesOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'languages'> extends infer L ? L extends LanguagesProp ? L : LanguagesProp : LanguagesProp;
/**
 * Props for elements that support multilingual/translatable values,
 * parameterized by the model-driving type arguments (`translate` /
 * `languages`). Plain usage (`TranslateProps`) keeps every member wide.
 */
export interface TranslateProps<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp> {
    /**
     * Whether the element's value is translatable into multiple languages.
     */
    translate?: TTranslate | boolean;
    /**
     * The default selected language.
     */
    language?: string;
    /**
     * The available languages for translatable content.
     */
    languages?: TLanguages;
}
/**
 * The model value type for a translatable element, derived from the `translate`
 * / `languages` props (and optional scalar `TScalar`, defaulting to `string |
 * number | null`):
 *
 * - `translate` unset or still the wide `boolean` — `TScalar` or a locale-keyed
 *   object of `TScalar` values (matches `TranslatableModel` for the default
 *   scalar).
 * - `translate: false` — `TScalar` only.
 * - `translate: true` — a locale-keyed object; keyed by the concrete `languages`
 *   prop keys when one is provided, otherwise `string` keys.
 *
 * Locale keys are optional — this is the input-side shape. The element
 * initializes missing languages at runtime, so the element's `model` (see
 * `MakeDataReturnTranslatable`) carries every key required.
 */
export type TranslateModel<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, TScalar = string | number | null> = [boolean] extends [TTranslate] ? TScalar | Record<string, TScalar | undefined> : [TTranslate] extends [true] ? [LanguagesProp] extends [TLanguages] ? Record<string, TScalar> : {
    [K in keyof TLanguages]?: TScalar;
} : TScalar;
/**
 * Model / default prop type for translatable elements.
 *
 * Wrapped in `NoInfer` so `modelValue` / `default` / `v-model` do not compete
 * with the `translate` / `languages` / scalar-driving props when inferring the
 * generics (mirrors `ItemsModelProp`).
 */
export type TranslateModelProp<TTranslate extends boolean = boolean, TLanguages extends LanguagesProp = LanguagesProp, TScalar = string | number | null> = NoInfer<TranslateModel<TTranslate, TLanguages, TScalar>>;
/**
 * Slot definitions for multilingual elements.
 */
export interface TranslateSlots {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the language selector rendering.
     *
     * @param props.language The currently active language code.
     * @param props.languages The available languages map.
     */
    language: (props: {
        language: string;
        languages: LanguagesProp;
    }) => VNode[];
}
/**
 * Part definitions for multilingual elements.
 */
export interface TranslateParts {
    /**
     * The language selector addon rendered alongside the input.
     *
     * @tag VfAddon
     */
    language: PartOf<'VfAddon'>;
}

/**
 * Props for elements that support validation rules and error display.
 */
export interface ValidationProps<TContext = any> {
    /**
     * Validation rules to apply to the element.
     */
    rules?: RulesProp<TContext>;
    /**
     * Whether to stop validation after the first failing rule.
     */
    bail?: boolean;
    /**
     * Custom error messages keyed by validation rule name.
     */

     * The display name used in validation error messages.
     */

     * Maximum number of validation errors to display at once.
     */
    maxErrors?: number;
    /**
     * Whether to hide validation error messages.
     */
    hideErrors?: boolean;
    /**
     * Where to show required field indicators (e.g. label, placeholder).
     */
    showRequired?: ShowRequiredProp;
    /**
     * Delay in milliseconds before processing input.
     */
    debounce?: number;
    /**
     * Whether to push the element's errors to its nearest ancestor element.
     */
    hoist?: boolean;
    /**
     * Controls when validation is triggered (e.g. on change, blur, or submit).
     */
    validateOn?: ElementValidateOnProp;
}

    valid: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted when the element becomes invalid.
     *
     * @param context$ The element's component context.
     */
    invalid: [context$: TContext];
