 * `getValidationModule` serves the inert `noopValidation` surface.
 */
export declare function hasValidationModule(vueform?: VueformInstance): boolean;

//// modules/validation/noop.d.ts
import type { ValidationModule } from './types';
/**
 * The inert validation surface used when the `validation` module is not
 * registered — behaves as if validation wasn't there at all: everything is
 * valid, policy predicates return `false`, views are static and empty. Warns
 * once in dev when rules are actually provided.
 */
export declare const noopValidation: ValidationModule;

//// modules/validation/symbols.d.ts
/**
 * Brand on `createRule` results so the validation compiler can distinguish them
 * from other callables (ArkType schemas, plain functions). Registered via
 * `Symbol.for` so rules created by a duplicated copy of core (e.g. a library
 * bundling its own) are still recognized.
 */
export declare const RULE_BRAND: unique symbol;

//// modules/validation/types.d.ts
import type { VueformInstance } from '../../helpers';
import type { ConditionalProp } from '../conditions';
import type { RULE_BRAND } from './symbols';
import type { ComputedRef } from 'vue';
import { type FormContext, type StatefulElement, type StandardSchemaV1 } from '../../types';
/**
 * Union of all known validation rule names — built-in rules plus any
 * user-registered custom rules from `CustomRules`.
 */
type RuleName = BuiltInRules | keyof CustomRules;
/**
 * A single validation rule string — either a bare rule name or a rule with
 * colon-separated parameters (e.g. `'min:3'`). Accepts custom rule names via
 * the `string & {}` fallback.
 */
type RuleString = RuleName | `${RuleName}:${string}` | (string & {});
type RequiredStringParamKeys<T extends readonly string[]> = {
    [I in keyof T]: T[I] extends `${string}$?` ? never : T[I] extends `${string}?` ? never : T[I] extends `${infer K}$` ? K : T[I];
}[number] & string;
type RequiredElementParamKeys<T extends readonly string[]> = {
    [I in keyof T]: T[I] extends `${infer K}$` ? T[I] extends `${string}?` ? never : `${K}$` : never;
}[number] & string;
type OptionalStringParamKeys<T extends readonly string[]> = {
    [I in keyof T]: T[I] extends `${infer K}?` ? T[I] extends `${string}$?` ? never : K : never;
}[number] & string;
type OptionalElementParamKeys<T extends readonly string[]> = {
    [I in keyof T]: T[I] extends `${infer K}$?` ? `${K}$` : never;
}[number] & string;
/**
 * Union of all built-in validation rule names shipped with Vueform.
 */
export type BuiltInRules = 'accepted' | 'after' | 'after_or_equal' | 'alpha' | 'alpha_dash' | 'alpha_num' | 'array' | 'before' | 'before_or_equal' | 'between' | 'boolean' | 'captcha' | 'confirmed' | 'date' | 'date_equals' | 'date_format' | 'different' | 'digits' | 'digits_between' | 'dimensions' | 'distinct' | 'email' | 'file' | 'filled' | 'gt' | 'gte' | 'image' | 'in' | 'in_array' | 'integer' | 'ip' | 'ipv4' | 'ipv6' | 'json' | 'lt' | 'lte' | 'max' | 'mimes' | 'mimetypes' | 'min' | 'not_in' | 'not_regex' | 'nullable' | 'numeric' | 'regex' | 'required' | 'same' | 'size' | 'string' | 'timezone' | 'url' | 'uuid';
/**
 * Value categories used for size-based validation rules.
 */
export type SizeTypes = 'array' | 'string' | 'number' | 'file' | undefined;
/**
 * Augmentable interface for registering custom validation rule names. Augment
 * this via module declaration merging to add autocomplete for custom rules:
 *
 * ```ts
 * declare module '@vueform/core' {
 *   interface CustomRules {
 *     phone: true
 *     slug: true
 *   }
 * }
 * ```
 */
export interface CustomRules {
}
/**
 * A rule or rule set that only runs when `$if` is met. `rules` accepts the same
 * forms as `RulesProp` (string, array, rule definition, Standard Schema).
 */
export type ConditionalRule<TContext = any> = {
    /**
     * The rule or rules to apply while `$if` is true.
     */
    rules: RulesProp<TContext>;
    /**
     * Conditions that must be met for `rules` to activate. Same syntax as element
     * `conditions`.
     */
    $if: ConditionalProp<TContext>;
};
/**
 * A validation rules definition as a pipe-separated string, a Standard Schema
 * (Zod, Valibot, ArkType, …), a rule definition, a conditional rule, or an
 * array of strings, conditional rules, rule definitions, or Standard Schemas.
 */
export type RulesProp<TContext = any> = RuleString | `${RuleName}|${string}` | `${RuleName}:${string}|${string}` | StandardSchemaV1 | RuleDefinition | ConditionalRule<TContext> | (RuleString | ConditionalRule<TContext> | RuleDefinition | StandardSchemaV1)[];
/**
 * RulesProp keyed by language for multilingual validation.
 */
export type TOnlyRulesProp<TContext = any> = Record<string, RulesProp<TContext>>;
/**
 * The full rules prop type: either a single rule set or a language-keyed
 * object.
 */
export type TRulesProp<TContext = any> = RulesProp<TContext> | TOnlyRulesProp<TContext>;
/**
 * A single `validateOn` trigger.
 */
export type ValidateOnTrigger = 'change' | 'blur' | 'next' | 'back' | 'submit';
/**
 * A structured validation issue produced by a field or model unit.
 */
export type Issue = {
    /**
     * The element path the issue belongs to (`''` for root / unmatched).
     */
    path: string;
    /**
     * The language key when the issue comes from a translatable rule set.
     */
    language?: string;
    /**
     * The rule name that produced the issue (e.g. `'required'`, `'min'`,
     * `'standard_schema'`, `'validation_schema'`).
     */
    rule: string;
    /**
     * The resolved, localized error message.
     */
    message: string;
};
/**
 * Options for defining a custom validation rule including check and message
 * functions.
 */
export type RuleOptions<T extends readonly string[] | true = true> = {
    debounce?: number;
    params?: T;
    typed?: boolean;
    /**
     * Extra element paths this rule depends on (beyond `$`-suffixed params). When
     * a dependency's value changes the rule revalidates, gated the same way as
     * `$`-param dependents (skip untouched, never-validated elements unless the
     * form has submitted).
     */
    deps?: string[] | ((ctx: CheckContext<T>) => string[]);
    message?: string | ((messageContext: MessageContext<T>) => string);
    /**
     * Extra or overriding placeholders for the error message. Merged on top of
     * the default params (`attribute` plus declared rule params).
     */
    messageParams?: (messageContext: MessageContext<T>) => Record<string, string | number | undefined>;
    transformParams?: (context: {
        params: RawParams<T>;
    }) => RawParams<T>;
};
/**
 * Function that performs the actual validation check.
 */
export type RuleChecker<T extends readonly string[] | true = true> = (value: any, ruleContext: CheckContext<T>) => boolean | string | Promise<boolean | string>;
/**
 * A single rule argument: positional (`min(3)`) or named (`min({ min: 3 })`).
 */
export type RuleAttribute = {
    value: string;
    name?: string;
};
/**
 * A stateless validation rule produced by `createRule`. Callable with
 * parameters to produce a configured copy (`min(3)`, `min({ min: 3 })`).
 */
export type RuleDefinition<T extends readonly string[] | true = any> = ((...args: any[]) => RuleDefinition<T>) & {
    readonly [RULE_BRAND]: true;
    readonly name: string;
    readonly options?: RuleOptions<T>;
    readonly attributes: RuleAttribute[];
    readonly conditions?: ConditionalProp;
    readonly debounce: number;
    readonly check: RuleChecker<T>;
};
/**
 * Live bindings the validator reads from an owner. Paths and values are
 * functions so list reorders don't require re-registration.
 */
export type ValidationOwner = {
    /**
     * Stable identity. Units are keyed by this, not by path, so validation state
     * survives list reorders.
     */
    id: object;
    /**
     * The element (or virtual element) the check context is built from.
     */
    el$: StatefulElement;
    /**
     * Current element path (`''` for the form / model root).
     */
    path: () => string;
    /**
     * Current data path — where the owner's value lives in the model. Falls back
     * to `path()` when absent. Store write notifications match owners by this, so
     * it matters where the two diverge (flat containers).
     */
    dataPath?: () => string;
    /**
     * Language keys to compile (`['default']` when not translatable).
     */
    languages: () => string[];
    /**
     * The value to validate for a language.
     */
    getValue: (language?: string) => any;
    /**
     * Whether to stop after the first failing unit.
     */
    bail?: () => boolean;
    /**
     * Element-level debounce fallback.
     */
    debounce?: () => number;
    /**
     * Whether the owner has been touched (blur). Used to gate dependent
     * revalidation.
     */
    touched?: () => boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the owner is currently available. Unavailable owners are skipped
     * during whole-form / headless sweeps.
     */
    available?: () => boolean;
};
/**
 * Context object passed to rule check functions, providing access to the
 * element, form, module instances, and utility helpers.
 */
export type RuleContext = {
    /**
     * The element instance being validated.
     */
    el$: StatefulElement;
    /**
     * The parent form context, if available.
     */
    form$?: FormContext;
    /**
     * The Vueform instance the rule runs under: its `config`, `$locale`, and the
     * module doorways (`getDateModule(vueform)`, `useDate(v, f, vueform)`).
     */
    vueform: VueformInstance;
    /**
     * The size-type category of the element (`'string'`, `'number'`, `'array'`,
     * or `'file'`).
     */
    type: SizeTypes;
    /**
     * The element's human-readable display name for error messages.
     */
    attribute: string;
    /**
     * Returns whether a value is considered non-empty by the element.
     *
     * @param value The value to check.
     */
    filled: (value: any) => boolean;
    /**
     * Returns the size of a value according to the element's type (length,
     * numeric value, file size in KB, or array length).
     *
     * @param value The value to measure.
     * @param el$ Optional element to derive the type from.
     */
    size: (value: any, el$?: StatefulElement) => number | undefined;
    /**
     * Derives the size-type category for a given element.
     *
     * @param el$ The element to inspect.
     */
    getType: (el$: StatefulElement) => SizeTypes;
    /**
     * Looks up another element by path, resolving wildcards relative to the
     * current element.
     *
     * @param path The target element path.
     */
    getOther$: (path: string) => StatefulElement | undefined;
};
/**
 * Resolved validator parameters combining required and optional params.
 */
export type ValidatorParams<T extends readonly string[] | true = string[]> = T extends readonly string[] ? {
    [K in RequiredStringParamKeys<T>]: string;
} & {
    [K in RequiredElementParamKeys<T>]: StatefulElement | undefined;
} & {
    [K in OptionalStringParamKeys<T>]?: string;
} & {
    [K in OptionalElementParamKeys<T>]?: StatefulElement;
} : string[];
/**
 * Resolved message parameters combining string and element params.
 */
export type MessageParams<T extends readonly string[] | true = string[]> = T extends readonly string[] ? {
    [K in RequiredStringParamKeys<T>]: string;
} & {
    [K in RequiredElementParamKeys<T>]: StatefulElement | undefined;
} & {
    [K in OptionalStringParamKeys<T>]?: string;
} & {
    [K in OptionalElementParamKeys<T>]?: StatefulElement;
} & {
    attribute: string;
} : {
    attribute: string;
};
/**
 * Context passed to rule message formatters including resolved parameters.
 */
export type MessageContext<T extends readonly string[] | true = true> = RuleContext & {
    params: MessageParams<T>;
};
/**
 * Context passed to rule check functions including resolved parameters.
 */
export type CheckContext<T extends readonly string[] | true = true> = RuleContext & {
    params: ValidatorParams<T>;
};
/**
 * Raw unprocessed parameter tuple as received from rule parsing.
 */
export type RawParams<T extends readonly string[] | true = string[]> = T extends readonly string[] ? {
    [K in T[number] as K extends `${string}?` ? never : K]: string;
} & {
    [K in T[number] as K extends `${infer V}?` ? V : never]?: string;
} : string[];
/**
 * Per-language (or `'default'`) read-only view of an owner's validation state.
 * Shape-compatible with the former `ElementValidation` so `el$.validation` /
 * `el$.currentValidation` keep working.
 */
export type ValidationView = {
    /**
     * The language key used for multilingual validation.
     */
    language: string | undefined;
    /**
     * Whether any active unit is currently invalid.
     */
    invalid: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether any async unit is awaiting a result.
     */
    pending: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether any unit is waiting for its debounce timer.
     */
    debouncing: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether validation is pending or debouncing.
     */
    busy: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether a `required` or `accepted` unit is active.
     */
    required: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Aggregated error messages from invalid units.
     */
    errors: ComputedRef<string[]>;
    /**
     * Structured issues from invalid units.
     */
    issues: ComputedRef<Issue[]>;
    /**
     * Whether every active unit has been run at least once.
     */
    validated: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Runs this language's units against the given value (or the owner's current
     * value when omitted).
     *
     * @param value The value to validate.
     */
    validate: (value?: any) => Promise<boolean>;
    /**
     * Marks units as not yet validated, requiring re-validation.
     */
    invalidate: () => void;
    /**
     * Resets units to their initial state.
     */
    reset: () => void;
};
/**
 * Per-owner rollup of validation state across languages, plus per-language
 * views.
 */
export type OwnerView = {
    /**
     * Per-language views keyed by language (`'default'` when not translatable).
     */
    languages: Record<string, ValidationView>;
    /**
     * Whether any language is invalid.
     */
    invalid: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether any language is pending.
     */
    pending: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether any language is debouncing.
     */
    debouncing: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether every language has been validated.
     */
    validated: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Aggregated error messages across languages.
     */
    errors: ComputedRef<string[]>;
    /**
     * Structured issues across languages.
     */
    issues: ComputedRef<Issue[]>;
};
/**
 * The per-form (or standalone) validator: compiles rules into units, runs them,
 * and exposes projections.
 */
export type Validator = {
    /**
     * All structured issues from registered owners and the model unit, including
     * root-bucket (`''`) issues.
     */
    issues: ComputedRef<Issue[]>;
    /**
     * Localized error messages from `issues`.
     */
    errors: ComputedRef<string[]>;
    /**
     * Whether any registered available owner (or the model root bucket) is
     * invalid.
     */
    invalid: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether any registered owner has a pending async unit.
     */
    pending: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether any registered owner is debouncing.
     */
    debouncing: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    /**
     * Whether the validator is subscribed to a model store's write notifications.
     * When `true`, change notification is store-driven and call sites don't need
     * to invoke `onChange` on value writes.
     */
    wired: boolean;
    /**
     * Registers an owner (or updates its live bindings when already registered).
     * Compiling rules is a separate `setRules` call.
     *
     * @param owner The owner to register.
     */
    register: (owner: ValidationOwner) => void;
    /**
     * Removes an owner and all of its units.
     *
     * @param owner The owner to remove.
     */
    unregister: (owner: ValidationOwner) => void;
    /**
     * Compiles `rules` into field units for the owner, replacing any previous
     * field units. Pass `undefined` to drop field units.
     *
     * @param owner The owner whose rules changed.
     * @param rules The new rules definition.
     */
    setRules: (owner: ValidationOwner, rules?: TRulesProp) => void;
    /**
     * Installs or clears the form-level Standard Schema (one model unit).
     *
     * @param schema The schema to run against the whole model, or `undefined`.
     */
    setValidationSchema: (schema?: StandardSchemaV1) => void;
    /**
     * Runs units. With an owner, runs that owner's field units (optionally one
     * language) and the model unit. With no owner, runs every registered
     * available owner plus the model unit.
     *
     * @param owner Optional owner to limit the run.
     * @param language Optional language to limit the run.
     */
    validate: (owner?: ValidationOwner, language?: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    /**
     * Marks an owner's units as not yet validated.
     *
     * @param owner The owner to invalidate.
     */
    invalidate: (owner: ValidationOwner) => void;
    /**
     * Resets an owner's units to their initial state.
     *
     * @param owner The owner to reset.
     */
    reset: (owner: ValidationOwner) => void;
    /**
     * Notifies the validator that `path`'s value changed: dirties the model unit
     * and revalidates field units that depend on `path` (gated like today's
     * `$`-param watchers).
     *
     * @param path The element path that changed.
     */
    onChange: (path: string) => void;
    /**
     * Re-resolves an owner's dependency index after its path changed (e.g. a list
     * reorder), so wildcard-resolved dep paths keep pointing at the right
     * targets. Unit state is preserved.
     *
     * @param owner The owner whose path changed.
     */
    repath: (owner: ValidationOwner) => void;
    /**
     * Returns (creating if needed) the projection for an owner.
     *
     * @param owner The owner to project.
     */
    view: (owner: ValidationOwner) => OwnerView;
    /**
     * Exposes this validator as a Standard Schema (validate an arbitrary value
     * against the compiled units).
     */
    toStandardSchema: () => StandardSchemaV1;
};
/**
 * The validation module instance: validator creation, view-models, owner
 * assembly, store attachment, and the `validateOn` policy. Validators are
 * created per form / model store.
 */
export type ValidationModule = ReturnType<typeof import('./createValidation').createValidation>;
/**
 * Configuration options for the validation module (`config.$validation`).
 */
export interface ValidationModuleOptions {
}

//// types/base.d.ts
import type { BlueprintContext } from '../composables';
import type { DefineEvents } from '../helpers';
import type { ClassValue } from './classes';
import type { ClassesProp, ComponentProp, PartsProp, PresetsProp, ReclassProp, SlotsProp } from './props';
import type { LooseContext } from './shared';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
/**
 * Base public context for plain form components (e.g. addon, nav). Wraps
 * `BlueprintContext` — blueprint `*Context` interfaces should extend this (or
 * `BaseElementContext`) rather than `BlueprintContext` directly.
 *
 * `TEvents` is always the raw emit map (e.g. `SelectEmits`) and is wrapped with
 * `DefineEvents` eagerly. `DefineEvents` has statically known keys, so
 * blueprint `*Context` interfaces can extend this even while `TProps` /
 * `TEvents` are still type parameters (the conditional `EventsOf` alone would
 * defer and break interface heritage).
 *
 * Kept as a type alias (not an interface) so it can wrap the mapped
 * `BlueprintContext` shape when `TApi` is still a type parameter.
 *
 * `TApi` is typically `typeof setup`.
 */
export type BaseComponentContext<TApi, TProps extends Record<string, any>, TEvents extends Record<string, any> = {}, TSlots extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, TParts extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, TClasses extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>> = BlueprintContext<TApi, TProps, DefineEvents<TEvents>, TSlots, TParts, TClasses>;
/**
 * Base public context for form elements (e.g. select, text). Extends
 * `BaseComponentContext` (same shape today; reserved for element-only fields).
 *
 * `TApi` is typically `typeof setup`.
 */
export type BaseElementContext<TApi, TProps extends Record<string, any>, TEvents extends Record<string, any> = {}, TSlots extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, TParts extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, TClasses extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>> = BaseComponentContext<TApi, TProps, TEvents, TSlots, TParts, TClasses>;
/**
 * Base props shared by all Vueform components (elements, form, and layout
 * components).
 */
export interface BaseComponentProps<S, P, C, TContext = any> {
    /**
     * CSS classes to apply to the component's root element.
     */
    class?: ClassValue;
    /**
     * Named configuration presets to apply to the component.
     */
    presets?: PresetsProp;
    /**
     * Custom DOM attribute overrides for the component's structural parts.
     */
    parts?: PartsProp<P, TContext>;
    /**
     * Custom CSS class overrides for the component's structural parts.
     */
    classes?: ClassesProp<C, TContext>;
    /**
     * CSS class overrides that replace (rather than merge with) default classes.
     */
    reclass?: ReclassProp<C, TContext>;
    /**
     * Custom Vue components to use for named slots. Every component resolves it
     * through the standard outlets pipeline (see `useOutlets`).
     */
    slots?: SlotsProp<S>;
    /**
     * A custom Vue component to use as the template instead of the default.
     */
    template?: ComponentProp | null;
    /**
     * A custom Vue component to render in the component's default slot.
     */
    component?: ComponentProp;
}
/**
 * Base lifecycle events emitted by all Vueform components.
 */
export interface BaseComponentEmits<TContext = LooseContext> {
    /**
     * Emitted before the component is mounted.
     *
     * @param context$ The component's context instance.
     */
    beforeMount: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted after the component is mounted.
     *
     * @param context$ The component's context instance.
     */
    mounted: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted before the component is unmounted.
     *
     * @param context$ The component's context instance.
     */
    beforeUnmount: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted after the component is unmounted.
     *
     * @param context$ The component's context instance.
     */
    unmounted: [context$: TContext];
    /**
     * Emitted after the component is updated.
     *
     * @param context$ The component's context instance.
     */
    updated: [context$: TContext];
}
/**
 * Base slots shared by all Vueform components.
 *
 * `TContext` defaults to `LooseContext` and is overridden by element /
 * component slot maps that pass a concrete context (see `VfSelectSlots`).
 */
export interface BaseComponentSlots<TContext = LooseContext> {
    /**
     * Slot that replaces the entire component rendering. Receives the full
     * component context as a single `context` prop.
     *
     * @param props.context The component context.
     */
    template: (props: {
        context: TContext;
    }) => VNode[];
}
export interface BaseComponentParts {
}
export interface BaseComponentClasses {
}
export interface BaseComponentExpose {
}

//// types/classes.d.ts
import type { ComponentRegistry, ComponentNames } from './component';
import type { MaybeContextual } from './utils';
/**
 * A single CSS class value or an array of class values, including conditional
 * object syntax. Matches Vue's built-in `:class` binding type.
 */
export type ClassValue = false | null | undefined | string | Record<string, any> | ClassValue[];
/**
 * Loosens a single class definition value so that functional class keys also
 * accept a plain `ClassValue`. Functional class keys additionally accept a
 * function whose last parameter is the component context.
 */
export type ClassInput<V, TContext = any> = V extends (...args: infer A) => ClassValue ? ClassValue | ((...args: A) => ClassValue) | ((...args: [...A, context$: TContext]) => ClassValue) : ClassValue | ((context$: TContext) => ClassValue);
/**
 * Maps every key of a classes definition so that functional class keys also
 * accept a plain `ClassValue`.
 */
export type LooseClasses<T, TContext = any> = {
    [K in keyof T]?: ClassInput<T[K], TContext>;
};
/**
 * Prop type for overriding a child component's classes from a parent,
 * supporting contextual functions. Functional class keys additionally accept a
 * function whose last parameter is the component context.
 */
export type ChildClassesProp<T extends ComponentNames> = ComponentRegistry[T]['classes'] extends infer Classes ? MaybeContextual<{
    [K in keyof Classes]?: Classes[K] extends infer C ? C extends (...args: infer A extends any[]) => any ? ClassValue | ((...args: A) => ClassValue) | ((...args: [...A, context$: any]) => ClassValue) : ClassValue | ((context$: any) => ClassValue) : never;
} & Record<string, ClassValue | ((...args: any[]) => ClassValue)>> : never;
/**
 * Extracts the classes definition type for a given component.
 */
export type ClassesOf<T extends ComponentNames> = ComponentRegistry[T]['classes'];

//// types/columns.d.ts
/**
 * The layout section keys that can receive column width assignments.
 */
export type ColumnKeys = 'container' | 'label' | 'wrapper';
/**
 * A plain column width value expressed as a number or string (e.g. `6` or
 * `'6'`).
 */
export type ColumnsPlain = number | string;
/**
 * An object specifying column widths for individual layout sections.
 */
export type ColumnsObject = {
    [K in ColumnKeys]?: ColumnsPlain;
};
/**
 * A column width expressed as either a plain value or a per-section object.
 */
export type ColumnsValue = ColumnsPlain | ColumnsObject;
/**
 * Responsive column definitions keyed by breakpoint name, excluding layout
 * section keys.
 */
export type BreakpointsColumns = Record<string, ColumnsValue> & {
    [K in ColumnKeys]?: never;
};
/**
 * The full columns prop type, supporting plain values, breakpoint objects, or a
 * contextual function.
 *
 * @param context$ The element's component context.
 */
export type ColumnsProp<TContext = any> = ColumnsValue | BreakpointsColumns | ((context$: TContext) => ColumnsValue | BreakpointsColumns);
/**
 * The resolved column widths after normalization, including the computed
 * `group` and `full` values.
 */
export type ResolvedColumns = Record<ColumnKeys | 'group' | 'full', number>;

//// types/component.d.ts
import type { BaseElementContext } from './base';
import type { NarrowExpose } from './utils';
import type { Component, ComponentPropsOptions } from 'vue';
/**
 * A slot callback with its signature re-declared in method syntax, which is
 * bivariant under `strictFunctionTypes` — narrow-context SFC slots stay
 * assignable to the canonical wide-context ones. Non-function members pass
 * through unchanged.
 */
type BivariantSlot<F> = F extends (...args: infer A) => infer R ? {
    fn(...args: A): R;
}['fn'] : F;
/**
 * The shape of a single component registration in the `*Registry` interfaces.
 *
 * `TContext` is the full public context — exactly what `defineExpose` receives
 * from `useBlueprint` (factory API + event helpers + `props` / `parts` /
 * `classes` / `outlets`). `TProps` / `TEmits` are instantiated from the
 * registry's `TEntry` payload for prop-generic components; `TSlots` / `TParts`
 * / `TClasses` stay wide (narrowed slots already flow through `TProps`).
 */
export type DefineRegistryEntry<TProps extends Record<string, any>, TEmits extends Record<string, any>, TSlots extends Record<string, any>, TParts extends Record<string, any>, TClasses extends Record<string, any>, TContext> = {
    /**
     * The component's prop types, narrowed by the registry `TEntry` payload for
     * prop-generic components.
     */
    props: TProps;
    /**
     * The component's emit map, narrowed by the registry `TEntry` payload so
     * schema `on*` handlers receive the narrowed context.
     */
    emits: TEmits;
    /**
     * The component's slot definitions (wide).
     */
    slots: TSlots;
    /**
     * The component's template part definitions (wide).
     */
    parts: TParts;
    /**
     * The component's CSS class definitions (wide).
     */
    classes: TClasses;
    /**
     * The component's full public context — the `defineExpose` shape, narrowed by
     * the registry `TEntry` payload for prop-generic components.
     */
    context: TContext;
};
/**
 * Stores control type component definitions (plain elements, e.g. text, select,
 * button).
 *
 * `TEntry` is the concrete props payload of one usage (a schema entry or an
 * explicit instantiation); registrations map it onto their generic types.
 * Augmentations must repeat the bare `<TEntry>` type parameter:
 *
 * ```ts
 * declare module '@vueform/core' {
 *   interface ControlRegistry<TEntry> {
 *     VfSelect: VfSelectEntry<TEntry>
 *   }
 * }
 * ```
 */
export interface ControlRegistry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> {
}
/**
 * Stores group type component definitions (group-like containers).
 */
export interface GroupRegistry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> {
}
/**
 * Stores list type component definitions (list-like containers).
 */
export interface ListRegistry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> {
}
/**
 * Stores grid type component definitions (grid-like containers).
 */
export interface GridRegistry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> {
}
/**
 * Stores matrix type component definitions (matrix-like containers).
 */
export interface MatrixRegistry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> {
}
/**
 * Stores all element definitions (no direct registration — combined from the
 * family registries).
 */
export interface ElementRegistry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends ControlRegistry<TEntry>, GroupRegistry<TEntry>, ListRegistry<TEntry>, GridRegistry<TEntry>, MatrixRegistry<TEntry> {
}
/**
 * Stores all component definitions. Components that are not elements (e.g.
 * `VfForm`, `VfNav`) register directly to this.
 */
export interface ComponentRegistry<TEntry = Record<string, any>> extends ElementRegistry<TEntry> {
}
/**
 * Union of all registered element names.
 */
export type ElementNames = keyof ElementRegistry;
/**
 * Union of all registered component names.
 */
export type ComponentNames = keyof ComponentRegistry;
/**
 * Catch-all element context when the concrete element type is unknown (e.g.
 * unknown `find()` paths).
 *
 * Intentionally not `ContextOf<ElementNames>`: that union instantiates every
 * registered element's context graph and dominates typecheck time. Call sites
 * that know the element should use `ContextOf<'Vf…'>` instead.
 */
export type UnknownElement = any;
/**
 * @write
 */
export type UnknownComponent = any;
/**
 * Catch-all element parts when the concrete element type is unknown. Kept loose
 * for the same typecheck reason as `UnknownElement`.
 */
export type UnknownElementParts = any;
export type FormContext = ContextOf<'VfForm'>;
/**
 * Returns the full public context of a registered component — the
 * `defineExpose` shape from `useBlueprint`, plus `$config`, `$locale`, and
 * `$globals` injected by `createComponentContext` on every component.
 *
 * Pass a props payload as `TEntry` to narrow prop-generic components the same
 * way SFC generics do:
 *
 * ```ts
 * ContextOf<'VfSelect', { items: typeof items; itemValue: 'id' }>
 * ```
 */
export type ContextOf<T extends ComponentNames, TEntry = Record<string, any>> = ComponentRegistry<TEntry>[T]['context'];
/**
 * Returns the context of a component without unwrapped refs. Currently an alias
 * of `ContextOf` (contexts are stored ref-unwrapped in the registry).
 */
export type RawContextOf<T extends ComponentNames, TEntry = Record<string, any>> = ContextOf<T, TEntry>;
/**
 * Extracts the props type for a given component from its registry entry,
 * optionally narrowed by a `TEntry` payload.
 */
export type PropsOf<T extends ComponentNames, TEntry = Record<string, any>> = ComponentRegistry<TEntry>[T]['props'];
/**
 * Extracts the emit map for a given component from its registry entry,
 * optionally narrowed by a `TEntry` payload.
 */
export type EmitsOf<T extends ComponentNames, TEntry = Record<string, any>> = ComponentRegistry<TEntry>[T]['emits'];
/**
 * Extracts a partial props type for a given component, used for individual part
 * prop overrides. The component may not be registered in the current program —
 * registration is augmentation-driven (a component's `unstyled.ts`), so this
 * must not assume the key exists (e.g. an adapter's src-based type program
 * loads only its own components: no `VfIcon` / `VfTabs` in PrimeVue). Falls
 * back to a loose props record when the key is absent.
 */
export type PartOf<T extends ComponentNames | (string & {})> = T extends ComponentNames ? Partial<PropsOf<T>> : Record<string, any>;
/**
 * The `outlets` shape of a public context: every declared slot name, optional
 * (an outlet only exists when an inline slot or `slots`-prop entry fills it),
 * with its payload types kept but made bivariant (see `BivariantSlot`).
 */
export type ContextOutlets<TSlots> = {
    [K in keyof TSlots]?: TSlots[K] extends (props: infer P) => infer R ? 'context' extends keyof P ? BivariantSlot<(props: {
        [K2 in keyof P]: K2 extends 'context' ? unknown : P[K2];
    }) => R> : BivariantSlot<TSlots[K]> : BivariantSlot<TSlots[K]>;
};
/**
 * Assembles a component's `*Context` from its public type surfaces:
 *
 * ```ts
 * interface VfSelectContext<
 *   TProps extends VfSelectProps = VfSelectProps,
 * > extends DefineElementContext<
 *   TProps,
 *   VfSelectEmits,
 *   VfSelectSlots,
 *   VfSelectParts,
 *   VfSelectClasses,
 *   VfSelectExpose,
 *   SelectApi<TProps>
 * > {}
 * ```
 *
 * Bundles the two constructions every context needs:
 *
 * - `NarrowExpose<TExpose, TApi>` — replaces the Expose's wide API members with
 *   the prop-instantiated ones (`TApi` may be an intersection when a component
 *   extension adds members).
 * - `ContextOutlets<TSlots>` for `outlets` — the slot map with every callback
 *   made bivariant. Using the slots interface as-is breaks SFC context
 *   assignability: slot callbacks are contravariant in their context parameter,
 *   so the SFC's narrow slots would not be assignable to the canonical ones.
 *   Method-syntax signatures are exempt from strict contravariance, which keeps
 *   the payload types on `context.outlets.*` without breaking that assignment.
 *
 * The consuming `*Context` must remain an interface (it sits on the recursive
 * props → context → api → props loop); only its body is factored out here.
 *
 * Convention for prop-generic components: type-parameter defaults on the
 * component's `*Props` / `*Emits` / `*Slots` interfaces must be wide (`any`, or
 * helpers that resolve to `any` like select's `ItemValueOf`) — runtime defaults
 * belong in blueprint `defaults` and the SFC's `generic="… = …"` default, and
 * per-usage narrowing in the registry entry's `EntryPropOr` fallbacks. A
 * concrete literal default (e.g. `= true`) makes the bare interface used here
 * concrete, and the SFC's generic-narrowed `defineSlots` then fails to assign
 * to this context's outlets (TS can't relate an open type parameter to a
 * literal in either direction).
 */
export type DefineElementContext<TProps extends Record<string, any>, TEmits extends Record<string, any>, TSlots extends Record<string, any>, TParts extends Record<string, any>, TClasses extends Record<string, any>, TExpose, TApi extends Record<string, any>> = BaseElementContext<NarrowExpose<TExpose, TApi>, TProps, TEmits, ContextOutlets<TSlots>, TParts, TClasses>;
/**
 * Describes the shape of an element that carries form state, used internally
 * for validation and data handling.
 */
export interface StatefulElement {
    /**
     * The element's field name.
     */
    name: string | number;
    /**
     * The element's dot-separated path in the form data tree.
     */
    path: string;
    /**
     * The element's dot-separated path used for data submission.
     */
    dataPath: string;
    /**
     * A human-readable display name for the element, used in validation messages.
     */
    genericName: string;
    /**
     * The element's current value.
     */
    value: any;
    /**
     * The element's bound model value.
     */
    model: any;
    /**
     * The element's submission payload keyed by field name.
     */
    payload: Record<string, any>;
    /**
     * Whether the element is a static (non-data) element.
     */
    isStatic: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element is currently visible and active based on conditions.
     */
    available: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element has been interacted with by the user.
     */
    touched: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element has been validated at least once.
     */
    validated: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element currently has validation errors.
     */
    invalid: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element has pending async validations.
     */
    pending: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element's input is currently being debounced.
     */
    debouncing: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element's value is considered empty.
     */
    empty: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element is completed, meaning it either has no rules or has
     * been validated without errors.
     */
    completed: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element's children should be flattened in the data output.
     */
    flat?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element is a container whose data is flattened into its
     * parent's level rather than nested under its own key (e.g. a group with
     * `nested: false`).
     */
    isFlatContainer?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether this element pushes its errors to its nearest ancestor element.
     * When enabled, the element does not display or report its own errors; the
     * ancestor includes them in its own errors, display errors, and form errors
     * instead.
     */
    hoist?: boolean;
    /**
     * Resolved value of the `hoist` prop indicating whether this element's errors
     * are pushed to its nearest ancestor element.
     */
    hoisted?: boolean;
    /**
     * The element's own errors including all languages (messageBag + validation).
     */
    ownErrors: string[];
    /**
     * The list of current visible error messages for the element, scoped to the
     * active language and limited by `maxErrors`.
     */
    errors: string[];
    /**
     * Error messages propagated to the form, keyed by element path.
     */
    formErrors: Record<string, string[]>;
    /**
     * Custom validation messages keyed by rule name.
     */
    ruleMessages?: Record<string, any>;
    /**
     * The element's resolved props, including optional debounce, bail, and
     * valueFormat settings.
     */
    props?: Record<string, any> & {
        /**
         * Debounce delay in milliseconds for input validation.
         */
        debounce?: number;
        /**
         * Whether to stop validation after the first failing rule.
         */
        bail?: boolean;
        /**
         * The format string used for value serialization (e.g. date format).
         */
        valueFormat?: string;
    };
    /**
     * The value format string, used when the element serializes values (e.g.
     * dates).
     */
    valueFormat?: string;
    /**
     * Loads a value programmatically and untracks expression tracking on this
     * element and all children that have `untrackOn` including `'load'`.
     *
     * @param data The value to load.
     */
    load?: (data: any) => void;
    /**
     * Determines whether the given value should be considered non-empty.
     *
     * @param value The value to check.
     */
    filled: (value: any) => boolean;
    /**
     * Updates the element's value programmatically.
     *
     * @param data The new value to set.
     */
    update: (data: any) => void;
    /**
     * Resets the element to its default value and clears validation state.
     */
    reset: () => void;
    /**
     * Clears the element's value to an empty state.
     */
    clear: () => void;
    /**
     * Runs validation rules on the element and returns the result.
     */
    validate: () => Promise<any>;
    /**
     * Removes all validation state from the element.
     */
    unvalidate: () => void;
    /**
     * Marks the element as untouched and pristine.
     */
    clean: () => void;
    /**
     * Verifies the element's value against async server-side checks.
     */
    verify?: () => Promise<boolean>;
}
/**
 * Options passed to the Vueform component factory when defining a component.
 */
export type ComponentOptions = {
    /**
     * Whether the component is a form element (participates in form data and
     * validation).
     */
    element?: boolean;
    /**
     * The registered name of the component (e.g. `'VfText'`).
     */
    name: string;
    /**
     * Vue component props options for the component.
     */
    props?: ComponentPropsOptions;
    /**
     * The list of event names the component can emit.
     */
    emits?: string[];
};
/**
 * A Vue component extended with Vueform-specific options (`name` and
 * `element`).
 *
 * Besides Vue's `Component`, this also admits plain call signatures: generic
 * `<script setup>` SFCs compile to a function type whose `ctx` parameter is
 * narrower than `FunctionalComponent`'s, so they never match `Component`
 * structurally even though they are valid components at runtime.
 */
export type VueformComponent = (Component<any, any, any> | ((props: any, ctx?: any, ...args: any[]) => any)) & {
    /**
     * Whether the component is a form element (participates in form data and
     * validation).
     */
    element?: boolean;
    /**
     * Whether the element supports `default`-value expression tracking (template
     * strings like `'{other} …'` that resolve from the model and auto-update).
     */
    expressionable?: boolean;
    /**
     * Model metadata: returns the element's null (empty) value derived from its
     * raw schema-entry props. Used by `useModel`'s schema walk to build the model
     * without mounting components.
     *
     * @param props The element's raw schema-entry props.
     */
    nullValue?: (props: Record<string, any>) => any;
    /**
     * Model metadata: returns a container element's unified child structure
     * (`ModelChildren`) derived from its raw schema-entry props. Leaf elements
     * omit it.
     *
     * @param props The element's raw schema-entry props.
     */
    children?: (props: Record<string, any>) => {
        flat?: boolean;
        array?: boolean;
        entries: Record<string, Record<string, any>>;
    } | undefined;
};
declare module 'vue' {
    interface ComponentCustomOptions {
        /**
         * Whether the component is a form element (participates in form data and
         * validation).

        element?: boolean;

         */
        children?: (props: Record<string, any>) => {
            flat?: boolean;
            array?: boolean;
            entries: Record<string, Record<string, any>>;

    }

/**
 * Resolves a single part value to its allowed shapes. Every object position
 * (static value or function return type) is widened with `Record<string & {},
 * any>` so users can pass arbitrary extra attributes.
 *
 * - The static return value (object of attributes).
 * - The original function shape (for callable parts).
 * - The original function shape with the component context appended as the last
 *   parameter.
 * - For non-callable parts, a function that receives only the component context.
 */
export type PartValue<V, TContext = any> = V extends (...args: infer A) => infer R ? OpenObject<R> | ((...args: A) => OpenObject<R>) | ((...args: [...A, TContext]) => OpenObject<R>) : OpenObject<V> | ((context$: TContext) => OpenObject<V>);

//// types/schema.d.ts
import type { Ref } from 'vue';
import { type ContextOf, type ElementNames, type ElementRegistry, type GridRegistry, type GroupRegistry, type ListRegistry, type MatrixRegistry, type UnknownElement, type AlignProp, type ValignProp, type ElementName, type EmitsToProps, type FlattenDeep, type IsUnion, type Join, type KebabToPascal, type MakeOptional, type MakeRequired, type Prettify, type StandardSchemaV1, type UnionToIntersection, type ComponentProp, type EntryPropOf, type ExpressionString } from './';
/**
 * Union of the `type` prop literals registered in a family registry (derived
 * from each entry's wide props).
 */
type TypesOfRegistry<R> = {
    [K in keyof R]: R[K] extends {
        props: infer P;
    } ? P extends {
        type?: infer T;
    } ? Extract<T, string> : never : never;
}[keyof R];
/**
 * A form schema in array notation with named entries (structural detection
 * helper).
 */
type ArraySchemaType = ReadonlyArray<{
    name: ElementName;
}>;
/**
 * Names of registered elements whose props include `as?: 'addon'`.
 */
type AddonableElementNames = {
    [K in ElementNames]: 'as' extends keyof ElementRegistry[K]['props'] ? K : never;
}[ElementNames];
/**
 * Grid cell layout properties that can be merged with element schemas or
 * content.
 */
type GridCellLayoutProps = {
    colspan?: number | null;
    rowspan?: number | null;
    align?: AlignProp | null;
    valign?: ValignProp | null;
    attrs?: GridCellAttrs;
};
/**
 * Readonly-compatible counterpart of `GridSchema` used as the inference
 * constraint in type-level helpers — `defineSchema`'s `const` narrowing turns
 * `grid` into readonly tuples, which never satisfy the mutable `GridSchema`.
 */
type GridSchemaLike = readonly (readonly (GridCellContent | GridCellSchema)[])[];
/**
 * Whether a registered element's wide props include a `modelValue` prop (i.e.
 * the element carries form data).
 */
type HasModelProp<N extends ElementNames> = 'modelValue' extends keyof ElementRegistry[N]['props'] ? true : false;
/**
 * Widens array model members (at any depth) to also accept their readonly
 * counterparts. `defineSchema`'s `const` type parameter narrows literal arrays
 * (e.g. `default: [1, 2]` or `default: { row: ['a'] }`) to readonly tuples,
 * which are not assignable to the mutable arrays the element models use —
 * without this, a readonly array default fails `ConstrainEntryModel`'s check,
 * inference falls back to the `(ObjectSchema | ArraySchema) & …` constraint,
 * and the `ArraySchema` member leaks Array prototype keys into `Paths` (i.e.
 * `find()` suggestions).
 *
 * Object branches also become partial: at runtime missing child values fall
 * back to `default` / `nullValue`, so structured `modelValue` / `default` input
 * accepts rows and branches with keys omitted (e.g. keys computed by
 * expressions).
 *
 * Validation-only: never surfaces as a model type, so mapping object members
 * (which structurally widens class instances like `Date`) is safe.
 */
type ModelWithReadonly<M> = M extends readonly (infer E)[] ? M | readonly ModelWithReadonly<E>[] : M extends (...args: any) => any ? M : M extends Record<string, any> ? {
    [K in keyof M]?: ModelWithReadonly<M[K]>;
} : M;
/**
 * Item/group key props re-checked against the entry's `items` / `options`
 * shape. Includes core `item*` / `group*` names and PrimeVue `option*` aliases
 * — names that are absent on a given element's props are skipped.
 */
type ItemKeyPropNames = 'itemValue' | 'itemLabel' | 'itemDisabled' | 'itemConditions' | 'groupLabel' | 'groupChildren' | 'groupConditions' | 'optionValue' | 'optionLabel' | 'optionDisabled' | 'optionConditions' | 'optionGroupLabel' | 'optionGroupChildren' | 'optionGroupConditions';
/**
 * Re-narrows item/group key props from the registry props instantiated with the
 * schema entry. Invalid keys (`itemValue: 'idf'` / `optionValue: 'idf'` against
 * `{ id, name }` items) and key props on synthetic shapes (scalar arrays,
 * record maps) fail the same way a wrong `modelValue` does.
 */
type ConstrainEntryItemKeys<El, P> = [
    Extract<keyof P, ItemKeyPropNames>
] extends [never] ? El : El extends Pick<P, Extract<keyof El, ItemKeyPropNames> & keyof P> ? El : Omit<El, ItemKeyPropNames> & Pick<P, Extract<keyof El, ItemKeyPropNames> & keyof P>;
/**
 * Re-narrows the model-coupled props (`modelValue`, `default`) and item/group
 * key props of a schema entry from its registry entry instantiated with the
 * entry itself — this is where `items` / `itemValue` / `multiple` / `translate`
 * / `languages` (or an adapter's own model-driving props) constrain the
 * accepted model, and where `itemValue` / `itemLabel` / `groupChildren` (and
 * the PrimeVue `option*` aliases) are checked against the `items` / `options`
 * shape.
 */
type ConstrainEntryModel<El, N extends ElementNames> = ElementRegistry<El>[N]['props'] extends infer P ? ConstrainEntryItemKeys<HasModelProp<N> extends true ? P extends {
    modelValue?: infer Model;
} ? El extends {
    modelValue?: ModelWithReadonly<Model>;
} & {
    default?: ModelWithReadonly<Model> | ExpressionString;
} ? El : Omit<El, 'modelValue' | 'default'> & {
    modelValue?: ModelWithReadonly<Model>;
    default?: ModelWithReadonly<Model> | ExpressionString;
} : El : El, P> : El;
/**
 * Recursively validates nested `schema` objects/arrays on group/list entries.
 * Grid cells are not re-validated (parity with the container's runtime
 * resolution).
 */
type ValidateNestedSchema<El> = El extends {
    schema: infer S;
} ? Omit<El, 'schema'> & {
    schema: S extends readonly any[] | Record<string, any> ? {
        [K in keyof S]: ValidateSchemaEntry<S[K]>;
    } : S;
} : El;
/**
 * Checks whether an object type has exactly one key.
 */
type IsSingleKey<T> = keyof T & string extends infer K ? K extends any ? [Exclude<keyof T & string, K>] extends [never] ? true : false : never : never;
/**
 * Extracts the schema entry of a single-element schema (used for `flat` lists).
 */
type SingleSchemaElement<S> = [S] extends [ArraySchemaType] ? S extends readonly [infer E] ? E : never : string extends keyof S ? never : [IsSingleKey<S>] extends [true] ? S[keyof S & string] : never;
/**
 * The synthetic prototype entry a non-flat list wraps its rows in at runtime
 * (see the list blueprint's `prototype`).
 */
type ListRowEntry<S> = {
    type: 'group';
    nested: true;
    schema: S;
};
/**
 * Converts an array schema to its object-keyed equivalent, recursing into
 * group/list children.
 */
type ToObjectSchema<T> = [T] extends [ArraySchemaType] ? {
    readonly [El in T[number] as El extends {
        name: infer K extends string;
    } ? K : never]: El extends {
        type: GroupTypes;
        schema: infer S;
    } ? Omit<El, 'schema'> & {
        schema: ToObjectSchema<S>;
    } : El extends {
        type: ListTypes;
    } ? Omit<El, 'schema'> & (El extends {
        schema: infer S;
    } ? {
        schema: ToObjectSchema<S>;
    } : El) : El;
} : T;
/**
 * Resolves the model type of a leaf schema entry from its registry entry
 * instantiated with the entry itself (so `items` / `translate` / etc. narrow
 * it), falling back to `any`.
 */
type ModelOfElement<N extends ElementNames, El> = ElementRegistry<El>[N]['props'] extends {
    modelValue?: infer M;
} ? Exclude<M, undefined> : any;
/**
 * Converts an object schema to its complete model type. Non-nested groups and
 * grids merge their children into the parent level.
 */
type ObjectSchemaToModel<T> = Prettify<{
    [K in keyof T & string as T[K] extends {
        type: GroupTypes | GridTypes;
    } ? T[K] extends {
        nested: true;
    } ? K : never : K]: ElementToModel<T[K]>;
} & UnionToIntersection<{
    [K in keyof T & string]: T[K] extends {
        type: GroupTypes;
        schema: infer S;
    } ? T[K] extends {
        nested: true;
    } ? {} : [FormSchema] extends [S] ? {} : string extends keyof S ? {} : ObjectSchemaToModel<ToObjectSchema<S>> : T[K] extends {
        type: GridTypes;
        grid: infer G extends GridSchemaLike;
    } ? T[K] extends {
        nested: true;
    } ? {} : ObjectSchemaToModel<GridToSchema<G>> : {};
}[keyof T & string] | {}>>;
/**
 * Resolves the model type for a single list item element.
 */
type ListItemModel<El> = El extends {
    flat: true;
    schema: infer S;
} ? FlattenedListModel<S> : El extends {
    schema: infer S;
} ? SchemaToModel<S> : any;
/**
 * Resolves the model type used for path-based value access (containers resolve
 * to their nested model regardless of `nested`, matching runtime `get`).
 */
type ElementModelForPath<El> = El extends {
    type: GroupTypes;
    schema: infer S;
} ? SchemaToModel<S> : El extends {
    type: GridTypes;
    grid: infer G extends GridSchemaLike;
} ? ObjectSchemaToModel<GridToSchema<G>> : ElementToModel<El>;
/**
 * Deeply accesses a type by a dot-separated path string, resolving to `any`
 * when the path cannot be followed.
 */
type DeepPropAccess<T, P extends string> = P extends `${infer K}.${infer R}` ? K extends keyof T ? DeepPropAccess<T[K], R> : any : P extends keyof T ? T[P] : any;
/**
 * Removes `null` and `undefined` deeply from a model type and drops optional
 * modifiers. Validation-only (never surfaces as a model type): the compile-time
 * Standard Schema check compares structural shape only, because required-ness /
 * optionality is the runtime validator's concern and leaf element models are
 * nullable by design (e.g. a text model is `string | number | null`).
 */
type StripNullish<T> = T extends null | undefined ? never : T extends (...args: any) => any ? T : T extends readonly (infer E)[] ? StripNullish<E>[] : T extends Record<string, any> ? {
    [K in keyof T]-?: StripNullish<T[K]>;
} : T;
/**
 * Keys of the (null-stripped) Standard Schema input that are missing from, or
 * structurally incompatible with, the (null-stripped) model shape. The input
 * may be narrower than the model (e.g. `z.enum(['a'])` against a `string`
 * model) — the model being narrower is a mismatch.
 */
type MismatchedModelKeys<SM, SI> = {
    [K in keyof SI]-?: K extends keyof SM ? [SI[K]] extends [SM[K]] ? never : K : K;
}[keyof SI];
/**
 * Union of all registered group element type strings.
 */
export type GroupTypes = TypesOfRegistry<GroupRegistry>;
/**
 * Union of all registered list element type strings.
 */
export type ListTypes = TypesOfRegistry<ListRegistry>;
/**
 * Union of all registered grid element type strings.
 */
export type GridTypes = TypesOfRegistry<GridRegistry>;
/**
 * Union of all registered matrix element type strings.
 */
export type MatrixTypes = TypesOfRegistry<MatrixRegistry>;
/**
 * Resolves the registered component name for a schema `type` string using the
 * runtime convention `Vf${PascalCase(type)}` (exactly what `useSchema` does),
 * filtered by the registered element names. Unknown type strings resolve to
 * `never`.
 */
export type ElementNameOfType<T extends string> = Extract<`Vf${KebabToPascal<T>}`, ElementNames>;
/**
 * The schema-entry surface for a registered element: its props (narrowed by
 * `TEntry` when provided) plus `on*` event-handler props derived from its
 * emits.
 */
export type SchemaEntryOf<N extends ElementNames, TEntry = Record<string, any>> = ElementRegistry<TEntry>[N]['props'] & EmitsToProps<ElementRegistry<TEntry>[N]['emits']>;
/**
 * An element schema definition with a required `type` property. This is the
 * autocomplete surface for schema entries — a union over every registered
 * element, discriminated by the `type` literal.
 */
export type NamedElementSchema = MakeRequired<{
    [K in ElementNames]: SchemaEntryOf<K>;
}[ElementNames], 'type'>;
/**
 * An element schema definition where the `name` property is optional (inferred
 * from the object key).
 */
export type ElementSchema = MakeOptional<NamedElementSchema, 'name'>;
/**
 * A form schema expressed as a readonly array of named element schemas.
 */
export type ArraySchema = readonly NamedElementSchema[];
/**
 * A form schema expressed as an object mapping field names to element schemas.
 */
export type ObjectSchema = {
    [key: string]: ElementSchema;
};
/**
 * The top-level form schema type, accepting either an array or object notation.
 */
export type FormSchema = ArraySchema | ObjectSchema;
/**
 * An element schema that can be rendered inside an addon slot. Only element
 * types whose props include `as?: 'addon'` are accepted.
 */
export type AddonSchema = MakeRequired<{
    [K in AddonableElementNames]: SchemaEntryOf<K>;
}[AddonableElementNames], 'type'>;
/**
 * The content of a single grid cell: an element schema, a string reference, or
 * null for an empty cell.
 */
export type GridCellContent = NamedElementSchema | string | null;
/**
 * Arbitrary HTML attributes applied to a grid cell's wrapper element.
 */
export type GridCellAttrs = Record<string, any>;
/**
 * A grid cell defined as a flat object merging grid layout properties with
 * either an element schema (has `type`) or text content (has `content`).
 */
export type GridCellSchema = GridCellLayoutProps & (NamedElementSchema | {
    content?: string;
});
/**
 * A two-dimensional grid schema where each row is an array of cell content or
 * cell objects.
 */
export type GridSchema = (GridCellContent | GridCellSchema)[][];
/**
 * Converts a grid cell definition to its object-schema representation (named
 * element cells keyed by their `name`).
 */
export type GridToSchema<T> = {
    [K in Extract<FlattenDeep<T>, {
        name: ElementName;
    }> as K['name']]: K;
};
/**
 * Validates a single schema entry: resolves the registered component from its
 * `type`, re-narrows the model-coupled and item-key props from the registry
 * entry, then recursively validates nested schemas.
 *
 * When `type` is missing or unknown, falls back to `ElementSchema` so object
 * literals still get element prop autocomplete inside `defineSchema`.
 */
export type ValidateSchemaEntry<El> = El extends {
    type: infer TY extends string;
} ? ElementNameOfType<TY> extends infer N ? [N] extends [never] ? ElementSchema : N extends ElementNames ? ValidateNestedSchema<ConstrainEntryModel<El, N>> : ElementSchema : ElementSchema : ElementSchema;
/**
 * Maps a schema (object or array) through `ValidateSchemaEntry`, replacing each
 * entry with the expected type when validation fails so TypeScript surfaces
 * property-level errors (e.g. wrong `modelValue` or `itemValue`).
 */
export type ExactValidatedSchema<O> = {
    [K in keyof O]: O[K] extends ValidateSchemaEntry<O[K]> ? O[K] : ValidateSchemaEntry<O[K]>;
};
/**
 * Flattens a list element's child schema into its model type.
 */
export type FlattenedListModel<S> = SingleSchemaElement<ToObjectSchema<S>> extends infer E ? [E] extends [never] ? any : ElementToModel<E> : any;
/**
 * Computes a union of all valid dot-separated paths within a form schema. Wide
 * / index-signature schemas yield `never` (path suggestions require a concrete
 * schema).
 */
export type Paths<T> = [FormSchema] extends [T] ? never : [T] extends [ArraySchemaType] ? Paths<ToObjectSchema<T>> : string extends keyof T ? never : {
    [K in keyof T & string]: T[K] extends infer El ? El extends {
        type: GroupTypes;
        schema: infer S;
    } ? K | Join<K, Paths<S>> : El extends {
        type: ListTypes;
        flat: true;
        schema: infer S;
    } ? K | Join<K, Paths<{
        [I in '0']: SingleSchemaElement<ToObjectSchema<S>>;
    }>> : El extends {
        type: ListTypes;
        schema: infer S;
    } ? K | Join<K, '0'> | Join<Join<K, '0'>, Paths<S>> : El extends {
        type: GridTypes;
        grid: infer G extends GridSchemaLike;
    } ? K | Join<K, Paths<GridToSchema<G>>> : El extends {
        type: string;
    } ? K : never : never;
}[keyof T & string];
/**
 * Validates a Standard Schema's inferred input type against a form schema's
 * model type (`SchemaToModel`). Resolves to `unknown` when compatible — or when
 * the check is vacuous (loose schemas, untyped/union/non-object inputs) — and
 * to a readable diagnostic object otherwise, so intersecting it with the
 * Standard Schema parameter surfaces per-key errors at the call site.
 */
export type MatchesSchemaModel<S, Z extends StandardSchemaV1> = StandardSchemaV1.InferInput<Z> extends infer I ? [unknown] extends [I] ? unknown : IsUnion<I> extends true ? unknown : SchemaToModel<S> extends infer M ? string extends keyof M ? unknown : StripNullish<I> extends infer SI ? SI extends Record<string, any> ? StripNullish<M> extends infer SM ? [MismatchedModelKeys<SM, SI>] extends [never] ? unknown : {
    'Validation schema input does not match the schema model — mismatched keys': MismatchedModelKeys<SM, SI>;
} : never : {
    'Validation schema input must be an object type matching the schema model': I;
} : never : never : never;
/**
 * Resolves the schema entry object at a dot-separated path (the element
 * config). Non-flat list rows resolve to the synthetic group prototype the list
 * wraps its rows in at runtime. Unresolvable paths yield `never`.
 */
export type GetSchemaEntryByPath<T, P extends string> = [FormSchema] extends [T] ? never : [T] extends [ArraySchemaType] ? GetSchemaEntryByPath<ToObjectSchema<T>, P> : P extends `${infer F}.${infer R}` ? F extends keyof T ? T[F] extends infer El ? El extends {
    type: GroupTypes;
    schema: infer S;
} ? GetSchemaEntryByPath<S, R> : El extends {
    type: GridTypes;
    grid?: infer G extends GridSchemaLike;
} ? GetSchemaEntryByPath<GridToSchema<G>, R> : El extends {
    type: ListTypes;
    flat: true;
    schema: infer S;
} ? GetSchemaEntryByPath<{
    [I in `${bigint}`]: SingleSchemaElement<ToObjectSchema<S>>;
}, R> : El extends {
    type: ListTypes;
    schema: infer S;
} ? R extends `${bigint}.${infer SR}` ? GetSchemaEntryByPath<S, SR> : R extends `${bigint}` ? ListRowEntry<S> : never : never : never : never : P extends keyof T ? T[P] : never;
/**
 * Extracts the model type from a full element schema entry, handling container
 * nesting (`group` / `grid` / `list`) before registry-driven leaf resolution.
 */
export type ElementToModel<El> = El extends {
    type: GroupTypes;
    nested: true;
    schema: infer S;
} ? SchemaToModel<S> : El extends {
    type: GridTypes;
    nested: true;
    grid: infer G extends GridSchemaLike;
} ? ObjectSchemaToModel<GridToSchema<G>> : El extends {
    type: ListTypes;
    flat: true;
    schema: infer S;
} ? FlattenedListModel<S>[] : El extends {
    type: ListTypes;
    schema: infer S;
} ? SchemaToModel<S>[] : El extends {
    type: ListTypes;
} ? any[] : El extends {
    type: infer TY extends string;
} ? ElementNameOfType<TY> extends infer N ? [N] extends [never] ? any : N extends ElementNames ? ModelOfElement<N, El> : any : any : any;
/**
 * Converts a form schema into its corresponding model (data) type, mapping each
 * element to its value type.
 *
 * Accepts both the loose `FormSchema` union and narrow `const` schemas returned
 * by `defineSchema` (which are not always assignable to `FormSchema` due to
 * readonly/`as const` literals).
 */
export type SchemaToModel<T> = [FormSchema] extends [T] ? Record<string, any> : string extends keyof T ? Record<string, any> : [T] extends [ArraySchemaType] ? ObjectSchemaToModel<ToObjectSchema<T>> : ObjectSchemaToModel<T>;
/**
 * Resolves the model (value) type for a specific dot-separated path within a
 * form schema.
 */
export type ModelByPath<T, P extends string> = [FormSchema] extends [T] ? any : [T] extends [ArraySchemaType] ? ModelByPath<ToObjectSchema<T>, P> : P extends `${infer F}.${infer R}` ? F extends keyof T ? T[F] extends infer El ? El extends {
    type: GroupTypes;
    schema: infer S;
} ? ModelByPath<S, R> : El extends {
    type: GridTypes;
    grid: infer G extends GridSchemaLike;
} ? ModelByPath<GridToSchema<G>, R> : El extends {
    type: ListTypes;
    flat: true;
    schema: infer S;
} ? ModelByPath<{
    [I in `${bigint}`]: SingleSchemaElement<ToObjectSchema<S>>;
}, R> : El extends {
    type: ListTypes;
} ? R extends `${bigint}` ? ListItemModel<El> : R extends `${bigint}.${infer SR}` ? El extends {
    schema: infer S;
} ? ModelByPath<S, SR> : any : any : any : any : any : P extends keyof T ? ElementModelForPath<T[P]> : any;
/**
 * Resolves the element context for a schema path via the registries: the entry
 * at the path is fed back as the registry `TEntry`, so the returned context is
 * fully narrowed by the entry's props (items, translate, …).
 *
 * Unknown paths, unknown types, and union-typed paths fall back to
 * `UnknownElement` (kept cheap — no all-elements context union).
 */
export type ElementByPath<T, P extends string> = [FormSchema] extends [T] ? UnknownElement : GetSchemaEntryByPath<T, P> extends infer El ? [El] extends [never] ? UnknownElement : El extends {
    type: infer TY extends string;
} ? ElementNameOfType<TY> extends infer N extends ElementNames ? [N] extends [never] ? UnknownElement : IsUnion<N> extends true ? UnknownElement : ContextOf<N, El> : UnknownElement : UnknownElement : UnknownElement;
/**
 * Resolves the return type for `get()`. When the path contains a `@` separator
 * the portion before it identifies the element and the portion after it is
 * resolved as a (possibly nested) property on the element context. Without `@`
 * the element's model value type is returned.
 */
export type GetResult<T, P extends string> = P extends `${infer ElPath}@${infer PropPath}` ? DeepPropAccess<ElementByPath<T, ElPath>, PropPath> : ModelByPath<T, P>;
/**
 * Resolved array of component and named element prop pairs.
 */
export type ResolvedSchema = {
    component: ComponentProp;
    props: NamedElementSchema;
}[];
/**
 * Resolves the child `schema` from a registry `TEntry` payload (unwrapping a
 * possible `Ref`), falling back to the wide `FormSchema` when absent.
 */
export type EntrySchemaOf<TEntry> = EntryPropOf<TEntry, 'schema'> extends infer S ? [S] extends [undefined] ? FormSchema : S extends Ref<infer V> ? V : S : FormSchema;
export {};

export type LooseContext = {

} & {
    form$: FormContext;

export type UID = string;
